paragraphs: Chapter 3701: Setting up a Formation with a few steps
Translator: Henyee Translations , Editor: Henyee Translations
“Interesting.” Not far away, a handsome young man smiled, “Kong Feiyi, what
do you think?”

There was also a young man beside him, but compared to his soaring vigor, that person was practically a sick cat. His face was a little pale, as if he had not woken up yet. He was laidback and did not have the slightest bit of spirit.

This sickly young man’s eyes were half-open. He glanced at Ling Han, and said, “To be able to injure Hou Qingbai with a single strike while being a Human Dao Foundation, he is indeed quite interesting.”
“Do you want to spar with him?” The handsome young man egged him on.

Kong Feiyi chuckled and said, “Firstly, I’m lazy. If I have the time to fight, I might as well lie down for a while longer. Secondly, even if he’s a four-star genius, he’s only Human Dao Foundation, after all. How can he be a match for me? I’m not interested in bullying others, and if you want me to suppress my cultivation level, I’ll be even lazier.”
The handsome young man laughed loudly, “Can’t you change your laziness?”
“No.” Kong Feiyi shook his head, “Yang Yuan, just give up.

The handsome young man, Yang Yuan couldn’t help but shake his head and say, “Kong Feiyi, you’re clearly only in your twenties, yet you already look like an old geezer. If you were to live until four to five hundred years old, you’d probably be too lazy to even cultivate, right?”
“Hehe, you really know me well. As expected of my good friend,” Kong Feiyi
said with a smile.
“Forget about it. I can’t be bothered to scold you either. Just watch the show,”
Yang Yuan shook his head helplessly.
The two of them continued to sit by and watch. On the other side, after Hou Qingbai had spouted a bunch of nonsense, he was finally unable to restrain his fury, and decided to make a move.
-Aside from the large black dog, there was probably no one else that could bear Ling Han’s verbal attacks, which would drive others to death with fury.

“I want you to die!” Hou Qingbai charged over, the Battle Armor on his body glowing, boosting him with great power. As he shot out a punch, his power reached the peak stage of Ultimate Dao Foundation, which was extremely terrifying.
This brought with it a dazzling brilliance, and a sonic boom was left behind
him, exploding in all directions.
Even ordinary Ultimate Dao Foundation cultivators wouldn’t dare to face such a punch head-on. They would definitely die.
Ling Han was naturally unafraid, but he didn’t take it head-on. Instead, he moved his feet and circled around in a limited space.
Everyone considered this natural in fact. It would be strange if he could match the power of the peak stage of the Ultimate Dao Foundation.
“However, a long-term defense is bound to lead to a loss. As long as he is hit by
a punch, then he would lose everything,” someone made a judgement.
“Mhm!” The people beside him all expressed their deep agreement.

Princess Bixiao was even more anxious. Though she knew that Ling Han had charged all the way into the top 12 in the Metal Element Fruit Gathering, and his abilities were astonishing, the prodigies that had come this time were really too strong. Ling Han might not be able to get any advantage.
Now that she saw that Ling Han was only dodging and not attacking, she was naturally worried, and thought that Ling Han was no match.
She was the one who had caused this trouble. If anything happened to Ling Han because of this, she would not be able to rest easy for the rest of her life.
“Brat, how long can you dodge for?” Hou Qingbai smirked coldly. His offensive became even more rapid, wanting to take Ling Han down with thunderous
force.
Though he now had the absolute upper hand, he still hadn’t taken down Ling Han even after so long, which made him feel slightly embarrassed.
Thus, he definitely had to capture Ling Han as soon as possible.
Ling Han had already circled five times around the area. He shook his head. The difficulty of setting up a formation in battle had indeed increased greatly.
He said calmly, “I advise you not to move again.”
“Are you begging for mercy?” Hou Qingbai laughed loudly, but how could he possibly pay any heed to this? He continued to attack Ling Han.
Weng! Multiple veined patterns lit up on the ground, and 36 columns of light shot out at the same time, shooting towards Hou Qing Bai.
Pa, pa, pa, pa! These rays of light landed on the Battle Armor, creating a loud sound. Meanwhile, Hou Qingbai’s expression changed drastically, and he stumbled.𝙧𝙚𝙚𝔀𝒆𝓫𝓷𝙤𝓿𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝙤𝓶
After he retreated three steps, xiu, xiu, xiu, another 36 pillars of light shot over. He paled in shock, yet could not dodge at all. Instantly, he was hit head-on, and his figure swayed again.
However, this time, he finally knew that he had already stepped into the formation, and could not move recklessly. Otherwise, the consequences would be very serious.
He forcefully steadied himself, but the attack of the pillars of light made him feel extremely uncomfortable. Instantly, he spluttered out a mouthful of blood.
This scene rendered everyone speechless.
“This guy is actually a… Formation Master!”
“Hehe, I really had not expected this. I had thought that he was dead for sure. I had not thought that there would actually be such a turn of events.
” Setting up formations with steps, this guy’s talent in formations is truly amazing.”

“This requires an incredibly deep understanding of formations, and only then would one be able to stomp down, and change the power of heaven and earth.” “Although it’s extremely likely that this guy is only a Human Tier Low Grade Formation Master, the fact that he can set up formations with steps speaks volumes of his natural talent.”
“His future… is limitless!”
Everyone nodded, seeing Ling Han in a new light.

Even if Ling Han possessed extremely high natural talent in martial arts, or even if it was a three-star genius or four-star genius, for the heirs of these great sects, they would only give him a second look at most. However, formation geniuses were a different story.
Similar to alchemy, the number of Formation Masters was also quite limited, and there were pitifully few that could be called prodigies.

With the help of such a person, it would be much easier to venture into ancient sites in the future. Not only would it increase the safety level, it could also allow one to venture deeper into some places that should not have been reachable.
All of a sudden, Ling Han’s value had increased countless times over.

Of course, Ling Han was doing this on purpose. He couldn’t possibly stay on the Celestial Sea Planet forever. He had to eventurally adventure into the galaxy, so he needed a certain amount of connections.
Hou Qingbai was both furious and depressed. “Who would’ve thought? You’re actually a Formation Master!”
If he had known this would happen, he definitely wouldn’t have battled in the same area as Ling Han. In the end, he had been trapped by Ling Han.

However, even if he had long since known that Ling Han was a Formation Master, he could not have imagined that Ling Han’s natural talent had actually reached the extent of setting up formations with steps.
This was practically over the top!

“Enough with the nonsense,” Ling Han said calmly. “Kneel down and apologize. Otherwise, you’ll stay inside for the rest of your life.” This was naturally an exaggeration. With his formation abilities, he could only temporarily change the general trend of heaven and earth. At most, in five minutes, this place would return to normal.
However, Hou Qingbai didn’t that and he was completely terrified by the formation.
“You dare?!” he roared. He was the descendant of a great elite at Sect Master-level, so how could he kneel down and apologize in public? What a joke!
“Is that so?” Ling Han smiled, raised his foot and stomped. Weng, the originally dim veined patterns immediately lit up again. Xiu, xiu, xiu, xiu, 36 pillars of light shot out in unison.
Did he think that everything would be fine as long as he stood in the formation without moving?
How naive!
He was a Formation Master, and as the Formation Master was right next to it, how could it be that he couldn’t control the formation?

“Wu!” Hou Qingbai released a muffled groan, and tried his best to dodge, but the speed of the pillars of light was too fast, so how could he possibly dodge? Under the combined attacks of the pillars of light, even the Battle Armor couldn’t protect him. After five rounds of attacks, pa, the Battle Armor shattered.
” Ah- ” Hou Qingbai released a terrible scream, but the good news was that he had finally rushed out of the formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 3702: Resolute and decisive
paragraphs: Chapter 3702: Resolute and decisive
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Hou Qingbai felt his vision darken, and a figure had already appeared in front of him.
Ling Han.

He wanted to attack, but he had just raised his hand, when he let out a pained groan. The Battle Armor had been damaged, and he had also been hit by the pillars of light. He was severely injured, so what power did he have left?
Ling Han delivered a palm strike, and pa, Hou Qingbai was smacked onto the ground.
Everyone sighed. This was the strength of a Formation Master. He definitely couldn’t be underestimated.

You see, without much effort, a two-star genius had been defeated, and this was a formation that Ling Han had set up at the last minute. If he was given enough time to prepare, even if he was facing ten or even a hundred Hou Qingbais, Ling Han would probably also be on the winning side, right?
Just think of those ancient sites, and you would know. Actually, they all had formations, and how many people had been trapped there?
Thinking of this, everyone’s eyes lit up, and became even more determined to befriend Ling Han.
Ling Han’s heart also thumped in excitement. He had seen another path. If formations were studied to the pinnacle, would they be able to kill even Saints?
Of course, who knew how many steps he had to take.
“Kneel down and apologize. Otherwise, die!” he said coldly. Since he had already spoken, he naturally had to keep his word.

Hou Qingbai raised his head high. How could he possibly kneel in front of so many people? He sneered, and said, “Do you dare to kill me? If I die, my personal memorial tablet will immediately shatter, and my father will immediately receive the news. At that time, when he charges over, not only you, but even the entire Celestial Sea Planet will be buried with me!”
“Kill me, then go ahead and kill me!”

Ling Han’s eyes sharpened. He could not accept being threatened at all. So what if it was a great elite of Sect Master-level? Worse come to worst, he could burn him with the Heavenly Dao Flames. In any case, he still had eight chances to use it.

It was just that there was a bit of trouble. If he used the Heavenly Dao Flames, it was very likely that he would be able to attract attention from the Holy Land of Metal Element. As long as the latter made a comparison, they would discover that the two flames were of the same origin.
Naturally, the fact that he was the true culprit who had set fire to the Holy Land would be exposed.
However, so what?

111 oblige you!” Ling Han said coldly, his killing intent surging like ice. Everyone gritted their teeth. This guy was really too decisive, wasn’t he? He would kill even the son of a great elite of Sect Master-level just like that? “Brother Ling, please have mercy!” Immediately, someone stepped out to mediate the situation, “Hou Qingbai is right. If a great elite of Sect Master-level arrives, the people here would be plunged into misery and suffering. Even if Brother Ling Ling has a way to escape, how innocent would the people here
It was a green-haired young man, his eyes shining like small suns. It was unknown whether he came from a Foreign Race, or was born with an Innate Divine Physique.
He smiled at Ling Han and said, “I’m Cheng Fei, and I actually don’t know Hou Qingbai. So, Brother Ling, please don’t think that I’m speaking up for him.”
“That’s right. Brother Ling still has a bright and boundless future ahead of you. There is no need for you to die here,” another advised.
Princess Bixiao also walked over, and said, “Forget it!”
“Hou Qingbai, quickly apologize to this lady!” Cheng Fei shouted at Hou Qingbai.

Hou Qingbai’s face was as white as a sheet. He had genuinely been frightened by Ling Han just then. Ling Han’s killing intent was as cold as ice, and it was incomparably firm and bone-chilling. This made him realize that Ling Han wasn’t simply trying to scare him. Instead, he genuinely dared to attack.
With this thought, he cowered.
For the sake of competing with a native, he was actually going to give up his life?
Of course, it was not worth it.

Thus, he turned to Princess Bixiao and said, “I’m sorry, I was too abrupt!” He swore that he would definitely avenge this humiliation. In future, he would make Ling Han kneel in front of him, and make him suffer a fate worse than death, while he would play Princess Bixiao to death.
These lowly people actually dared to humiliate him.
Princess Bixiao hurriedly said to Ling Han, “Forget it, forget it. He has already apologized.” She was really worried about Ling Han, and did not want anything to happen to him.
In any case, Ling Han had already stepped out bravely for her, which made her feel a sweetness in her heart.
Just when everyone thought that Ling Han was about to stop, they saw Ling Han raise his foot and suddenly kick out.
Pa! Hou Qingbai collapsed to the ground.
Ling Han walked over and pulled his upper body up. This time, Hou Qingbai was forced into a kneeling position.

“I told you to kneel down and apologize. Did you not hear me clearly?” he whispered by Hou Qingbai’s ear, while his right hand gripped onto the latter’s neck. “You can test my courage, and see if I dare to kill you!”
A terrifying chill instantly spread throughout his body, and Hou Qingbai couldn’t help but shiver. This killing intent was as cold as ice, directly penetrating into his heart.
He didn’t dare to try. Just now, he had already been frightened by Ling Han’s killing intent. This guy really couldn’t be judged by common sense. Who knows, he might make a move.
In any case, he had already been forced into a kneeling position, so it wouldn’t hurt to say another word, right?
“S-sorry, I was wrong!” he said to Princess Bixiao again, his face flushed red.
Kneeling down in public and apologizing, as the son of a Sect Master, how could he endure this?
This was utterly humiliating.
Scram!” Ling Han casually waved his hand and tossed Hou Qingbai away.
At this moment, everyone was speechless.
This guy was really too stubborn, wasn’t he? Just because he said he wanted someone to kneel down and apologize, he had to force them to kneel. Merely apologizing was useless.
Hard-headed, he was really too hard-headed.
However, some people saw that there was something deeper behind this, and that was Ling Han’s determination.
Without achieving his goal, he would definitely not give up, and would definitely not compromise.

In martial arts, this was an incomparably valuable quality. No matter what kind of hardships and difficulties they encountered, they would not give up. Even if they crashed into a wall, they would not turn back. Instead, they would have to forcefully crash through the wall – or kill themselves there.

No wonder this guy had been able to achieve setting up formations with steps at such a young age. With this kind of perseverance and determination, as well as enough natural talent, it would be strange if he did not have such accomplishments.
“Brother Ling, I am Su Feilang, and would like to befriend you.”
“I amZhuang Boming. Greetings, Brother Ling.”
IIJ II
Everyone gathered around, wanting to befriend Ling Han. This was a formation genius, and a future Formation Grandmaster, so he was definitely worth befriending.
As for offending Hou Qingbai?
Hehe, they were all the descendants and heirs of Sect Master, or even Venerate Tier elites, so how could they be afraid?

Ling Han also became cordial, and greeted everyone one by one. These people could possibly become his connections after he entered into the galaxy in future, so he did not mind making a few more friends.
After talking for a while, he finally said to Princess Bixiao, “Come let’s eo back.”? ’???6

To avenge her, this man had even thrashed the son of a great elite of Sect Master Tier, just like that. He had even forced him to lower his head and kneel down in apology. How could she not be touched?
At this moment, she was truly willing to bear children for Ling Han.
Yes, it was indeed a monkeyO.
Not long after, the two of them returned to the “camp”.
Ling Han began to set up formations, preparing to concoct Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pills.

If he wasn’t a Formation Master, he would first have to buy the corresponding formation foundations, then ask a Formation Master to set up a formation for him. Now, there was no need to go to so much trouble. Ling Han himself was Formation Master, taking care of everything single-handedly.𝑓𝓇𝘦ℯ𝘸𝘦𝑏𝓃𝑜𝘷ℯ𝑙.𝑐𝑜𝓂

Just when everyone thought that Ling Han was about to stop, they saw Ling Han raise his foot and suddenly kick out.
Pa!

Ling Han walked over and pulled his upper body up.
This time, Hou Qingbai was forced into a kneeling position.
“I told you to kneel down and apologize.
Did you not hear me clearly?” he whispered by Hou Qingbai’s ear, while his right hand gripped onto the latter’s neck.
“You can test my courage, and see if I dare to kill you!”
A terrifying chill instantly spread throughout his body, and Hou Qingbai couldn’t help but shiver.
This killing intent was as cold as ice, directly penetrating into his heart.
He didn’t dare to try.
Just now, he had already been frightened by Ling Han’s killing intent.
This guy really couldn’t be judged by common sense.
Who knows, he might make a move.
In any case, he had already been forced into a kneeling position, so it wouldn’t hurt to say another word, right?
“S-sorry, I was wrong!” he said to Princess Bixiao again, his face flushed red.
Kneeling down in public and apologizing, as the son of a Sect Master, how could he endure this?
This was utterly humiliating.
Scram!” Ling Han casually waved his hand and tossed Hou Qingbai away.
At this moment, everyone was speechless.
This guy was really too stubborn, wasn’t he?
Just because he said he wanted someone to kneel down and apologize, he had to force them to kneel.
Merely apologizing was useless.
Hard-headed, he was really too hard-headed.
However, some people saw that there was something deeper behind this, and that was Ling Han’s determination.
Without achieving his goal, he would definitely not give up, and would definitely not compromise.
In martial arts, this was an incomparably valuable quality.
No matter what kind of hardships and difficulties they encountered, they would not give up.
Even if they crashed into a wall, they would not turn back.
Instead, they would have to forcefully crash through the wall – or kill themselves there.
No wonder this guy had been able to achieve setting up formations with steps at such a young age.
With this kind of perseverance and determination, as well as enough natural talent, it would be strange if he did not have such accomplishments.
“Brother Ling, I am Su Feilang, and would like to befriend you.”
“I amZhuang Boming.
Greetings, Brother Ling.”
IIJ II

This was a formation genius, and a future Formation Grandmaster, so he was definitely worth befriending.
As for offending Hou Qingbai?
Hehe, they were all the descendants and heirs of Sect Master, or even Venerate Tier elites, so how could they be afraid?

These people could possibly become his connections after he entered into the galaxy in future, so he did not mind making a few more friends.

He had even forced him to lower his head and kneel down in apology.
How could she not be touched?
At this moment, she was truly willing to bear children for Ling Han.
Yes, it was indeed a monkeyO.
Not long after, the two of them returned to the “camp”.
Ling Han began to set up formations, preparing to concoct Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pills.
If he wasn’t a Formation Master, he would first have to buy the corresponding formation foundations, then ask a Formation Master to set up a formation for him.
Now, there was no need to go to so much trouble.
Ling Han himself was Formation Master, taking care of everything single-handedly.𝑓𝓇𝘦ℯ𝘸𝘦𝑏𝓃𝑜𝘷ℯ𝑙.𝑐𝑜𝓂

chapters.title: Chapter 3703: Refining the Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill
paragraphs: Chapter 3703: Refining the Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
The concoction of the Celestial level alchemical pill was slightly more complicated. Merely the formation alone was not enough. It also needed an alchemy cauldron, which was very important.
Because the quality of the cauldron would also affect the quality of the completed pill.
Ling Han didn’t have a good alchemy cauldron in his possession right now, so he could only use the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower as a replacement. Why was the cauldron so important?

This was because an alchemist’s cauldron was like a Spirit Tool. It would be fused with a sliver of divine sense. Thus, it would be extremely sensitive to changes in energy, and alchemy was actually using energy to extract the medicinal properties, guide the medicinal properties, and fuse the medicinal properties.
The more sensitive one was to energy, the higher the chances of concocting alchemical pills, and the higher the grade of the completed pill.
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was Ling Han’s Spirit Tool. It was forged from the Origin Gold, and could be considered the strongest alchemy cauldron in the world, right?
Ling Han activated the formation. Boom! The power of heaven and earth surged out.

The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower floated gently. With Ling Han’s guidance, he extracted the power of heaven and earth into the ninth level of the tower. Now, only this level was empty, and could be used as space for the alchemy cauldron.
Ling Han made slight adjustments through that sliver of divine sense, changing the strength and category of energy that had entered the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Materials were thrown out one after another, and were absorbed by the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
Ling Han performed precise control, and his consciousness turned into thin threads, not being detected in the slightest.

The refinement process was progressing in an orderly manner, and one of the greatest benefits of using the Primal ChaosExtreme Lightning Tower to concoct alchemical pills was that the cauldron would not explode. At most, the alchemical pill would be messed up, and only a portion of the ingredients would be wasted.
Three hours passed, and Ling Han couldn’t help but frown.
He had failed.
The Alchemy Emperor actually failed?

Ling Han recalled the entire process, and nodded, “The medicinal recipe is set in stone, but the age of the ingredients could not possibly completely match the medicinal recipe. Thus, slight adjustments have to be made. This is my mistake.”
He started again, and another three hours later, a smile appeared on Ling Han’s face.
Success.
With a thought, xiu, xiu, xiu, seven green alchemical pills flew out of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
“Grade of completed pill, High Grade!”
Ling Han laughed loudly. He had successfully refined it on his second attempt, and it had even reached High Grade. What was there to be dissatisfied about?
“If I refine it a few more times, I’ll definitely be able to reach the quality of Peak Grade.”
However, after concocting two alchemical pills, Ling Han’s spiritual power was also greatly exhausted, and he could no longer continue.
He would rest first, and continue tomorrow.
He wasn’t a petty person, and he gave Princess Bixiao and Sixth Baby each two Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pills.

One pill could only be ingested each day. After all, it was a medicine, and had a certain level of poison. If one ingested too much, not only would it be useless for cultivating, one would also accumulate alchemical poison. When it reached a certain level, even a Saint would not be able to save him.
However, to the majority, this problem did not exist.
—Who would be so wealthy that they could eat Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pills every day, and still have excess?

Princess Bixiao was naturally overjoyed. The Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill was extremely valuable, and no one on the Celestial Sea Planet could refine it. However, after some thought, she accepted it.
Er, in any case, she owed too many debts, so she would repay these debts with her body.
Her face was flushed, and she was extremely embarrassed.
Sixth Baby didn’t want it, and she said, “Father, we’re a bit special. Celestial medicines have no effect on us.”
Yi, could it be that since you guys grew from the gourd vine, so you won’t eat greens?

Alright, Ling Han nodded. He trusted the babies very much, and also believed in their uniqueness. Since Sixth Baby said that the Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill had no effect on her, then it definitely had no effect.

Ling Han put the alchemical pill away. This thing should be one of the most practical alchemical pills for Foundation Building Tier cultivators. Now, there were extraordinarily many Foundation Building Tier cultivators here, so there should be a wide market for them, and they could be sold for a high price.
Moreover, he had also promised the stall keeper that he would sell him a portion of the Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pills that he had concocted in exchange for more Foxwood.
“When the time comes to concoct alchemical pills, I regret not having enough!” Ling Han exclaimed ruefully.
The next morning, the sun had just risen. Ling Han swallowed an Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill first, then started to cultivate.
In this way, he could maximize the effects of the alchemical pill.

Hong, with the guidance of the Great Sun Lotus Technique, the power of heaven and earth surged into Ling Han’s body. The apertures all over his body opened up. There were 360 of them, which was a whole ten times more than the weakest Foundation Building Tier cultivator, so the speed of his cultivation was naturally a whole ten times slower.
Additionally, there were two mysterious powers taking effect inside his body, endlessly turning into mystical power that he could absorb, strengthening the foundations of the Celestial Path.

This was naturally the Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill that he had just ingested, as well as the Silver Dragon Fish that he had ingested earlier. The unique trait of the Silver Dragon Fish was that its effects would not immediately appear, but would be exhibited in the following period of time.

This was especially the case with the Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill. The effects were extremely obvious, and Ling Han could clearly sense that his cultivation speed was much faster than the day before.
“I don’t know the limits of Human Dao Foundation, so I can’t estimate my own progress. Did I really advance into the middle stage of Human Dao Foundation?”

Ling Han stroked his chin and said, “Forget about it. I’ll ignore this for now. In any case, as long as I can’t advance any further in my cultivation, I would have reached the pinnacle of Human Dao Foundation.”

He first concocted a cauldron of alchemical pills. This time, they were still High Grade alchemical pills, and had not leaped into the level of Peak Grade. However, the number of completed alchemical pills had reached eight, which meant that Ling Han had actually made some improvement in concocting the Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill.
Only one night had passed, and he had only concocted one more cauldron, and he had already attained this kind of improvement. His reputation as the Alchemy Emperor was definitely not just for show.
However, his spiritual power was almost exhausted. Ling Han didn’t want to exhaust himself too much, so he didn’t refine a second cauldron.
He went to the marketplace and found the stall keeper from yesterday.𝘧𝑟𝑒𝑒𝘸𝘦𝘣𝑛𝑜𝘷𝑒𝓁.𝘤𝘰𝓂
“Yi, brother, it’s you?” The stall keeper smiled, and said, “What is it? You’ve wasted all the ingredients, and now you want to replenish them?”
Ling Han laughed loudly, drew out a pill bottle and handed it over.
“Yi, you’ve succeeded!” The stall keeper was skeptical. After taking the pill bottle, he uncorked it, and when he looked at it, he couldn’t help but feel moved.
He had naturally eaten Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pills before, so he was naturally no stranger to this.
This was definitely a genuine item, and furthermore… its quality was extraordinary.
“You really succeeded?” The stall keeper looked at Ling Han in shock.
It had only been a day, and he had already concocted it?

For the majority of alchemists, being able to concoct a successful cauldron out of every ten cauldrons was already quite impressive. Thus, though he had sold Ling Han a length of Foxwood, he did not think that Ling Han would really be able to concoct anything.
At least, not so fast.
Yet Ling Han had succeeded, and furthermore, the grade of the completed pill was so high.
Inconceivable, this was really inconceivable.
“I’m Lin Xiu. Let’s be friends,” the stall keeper said.
“Ling Han.” Ling Han also smiled slightly, and stretched out a hand towards the other.

Lin Xiu shook hands with Ling Han, and said, “I come from the Permanent Bright Planet, also known as the Medicinal Garden Planet. The heaven and earth there is especially suitable for growing Celestial medicines. A great many Celestial medicines that do not survive on other planets can survive in the Medicinal Garden Planet. Furthermore, they grow well and quickly.”
“Hehe, the reason why I’m here this time is actually to sell medicinal ingredients. Going to the Mystery Realm is only in passing.”
Er, he was really honest.

chapters.title: Chapter 3704: Galaxy Network
paragraphs: Chapter 3704: Galaxy Network
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations

Ling Han chatted with Lin Xiu for a while, and Lin Xiu indeed kept his word. He took out a few more segments of Foxwood and sold them to Ling Han. They were far older than the previous segment, and the price was quite fair.
The two of them reached an agreement. Lin Xiu would sell Ling Han as much Foxwood as he wanted, and Ling Han would sell the same amount of Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pills to Lin Xiu.

It looked like Ling Han had profited greatly, but he was the Alchemy Emperor, and his pill completion rate had exceeded imagination. For an ordinary alchemist, this kind of requirement was already very high.

Ling Han found out that most of the people on the Medicinal Garden Planet were farmers, but there wasn’t a single alchemist. Thus, the medicinal ingredients produced could only be sold, but couldn’t be refined.
Though they were in the upper reaches of the alchemical pill business, they did not earn much profit. The majority of the profits had been taken by the alchemists.

It couldn’t be helped. The medicinal ingredients purchasing teams from the planets around Medicinal Garden Planet worked together to lower the price, resulting in the price of the raw ingredients not being high.
“Can’t you guys transport the medicinal ingredients out by yourselves?” Ling Han asked.
“We have thought about it, and we have tried.” Lin Xiu shook his head, “But there are interstellar pirates outside our planet, and they have snatched all our goods, and the result is even worse.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but sneer, “What interstellar pirates? It’s most likely those medicinal purchasing groups in disguise.”

“Sigh!” Lin Xiu sighed, and said, “It can’t be helped. Although the Medicinal Garden Planet is suitable for medicinal ingredients to grow, it’s not suitable for the growth of cultivators. It can’t produce any elites, so we can only wait to have our prices sliced.”
Ling Han nodded, “Then why have you come out this time? Firstly, to sell medicinal ingredients, and secondly, to become stronger?”
“If I can become Sect Master-level in the future, I would really like to see who would dare to bully Medicinal Garden Planet,” Lin Xing said angrily.
Ling Han paused, then said, “In future, I can sell you two Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pills every time.”
“Really?” Lin Xiu’s eyes lit up.
“Really.” Ling Han nodded.
“Thank you.”
“No need. I’m not givingyou alchemical pills, I’m still taking payment.”

“Haha.” Lin Xiu patted Ling Han’s shoulder. The Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill had always been priceless. Aside from the Dao Child and Holy Daughter of the great sects, there were very few other heirs that could consume it.
Ling Han selling an additional Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill to him was a huge favor.
He did not say any more words of thanks, but rather kept it in his heart. He would definitely repay him in future.

Ling Han took out an additional Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill. This was nothing to him. As long as there was enough Foxwood, as the Alchemy Emperor, how could he fear that there would be no alchemical pills?𝒻𝓇𝑒𝘦𝘸𝑒𝒷𝓃ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝒸ℴ𝘮
Moreover, the other was born in the Medicinal Garden Planet, so he definitely had a channel to obtain a large amount of precious medicinal ingredients. This connection was extremely useful to him.
Ling Han returned to his tent, and saw that there were already a great many people waiting for him, wanting to further develop relations with him.
A formation prodigy was really worth befriending.

Ling Han also observed people. If he could get along with them, he would say a few more words. If they couldn’t, he wouldn’t deliberately offend them either. He just couldn’t be bothered to deal with them. Once he spoke less, they would know what he was doing, and wouldn’t take the initiative to be rebuffed.
A few days later, someone issued a bounty. Whoever could kill Ling Han would be able to obtain a thousand Dao Stones.
When Ling Han received the news, he was extremely surprised. How was he supposed to receive this bounty? He didn’t even know who the person who issued the bounty was.
“You’re actually curious about this?” Princess Bixiao didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. Shouldn’t you be more concerned about who issued the bounty and how to deal with possible assassins?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “It’s most likely a bounty issued by Hou Qingbai. I’m thinking, if others really succeed and go to him to collect the bounty, what if he doesn’t admit it?”
Princess Bixiao was rendered speechless.
Ling Han soon found out that this bounty wasn’t a joke.
Though the galaxy was huge, after so many years of development, aside from the boundless and distant edges of the universe, the whole galaxy was actually already connected.
The internal structure of the planet was through the Wide Star Vine, while the connection between planets was through spatial nodes.

On the planets where martial arts were developing normally, many people would buy connectors to connect to the colossal Galaxy Network, and find out in real time what major events were happening in the galaxy.
It was said that this Galaxy Network was constructed by an Ancestral King in the ancient times, who had used great power to open up spatial nodes one after another.
After the Galaxy Network was constructed, a kind of virtual currency was also created, and that was Universe Coins.

The Universe Coins were linked to the Dao Stones, and the exchange rate was one to one. Meanwhile, the stability of the Universe Coins was maintained by the Ancestral King-level force that had built the Galaxy Network. They had a large number of Dao Stones in their possession, and it was guaranteed that the Universe Coins could be exchanged for Dao Stones.
With such a foundation, interstellar trading became possible.

The bounty for Ling Han was posted on the Galaxy Network. Whoever killed Ling Han and uploaded the image of Ling Han’s death would be recognized by this platform, and the 1000 Universe Coins that the person who had posted the bounty had previously written off would be directly recorded into his account.

—Previously, the internet platform of the Dark North Nation was the model of the Galaxy Network. However, at that time, there was no Wide Star Vine, so they had to rely on the help of satellites, light cables, and so Chen Fengyan, as an “ancient person” from more than 2000 years ago, definitely knew about the Galaxy Network.
“Yi, there’s actually such a good thing?” Ling Han was surprised. Unfortunately, he didn’t have a connection device, and couldn’t connect to the Galaxy Network.
However, there were many extraterrestrial visitors here, so he could borrow them.
Ling Han used someone else’s connection device to log into the Galaxy Network, and instantly, an incredibly vast world appeared in front of him.
Before this, he was like a frog at the bottom of a well, and the things he could come into contact with were extremely barren.

“Hehe, as long as you have enough Universe Coins, you can also buy cultivation techniques, pill recipes, formation techniques.” Ling Han nodded, “If you want to obtain Universe Coins, the fastest way would be to obtain the Charging Stone, and there are charging points set up by the Chang Clan on many planets.

The Chang Clan was the descendant of that Ancestral King that had constructed the Galaxy Network. With such a colossal network in their grasp, after countless years, the wealth and power of the Chang Clan must have reached a terrifying extent.
Unfortunately, even with such astonishing resources, the Chang Clan was still unable to produce a second Ancestral King.
The difficulty of the Imperial Path could be imagined.
“However, firstly, the Dao Stones in my possession are limited, and secondly, there are no charging points on the Celestial Sea Planet.”
“Then, I can only earn Universe Coins first.”

“I can auction off the Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill, and have someone transfer money to me through the Galaxy Network… Oh, no wonder someone asked me for an account number when I was selling ingredients.”
“I don’t have an account number, but Lin Xiu should have one. Let’s just leave the money with him first.”
“En, I’ll ask him tomorrow what his account is called.”

Ling Han swept his gaze over it. Pill recipes were extremely expensive. The cheapest Celestial level pill recipe was at least 500 Dao Stones. Furthermore, pill recipes were unique. In other words, after you obtained a new pill recipe, you could apply for a proprietary application on the Galaxy Network. Even if others bought this pill recipe from you, they would not be allowed to sell it on the Galaxy Network.
It was the same for cultivation techniques and formation techniques, protecting the fruits of labour of the creator as much as possible.
Of course, for the Chang Clan, they could read all the cultivation techniques, pill recipes, formations, and so on, of the world, without paying any price at all.
Thus, it would be difficult for the Chang Clan to not be strong.

Lin Xiu would sell Ling Han as much Foxwood as he wanted, and Ling Han would sell the same amount of Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pills to Lin Xiu.
It looked like Ling Han had profited greatly, but he was the Alchemy Emperor, and his pill completion rate had exceeded imagination.
For an ordinary alchemist, this kind of requirement was already very high.
Ling Han found out that most of the people on the Medicinal Garden Planet were farmers, but there wasn’t a single alchemist.
Thus, the medicinal ingredients produced could only be sold, but couldn’t be refined.
Though they were in the upper reaches of the alchemical pill business, they did not earn much profit.
The majority of the profits had been taken by the alchemists.
It couldn’t be helped.
The medicinal ingredients purchasing teams from the planets around Medicinal Garden Planet worked together to lower the price, resulting in the price of the raw ingredients not being high.
“Can’t you guys transport the medicinal ingredients out by yourselves?” Ling Han asked.
“We have thought about it, and we have tried.” Lin Xiu shook his head, “But there are interstellar pirates outside our planet, and they have snatched all our goods, and the result is even worse.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but sneer, “What interstellar pirates?
It’s most likely those medicinal purchasing groups in disguise.”
“Sigh!” Lin Xiu sighed, and said, “It can’t be helped.
Although the Medicinal Garden Planet is suitable for medicinal ingredients to grow, it’s not suitable for the growth of cultivators.
It can’t produce any elites, so we can only wait to have our prices sliced.”
Ling Han nodded, “Then why have you come out this time?
Firstly, to sell medicinal ingredients, and secondly, to become stronger?”
“If I can become Sect Master-level in the future, I would really like to see who would dare to bully Medicinal Garden Planet,” Lin Xing said angrily.
Ling Han paused, then said, “In future, I can sell you two Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pills every time.”
“Really?” Lin Xiu’s eyes lit up.
“Really.” Ling Han nodded.
“Thank you.”
“No need.
I’m not givingyou alchemical pills, I’m still taking payment.”
“Haha.” Lin Xiu patted Ling Han’s shoulder.
The Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill had always been priceless.
Aside from the Dao Child and Holy Daughter of the great sects, there were very few other heirs that could consume it.
Ling Han selling an additional Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill to him was a huge favor.
He did not say any more words of thanks, but rather kept it in his heart.
He would definitely repay him in future.
Ling Han took out an additional Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill.
This was nothing to him.
As long as there was enough Foxwood, as the Alchemy Emperor, how could he fear that there would be no alchemical pills?𝒻𝓇𝑒𝘦𝘸𝑒𝒷𝓃ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝒸ℴ𝘮
Moreover, the other was born in the Medicinal Garden Planet, so he definitely had a channel to obtain a large amount of precious medicinal ingredients.
This connection was extremely useful to him.
Ling Han returned to his tent, and saw that there were already a great many people waiting for him, wanting to further develop relations with him.
A formation prodigy was really worth befriending.
Ling Han also observed people.
If he could get along with them, he would say a few more words.
If they couldn’t, he wouldn’t deliberately offend them either.
He just couldn’t be bothered to deal with them.
Once he spoke less, they would know what he was doing, and wouldn’t take the initiative to be rebuffed.
A few days later, someone issued a bounty.
Whoever could kill Ling Han would be able to obtain a thousand Dao Stones.
When Ling Han received the news, he was extremely surprised.
How was he supposed to receive this bounty?
He didn’t even know who the person who issued the bounty was.
“You’re actually curious about this?” Princess Bixiao didn’t know whether to laugh or cry.
Shouldn’t you be more concerned about who issued the bounty and how to deal with possible assassins?
Ling Han smiled faintly, and said, “It’s most likely a bounty issued by Hou Qingbai.
I’m thinking, if others really succeed and go to him to collect the bounty, what if he doesn’t admit it?”
Princess Bixiao was rendered speechless.
Ling Han soon found out that this bounty wasn’t a joke.
Though the galaxy was huge, after so many years of development, aside from the boundless and distant edges of the universe, the whole galaxy was actually already connected.
The internal structure of the planet was through the Wide Star Vine, while the connection between planets was through spatial nodes.

On the planets where martial arts were developing normally, many people would buy connectors to connect to the colossal Galaxy Network, and find out in real time what major events were happening in the galaxy.
It was said that this Galaxy Network was constructed by an Ancestral King in the ancient times, who had used great power to open up spatial nodes one after another.
After the Galaxy Network was constructed, a kind of virtual currency was also created, and that was Universe Coins.
The Universe Coins were linked to the Dao Stones, and the exchange rate was one to one.
Meanwhile, the stability of the Universe Coins was maintained by the Ancestral King-level force that had built the Galaxy Network.
They had a large number of Dao Stones in their possession, and it was guaranteed that the Universe Coins could be exchanged for Dao Stones.
With such a foundation, interstellar trading became possible.
The bounty for Ling Han was posted on the Galaxy Network.

Whoever killed Ling Han and uploaded the image of Ling Han’s death would be recognized by this platform, and the 1000 Universe Coins that the person who had posted the bounty had previously written off would be directly recorded into his account.
—Previously, the internet platform of the Dark North Nation was the model of the Galaxy Network.

However, at that time, there was no Wide Star Vine, so they had to rely on the help of satellites, light cables, and so Chen Fengyan, as an “ancient person” from more than 2000 years ago, definitely knew about the Galaxy Network.
“Yi, there’s actually such a good thing?” Ling Han was surprised.
Unfortunately, he didn’t have a connection device, and couldn’t connect to the Galaxy Network.
However, there were many extraterrestrial visitors here, so he could borrow them.
Ling Han used someone else’s connection device to log into the Galaxy Network, and instantly, an incredibly vast world appeared in front of him.
Before this, he was like a frog at the bottom of a well, and the things he could come into contact with were extremely barren.

“Hehe, as long as you have enough Universe Coins, you can also buy cultivation techniques, pill recipes, formation techniques.” Ling Han nodded, “If you want to obtain Universe Coins, the fastest way would be to obtain the Charging Stone, and there are charging points set up by the Chang Clan on many planets.
The Chang Clan was the descendant of that Ancestral King that had constructed the Galaxy Network.
With such a colossal network in their grasp, after countless years, the wealth and power of the Chang Clan must have reached a terrifying extent.
Unfortunately, even with such astonishing resources, the Chang Clan was still unable to produce a second Ancestral King.
The difficulty of the Imperial Path could be imagined.
“However, firstly, the Dao Stones in my possession are limited, and secondly, there are no charging points on the Celestial Sea Planet.”
“Then, I can only earn Universe Coins first.”
“I can auction off the Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill, and have someone transfer money to me through the Galaxy Network…
Oh, no wonder someone asked me for an account number when I was selling ingredients.”
“I don’t have an account number, but Lin Xiu should have one.
Let’s just leave the money with him first.”
“En, I’ll ask him tomorrow what his account is called.”
Ling Han swept his gaze over it.
Pill recipes were extremely expensive.
The cheapest Celestial level pill recipe was at least 500 Dao Stones.
Furthermore, pill recipes were unique.
In other words, after you obtained a new pill recipe, you could apply for a proprietary application on the Galaxy Network.
Even if others bought this pill recipe from you, they would not be allowed to sell it on the Galaxy Network.
It was the same for cultivation techniques and formation techniques, protecting the fruits of labour of the creator as much as possible.
Of course, for the Chang Clan, they could read all the cultivation techniques, pill recipes, formations, and so on, of the world, without paying any price at all.
Thus, it would be difficult for the Chang Clan to not be strong.

chapters.title: Chapter 3705: Super genius
paragraphs: Chapter 3705: Super genius
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations
With so many resources, how could there be no one envious?
There definitely was.
But what kind of existence was the Chang Clan?
Having once produced an Ancestral King, and having an Ancestral Weapon as overseer, this could guarantee the fortune for millions and millions of years!
-Without the appearance of the Great Emperor, the ancestral weapon would be invincible, and even Saints would have to bow their heads in submission.
The Chang Clan was naturally eternally prosperous.

In the circle of Great Emperors, there was an unwritten rule. As long as Great Emperor-level forces did not seek death themselves, and angered an existing Great Emperor, the Great Emperor would not deliberately target them either.
This was because the Great Emperor was not indestructible. How could it be that he was not worried that after his death, another Great Emperor would similarly destroy his force?
On the other hand, this was also a show of respect to his predecessors. Which one of those who could become a Great Emperor did not have outstanding bearing and was peerless in the world?
There could only be one in a single era!
Ling Han sighed ruefully, and began to search again. Then, he discovered another source of income.
And that was to fight on the martial arts ring, and make bets.
In the Galaxy Network, two people’s wills could take form and engage in battle.

It could be a battle at the same cultivation level, or it could be a battle where there was a gap of a few cultivation levels between them. It could be a one-on- one battle, a one-on-many battle, or a group battle. There were various methods, and it was up to the individual to choose.
This was called Galaxy Network Tournament.
In this place, one could fight with others, place bets, or not place bets.
However, those who used the Galaxy Network Tournament would have to pay
0.1 Universe Coins each time.

If they didn’t fight, they could also participate in the ranking battles. If they could rank in the top 1000 at a certain cultivation level, they would be recognized as a prodigy by the entire universe.

That was because practically everyone in the entire universe was connected to this network. To be able to rank in the top 1000 among such a colossal number of cultivators, on average, not even one in a galaxy would be able to do so.

For example, in the Centaur Galaxy, where Celestial Sea Planet belonged, not one person made it into any of the leaderboards-the Foundation Building List, the Cauldron Forging List, the Core Formation List, and so on were all zero. Thus, in terms of the entire universe, the Centaur Galaxy was definitely not ranked. They did not have super elites in the higher cultivation levels, and there weren’t any stunning rising stars that could hold up the skies of the future among the lower cultivation levels either.

If one could make it into the leaderboard, such as the Foundation Building Tier List, they would immediately be able to obtain 1000 Universe Coins, and every year after that, the platform would distribute 1000 Dao Stones as rewards – if they dropped out of the leaderboard, that would naturally be gone.
To the super genius, 1000 Dao Stones naturally wasn’t much. However, the most important thing was the ranking itself. This was a great honor.

Aside from that, there were also various records. If one could break these records, they would similarly be rewarded with Universe Coins, and this kind of glory was even more dazzling, because there were many people on the leaderboard, but what about the record holder?
There was only a single name for each record, and there was no second place.

However, after so many years, the records were also becoming harder and harder to break. This meant that he had to surpass all the prodigies within hundreds of millions of years or even tens of billions of years!
Just how difficult was it to break records?

However, what was astonishing was that there were actually people who broke records repeatedly among the Foundation Building Tier cultivators. Moreover, it wasn’t just one, but three. This was extremely inconceivable.
These three people did not reveal their real names, nor did they reveal their true identities. Instead, they appeared with code names.𝒇𝒓𝙚𝒆𝔀𝓮𝓫𝒏𝓸𝙫𝓮𝓵.𝓬𝙤𝙢
One was called Heaven Crushing, one was called Origin, and one was called
Myriad Dao.
All were very arrogant.

However, it was unknown whether they were male or female, age, or cultivation level, because even Saints could break the record of Foundation Building Tier. In any case, the Galaxy Network would suppress cultivation level. This was the power of the Ancestral King, and even Saints had to adhere to it. After experiencing eternity, every record should be unbreakable. Being able to break any one of them would be enough to shake the whole universe, but now, three of such top prodigies actually came out in one go?

Ling Han’s interest was suddenly piqued. He wanted to fight with these three people to see who was the number one elite of the Foundation Building Tier. Unfortunately, he was presently borrowing a connection device. Furthermore, even if he wanted to break records, he would use a code name, and did not want to become the target of all.

-Even Emperor-level forces would probably recruit prodigies that could break records, right? Then, if he encountered someone more overbearing, and if they were rejected, they would move to erase him. Wasn’t that just causing trouble for himself?
Thus, Ling Han definitely had to get a connection device that belonged to him first.
He returned the connecting device, and on the second day, returned to the Imperial Capital, so that Tang Yun’er could make a trip to buy a connecting device for him.

“Huh? Ugly, you also know of the connector?” The little girl licked the toffee and said, “Unfortunately, I’m still young, and my cultivation level isn’t high enough. My Spiritual Power isn’t strong enough, so I can’t use the connection device.”

Ling Han’s expression darkened, “When did I become Ugly? “Compared to Sister LuanXing, you’re naturally ugly!” Tang Yun’er said confidently. “Sigh, how can someone as ugly as you be worthy of Sister Luan Xing? If I were you, I’d knock myself to death to avoid tainting Sister Luan Xing.”

“Cut the crap and run errands for me,” Ling Han said in irritation. At first, he had still felt slightly apologetic, asking the little girl to run around for a few months, but now, he could only feel irritated and tempted to slap this little girl’s behind.
“I’m not going! I’m going to accompany Big Sister!” the little loli said with a humph. She wasn’t afraid of Ling Han.
“Go immediately.” The empress’s soft voice rang out.
“Yes, Big Sister.” The little loli immediately stood up, and could not be more obedient

In order to intimidate these rascals, the empress had to be the one to do it. You see, even the seven babies were very obedient towards the empress. Of course, they were even more familiar with Hu Niu. After all, they were on the same “age” level.

Ling Han was worried, so he had the Second Baby follow Tang Yun’er. In any case, the babies didn’t need to cultivate anyways, so they didn’t need to worry about wasting time traveling through the galaxy.
He returned to the entrance of the Mystery Realm, and continued to wait for the Mystery Realm to open.

With every passing day, Ling Han would concoct an additional cauldron of Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pills. After a few days, he also had a considerable amount of stock on hand. Considering his poverty, he asked Ling Han to help him sell off a few.
One pill for ten Dao Stones, and would be immediately sold out once it was taken out, making Ling Han feel rueful. Rare items were still best displayed through the auction method.

In these few days, he had become an esteemed guest of the extraterrestrial visitors. Every day, there would be people inviting him to the banquet, and they had only one purpose, and that was when the Mystery Realm opened, they hoped that Ling Han could join their team.

Ling Han wasn’t interested in forming a team with anyone. He politely declined, but expressed that after entering into the Mystery Realm, he could cooperate if he had the chance. He didn’t go all out on his words.

The assassination of Ling Han was not carried out, because the five great Spirit Transformation Tier elites had all spoken, forbidding a bloody battle from taking place here. Killing people was naturally even more forbidden. At present, no one dared to commit a crime openly.
However, once the Mystery Realm opened, the situation would be different. Even the Spiritual Transformation True Lords wouldn’t be able to control it. Ling Han was completely unconcerned about this.
In a battle of equal cultivation levels, who would be killing whom? In any case, the one who would die would definitely not be him.
He did not mind using this chance to pretend to be a pig to eat a tiger, and instead, make a fortune out of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 3706: Moon Occult Mystery Realm opens
paragraphs: Chapter 3706: Moon Occult Mystery Realm opens
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations

However, those extraterrestrial prodigies had paid an exorbitant price to come here, and that was not for the sake of doing business. They just happened to have some treasures that they had no use for, and could use this opportunity to trade.
Thus, after a few days, the marketplace became quiet. There were many people walking around, and few people selling. Later, almost all of them were just looking around.

Lin Xiu also closed his stall. He planned to sell the medicinal ingredients to Ling Han, because he had seen Ling Han’s prodigious talent in alchemy. Though the latter presently could only concoct one kind of alchemical pill, the future prospects were definitely boundless, and they could work together on a long -term basis.
Most importantly, Lin Xiu also believed in Ling Han’s character.

The Moon Occult Mystery Realm didn’t open for a long time, but those who should come had already arrived, and they were all waiting nearby. Some people didn’t have much patience, fighting and causing trouble every day. Thankfully, they still didn’t dare to kill people due to the intimidation from the Spirit Transformation True Lords.
Just when Ling Han thought that he would wait until Tang Yun’er returned, the Moon Occult Mystery Realm suddenly opened.
Without the slightest sign, moonlight gushed out, like a spring.

Everyone ran out one after another to take a look, and saw that the place where the pillar of light had shot out previously was already enveloped by endless moonlight. Occasionally, it would surge out towards the surroundings, which was both magnificent and grand.
“The Moon Occult Mystery Realm has opened!”
Xiu, a figure flew over, standing proudly in the skies, exuding a powerful aura.
The Nine Spirits True Lord!

Xiu, xiu, xiu! More figures flew over, but there were pitifully few people that could stand quietly in the skies. This required the cultivation level of Celestial Sea Planet, at least, and among the natives of the Celestial Sea Planet, only Chen Fengyan met the standards. The others all came from the prison.
The problem was, no matter how big the prison was, how many people could there be?

Thus, there were only a few hundred people standing in the sky at this moment. Compared to the other planets, where tens of thousands would appear at the drop of a hat, this number was naturally pitifully small.
No wonder those extraterrestrial visitors looked down on the Celestial Sea Planet. In terms of abilities, the Celestial Sea Planet was as weak as could be. “Work hard, go on.”
Don t retreat in the face of difficulties. You have to advance bravely.”
Those elites all began to instruct their heirs. Very few people said that they had to be more careful, but rather encouraged them to take risks.
For the sake of obtaining the inheritance of the Saint, wasn’t that natural?
At this time, in order to make the best use of their time, everyone entered into the area that was enshrouded by the moonlight.
Ling Han carried the Sixth Baby in his arms, and also headed there. Meanwhile, Princess Bixiao followed closely behind him.
He could clearly feel that there were a great many people’s eyes focused on him. Some were very obscure, while there were some that did not hide their killing intent at all.

These people might not take a thousand Dao Stones to heart, but wasn’t snatching treasures and killing people in a Mystery Realm a matter of course? Thus, they would eliminate a competitor and earn some Dao Stones while they were at it, so why not?

After all, this time, there were still no prodigies on the level of Dao Child and Holy Daughter. Even if they were the key heirs of major sects, the cultivation resources they could obtain were still limited. A thousand Dao Stones was relatively a considerable amount of wealth.
As for why no prodigies on the level of Dao Child and Holy Daughter had come, was it because those great sects were actually not optimistic that they would be able to gain anything?

True, this Mystery Realm had existed for tens of thousands of years. In the past, there must have been true prodigies that had come here before, and none of them had passed the test. As time passed, those great sects could no longer be bothered to let the top prodigies come here to waste their time.
Thus, these inferior prodigies replaced them. It was fine even if they couldn’t obtain the inheritance of the Saint. At the very least, they could still gain some experience.
Was that really the case?
Ling Han thought internally, yet his steps did not slow down in the slightest. In the ancient site, he was not afraid of anyone targeting him. Worse come to worst, he would just get into a fight.
Speaking of fighting, who would he be afraid of among his peers?
When Ling Han entered into the moonlight, a mysterious power surged, extraordinarily majestic.
“En, this is the power of Transfer!”

At present, Ling Han was deeply versed in formation techniques. Though the number of formations he could lay out was limited, he already had no lack of understanding of formation techniques, so it was naturally not the slightest bit difficult for him to judge the type of formation technique.
This Mystery Realmdefinitely isn’t underground. In fact, it’s not actually on the Celestial Sea Planet, but rather on the fragments of the ancient Celestial Sea Planet.”
Ling Han took a few more steps, and the moonlight that filled the skies had already disappeared. A desolate plain appeared ahead of him, and when he raised his head, the galaxy was different.
“As expected, this is definitely not Celestial Sea Planet. Otherwise, there would not have been such a massive deviation in the position of the stars.”
“Yi, where is this?” Princess Bixiao also walked in. She looked at the skies in surprise.
“We should have already left Celestial Sea Planet,” Ling Han said in a solemn voice.
Princess Bixiao frowned, and said, “If this is in the galaxy, why hasn’t anyone discovered it all these years?”
This was a problem. Though the galaxy was colossal, after innumerable years, those galactic scout ships that explored for mineral ore and medicinal planets would have discovered this place, right?

Sixth Baby giggled, and also leaped out of Ling Han’s arms, greeting Zhuang

In this palm strike, he was very measured in his movements, and his power was very gentle.
However, when his palm struck out, he was shocked, and suddenly came to his senses. The entry conditions here were Foundation Building Tier cultivators.
Thus, this baby was a Foundation Building Tier cultivator!
F***, a Foundation Building Tier cultivator that was only two to three years old, what the heck was that?
However, it was already too late for him to change his move. Sixth Baby was surging over with terrifying power, as if she could destroy a planet.
She was born with a Divine Physique, and her battle prowess far surpassed that of ordinary Human Dao Foundation.

Thankfully, Sixth Baby was more proficient in stealth and penetration, and not in strengthening her attacks. If it was Eldest Baby, then once this freakishly violent maniac showed her might, her destructive power would be several times stronger.
Peng! The attack landed, and Zhuang Bufan screamed in pain as he was sent flying.
Sixth Baby clapped her hands, turned her head and smiled, saying childishly,
“Done and dealt with.”
Ling Han nodded, “Let’s go.”

This Zhuang Bufan could only be considered a child. Furthermore, when he had faced off against Sixth Baby just now, he had deliberately used gentle force. For the sake of this, he had no intention of killing him.

“You wet-behind-the-ears brat, are you asking for a beating?” Sixth Baby pointed at Zhuang Bufan and said, “Aren’t you afraid of being struck by lightning for showing off so much?”

this little girl was not outdone either.

Ling Han smiled faintly, and spread open his right hand. Then, he retracted his hand, and he had already taken all the Sword Qi into his palm.

Zhuang Bufan was rendered speechless. Was this the gulf between their abilities? This was far too great!

“I am no match for you,” he said honestly, his face filled with disappointment. Previously, his opinion of himself had been too high. Thus, when he saw that there was such a wide gap between himself and Ling Han, he was naturally extremely disappointed.

“Could it be that you’re a Heavenly Dao Foundation cultivator, or even an Ultimate Dao Foundation Building cultivator?” Zhuang Bufan’s eyes lit up. He had just entered the Foundation Building Tier, so it was naturally very normal for him to be no match for a Heavenly Dao Foundation prodigy.

You call this comforting?
“lam invincible among my peers, so there is no need for you to take it to heart,” Ling Han continued.
Zhuang Bufan glanced at Ling Han, and felt frustrated.
‘You’re the expert of showing off! Who dares to say that they re invincible among their peers?’
“In a battle of equal cultivation levels, you will definitely be no match for my brother!” he said forcefully, as if he too wanted to make himself believe it firmly.
“Oh?” Ling Han smiled sheepishly.
“My older brother is ranked 88,000th in the Galaxy Network Tournament!” Zhuang Bufan declared proudly.
Pu!
Ling Han couldn’t help but splutter with laughter. It is 88,000th, so what was there to be proud of?
However, his smile quickly disappeared, because Zhuang Bufan was presently looking at him plaintively.

“This is indeed very extraordinary,” Princess Bixiao interjected, “The Galaxy Network Tournament includes practically all the cultivators in the entire universe. Those that can make it into the leaderboard are all super geniuses that have surpassed an entire galaxy.”

“That’s right!” Zhuang Bufan felt like he had finally met someone who understood him. “Don’t think that my older brother’s ranking is low. Though he is ranked in the 80,000s, in the Centaur Galaxy, he is still a top-notch existence, and is also ranked the highest in our Bright Foundation Planet.” Ling Han gave an ‘oh’, and asked, “Your brother is in the Foundation Building Tier?”

“Humph, my older brother is only twenty-nine years old this year, and is already a Cauldron Forging Tier elite!” Zhuang Bufan declared proudly. Ling Han smacked him on the back of the head, and said, “You’re just a child. Don’t speak in such an old-fashioned manner.”
Zhuang Bufan clutched his head, and looked towards Princess Bixiao. He hoped that this beautiful big sister could deal with Ling Han, so that he would not always treat him like a child.
Unfortunately, how could Princess Bixiao possibly help him?
“Cauldron Forging Tier… then I can’t fight at the same cultivation level. However, when I connect to the Galaxy Network in the future, I can spar with him,” Ling Han murmured to himself.
“You are definitely no match for my brother.” Zhuang Bufan had a kind of blind admiration for his own brother.
“What’s your brother’s name? In future, I’ll go up and challenge him to a battle,” Ling Han said with a smile.
” Zhuang Feif an!”
Ling Han couldn’t help but glance at him. “I’ve discovered that your clansmen are all quite shameless.?”
One was Feifan, while the other was Bufan. This was practically extraordinary. “You’re the shameless one!” Zhuang Bufan shouted loudly. He naturally had to defend the pride of his clan.
“Come, become my underling,” Ling Han suddenly thought.

paragraphs: Chapter 3708: Ancient battlefield
Translator: Henyee Translations . Editor: Henyee Translations
Though Zhuang Bufan’s name exuded a strong air of posturing, to be able to become a Foundation Building cultivator at sixteen years old, his talent was indeed not just for show.
Of course, he couldn’t compare to the seven babies. They had grown from a gourd vine.
“I don’t want to be your underling!” Zhuang Bufan objected loudly.
“Heh, you’ll definitely agree,” Ling Han said with a chuckle. There was a hint of evil in his eyes.
“You, what do you want to do?” Zhuang Bufan’s heart clenched.
Ling Han broke into a smile, sunny and harmonious, “lam going to hang you from a tree, take off your pants and spank your behind.”
Zhuang Bufan’s breathing instantly stopped. This was too vicious; how could he treat him like this?
“How about it?” Ling Han patted Zhuang Bufan’s shoulder, “Are you going to be my lackey or not?”
“… I will,” Zhuang Bufan forced out through gritted teeth. If he was really to be beaten naked, he would really go crazy.
“Then what should you call me?” Ling Han patiently coaxed.
“Boss,” Zhuang Bufan whispered.
“What?”
“Boss!” This time, his voice was much louder.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “I was just joking with you just now. How could an upright person like me possibly do something like hang someone from a tree, take off his pants, and spank his behind?”
When these words fell, Princess Bixiao, Sixth Baby, and Zhuang Bufan all complained at the same time.
You can do it, definitely.
Ling Han blinked his eyes. Since when had his credibility become so poor that
even a kid like Sixth Baby would complain about him?
Forget it, who cares.
Ling Han had taken in a lackey, so he was in a good mood. He borrowed Zhuang Bufan’s connection device, but was unable to connect to the Galaxy Network.

Ling Han patted his shoulder and said, “Come, say it again.

“My cultivation level is too low, after all. If I were to face a three-star or even four-star genius of Ultimate Dao Foundation, unless I use the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, it would be very difficult to match.”

a headache.”

In this exchange, the two of them were evenly matched.

chapters.title: Chapter 3709: Kill one as a warning to a hundred others
paragraphs: Chapter 3709: Kill one as a warning to a hundred others
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations

The blue-robed middle-aged man charged over, and once again stretched out a hand to deliver a palm strike at Ling Han. Boom, this time, multiple golden patterns appeared in the force, and there was an aura that surpassed Foundation Building Tier.
He was at the Cauldron Forging Tier.

Though this place suppressed cultivation level, when a Cauldron Forging Tier was here, the power he could unleash was only Foundation Building Tier peak stage. However, Cauldron Forging Tier was still Cauldron Forging Tier, after all, so it still had some advantages. For example, he could use the Celestial Cauldron that he had formed inside his body.
This aura was the Celestial Cauldron showing its might, forming an aura that surpassed the Foundation Building Tier, and could effectively suppress the Foundation Building Tier.

If this aura were in the outside world, 90% of the Foundation Building Tier cultivators would lose their battle prowess once they unleashed this aura. This was the suppression of the level of being. It was like a wolf that had encountered a tiger, and could only tremble in fear.

This place suppressed cultivation level, so the might of the Celestial Cauldron wasn’t as great. However, it still had a certain amount of deterrence power against Foundation Building cultivators. At the very least, it could reduce the battle prowess of Foundation Building cultivators by 20-30%.
This was also why the middle-aged man in blue dared to attack Ling Han.
Ling Han nodded, and said, “You’re from the prison, right?”
As he spoke, he replied with a punch of his own. His aura was steady, and was completely unaffected by the Celestial Cauldron.

Just how terrifying was the foundation stone of the Celestial Path that he had built? Even the heavens would unleash their might to erase it, so how could it possibly be suppressed by a mere Celestial Cauldron?
It could be said that while a Saint’s aura could easily kill Ling Han, but even if the Great Emperor appeared, Ling Han still wouldn’t yield.
That was because his Celestial Foundation was incredibly sturdy, and no one could hope to shake it.
Boom!
The two of them exchanged blows again, and it was still a tie.
The blue-robed middle-aged man revealed an expression of confusion and shock. Ling Han was actually unaffected by his Celestial Cauldron, and his battle prowess hadn’t weakened in the slightest?
It was too strange.

The Celestial Cauldron’s pressure on Human Dao Foundation was the greatest, followed by the Heavenly Dao Foundation, and if it was an Ultimate Dao Foundation, the effects would be very small.𝓯𝙧𝙚𝒆𝙬𝙚𝒃𝙣𝙤𝒗𝓮𝓵.𝙘𝙤𝙢
But no matter how small it was, it would still have an effect. How could it possibly be like how Ling Han was completely unscathed?

He forcefully suppressed his shock, and said calmly, “That’s right. I come from the prison, and in my eyes, you’re nothing but trash. If it weren’t for Chen Fengyan protecting you, would you dare to strut around in front of us?” “You’re wearing some rare treasure, aren’t you? You’re actually unaffected by the Celestial Cauldron!” he couldn’t help but ask.
When these words were said, the people in the ancient battlefield all looked tempted.
A rare treasure that could resist the Celestial Cauldron’s oppressive might? That was really too practical.

To say nothing of this place, if they encountered a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator after they left, that would be equivalent to having an additional chance of escaping. That was because the moment the Celestial Cauldron appeared, it would directly suppress the essence of life. Foundation Building Tier cultivators might feel their knees go weak, and not even be able to think of running for their lives.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t say that this was because his celestial foundation was based on the ancient Celestial Gate, which even the heavens envied, so it was naturally awesome.

“I’ll send you on your way!” he said solemnly. His figure charged out, and the Demonic Monkey Fists was unleashed. His fists were wrapped with the Heavenly Dao Flames, and with the combined attacks of 108 overlapping layers of power, just how terrifying was the power of this combination punch?
Boom, boom, boom, punch after punch, incinerating the heavens and obliterating the earth.

The blue-robed middle-aged man’s advantage was all in the Celestial Cauldron, but the suppression of his cultivation level was completely ineffective. In truth, he was no different from an ordinary Ultimate Dao Foundation. Under Ling Han’s powerful suppression, his disadvantage was extremely great.
In this perilous situation, he felt extreme regret. If he had known earlier, he wouldn’t have jumped out.
“Do you regret it now?” Ling Han asked calmly. “Unfortunately, it’s too late!”

Faced with such ridicule, the middle-aged man in blue couldn’t help but blush. However, his life was in danger, so how could he still care about his pride? He hurriedly said, “Stop! Stop! I’ll immediately surrender to the Dark North Nation. You can’t kill me!”

Ling Han sneered, “Unfortunately, I am not the Department Chief of the Foreign Affairs Department of the Dark North Nation now. I am just an ordinary adventurer. Whoever wants to kill me, I will destroy them. Even if the Heavenly King comes, it would be useless!”
He attacked aggressively, and in just a few moves, the blue-robed middle-aged man was blasted into smithereens.

Seeing this scene, everyone shook their heads. Presumably, even if the man in blue died, he would be filled with regret, right? If it was in the outside world, it would only be a matter of a single thought for him to kill Ling Han, but now, he had been killed by Ling Han instead.
Adventuring in the Mystery Realm was just that dangerous. Those with higher cultivation levels could also die in the hands of those with lower cultivation levels.
Ling Han swept an eye over the surrounding people, and asked, “Who else wants my head?”

Everyone acted as if they had not heard him, and went off to do their own things. If they nodded, that would be equivalent to making an enemy of Ling Han. That was definitely not allowed, but if they shook their heads, that would be equivalent to bowing their heads to Ling Han. They could not bring themselves to do so, so they could only pretend that they had not heard anything.
Ling Han walked in the ancient battlefield. The sunlight was clearly dazzling, but because there were bones all over the ground, it gave off a sinister feeling.
He also looked at the Battle Armors and weapons, and shook his head. They were all in tatters, and could not be used at all.
Continuing onwards, Ling Han wanted to see what lay at the end of this ancient battlefield.
He quickened his pace, yet gave a muffled humph, and immediately stopped.
Ling Han lowered his head to take a look. There were a few more rips on his clothes. Those had been torn open by the air after he had just sped up.
How could the air possess such terrifying destructive power?

As Ling Han walked, he secretly experienced it, and enlightenment rose up in his heart. It was not the sharpness of the air, but rather that there was a kind of killing intent in the air. If one rubbed against it intensely, it would cause a very great destructive effect.

He activated the Starlight Screen and slowly sped up. However, he was only able to reach double the speed of sound, and he had already reached his limit. It was as if there were countless invisible blades in the air, and in an instant, the Starlight Screen was torn apart.
Ling Han slowed down slightly. The Starlight Screen’s energy consumption was coincidentally equal to his rate of recovery, so he was able to maintain the effects of the Starlight Screen at all times.
Soon, the sun set in the west, and the sky began to darken.

It was unknown which corner of the galaxy this was. Though the sun could be seen, the moon did not exist. Thus, when the sun had disappeared from the horizon, the whole world had instantly become dark, with only stars scattered here and there, exuding a faint brilliance.
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han suddenly stopped in his tracks. He could sense a strange aura.
However, the surroundings were completely silent, so how could there be anything strange?
Ling Han trusted his instincts very much. He activated his eye technique and looked around again.

After advancing into Celestial Path, his eye technique had also improved astonishingly, being able to see through all illusions, and see through the fine details, immediately discovering what was strange.
In the heaven and earth, multiple auras rose, like smoke.
Ka, a soft sound rang out. If Ling Han hadn’t been completely focused, it was very likely that he wouldn’t have heard it, and even if he had heard it, he might have directly overlooked it.
But now, he activated his eye technique and looked in that direction.

A shocking scene appeared. A corpse was slowly getting up. It had one leg broken, but it was still supported by a rusted saber. It stood up with its other leg. Weng, two balls of dark flames popped up in its eye sockets.
Er, he had to be seeing things.
