Soon, the sun set in the west, and the sky began to darken.
It was unknown which corner of the galaxy this was.
Though the sun could be seen, the moon did not exist.
Thus, when the sun had disappeared from the horizon, the whole world had instantly become dark, with only stars scattered here and there, exuding a faint brilliance.
‘Hmm?’
Ling Han suddenly stopped in his tracks.
He could sense a strange aura.
However, the surroundings were completely silent, so how could there be anything strange?
Ling Han trusted his instincts very much.
He activated his eye technique and looked around again.

After advancing into Celestial Path, his eye technique had also improved astonishingly, being able to see through all illusions, and see through the fine details, immediately discovering what was strange.
In the heaven and earth, multiple auras rose, like smoke.
Ka, a soft sound rang out.
If Ling Han hadn’t been completely focused, it was very likely that he wouldn’t have heard it, and even if he had heard it, he might have directly overlooked it.
But now, he activated his eye technique and looked in that direction.
A shocking scene appeared.
A corpse was slowly getting up.
It had one leg broken, but it was still supported by a rusted saber.
It stood up with its other leg.
Weng, two balls of dark flames popped up in its eye sockets.
Er, he had to be seeing things.

chapters.title: Chapter 3710: Bloody battle of corpses
paragraphs: Chapter 3710: Bloody battle of corpses
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations
A corpse that had been dead for who knew how many years suddenly stood up again.
Was it haunted? Or was there an indescribable power supporting this place, allowing the dead to rise again?
Ling Han preferred the latter option. He didn’t sense any spiritual fluctuation, so this wreckage should have crawled up under the influence of some kind of power.
Ka, ka, ka! The sounds were endless, and countless corpses were crawling up on their own. Some were even wearing tattered Battle Armors, and green flames were flickering in their eye sockets.
These corpses all set their eyes on Ling Han, and pointed the weapons in their hands at him. Their killing intent blazed, as if it was solid.

Boom, not too far away, the ground split apart, and a rider appeared. Beneath him was a skeletal warhorse that was as tall as nine meters, and this rider was not much better off either. All that was left of him was bone, though there was still a part of his body that was wrapped in the damaged armour.

But even so, this skeletal knight was still exuding a powerful aura. The fierce aura seemed to have solidified, and entwined around the battle spear in his hands. It was as if even if the heavens came down on him, he would still be able to pierce through with a single spear strike.
“Charge!” This skeleton rider released a cold voice, and instantly, the army of corpses rushed towards Ling Han.

Ling Han unleashed a murderous aura, yet it was completely ineffective. These Corpse Soldiers were all inanimate objects, and had no souls. They could move completely because they were being controlled by an unknown power. Thus, the barrage of murderous aura was naturally ineffective against them.
Then let’s switch tactics.
“An!” Ling Han shouted, and the Six Characters Bright King Curse was activated.
The Buddhist chant was vast and mighty, but it still did not have the slightest effect.
This confirmed Ling Han’s thoughts. Though the army of corpses looked frightening, they were not vengeful ghosts, so the Buddhist chant was also ineffective against them.
Boom, the army of corpses charged over, and a dense wave of Saber Qi and
Sword Qi shot over.
Ling Han activated his Starlight Screen. Peng, peng, peng! The shockwaves were all blocked.
However, with such a barrage of attacks, the Starlight Screen was more or less exhausted. It only needed another casual attack, and it would definitely shatter.

Ling Han naturally wouldn’t sit still and wait for death. No matter how confident he was, he couldn’t possibly stay where he was like an idiot and be bombarded by so many corpses. In that case, no matter how strong he was, he would still be blasted into smithereens.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! He used his movement technique and leaped out of the encirclement. However, there were corpses everywhere here. No matter where Ling Han ran, all he could do was battle.
Then let’s battle.
Ling Han let out a battle cry, and attacked in quick succession. The Demonic Monkey Fists was activated, and he was incredibly powerful.

These army of corpses all possessed the strength to build foundations of human Dao. The might of their combined attacks was incredibly frightening, but their defenses were considerably weak. Even if they were only scraped by the aftermath of Ling Han’s punch, their bones still flew, and they immediately fell apart.

Boom, his present strength was incomparably frightening. As he shot out a punch, the force of his punch could reach as far as three hundred meters, yet still maintain a powerful destructive power. With a single punch, a large area would be emptied out ahead of him.
He was extraordinarily fierce and domineering, his battle prowess terrifying, and the army of corpses was superior in numbers. It was as if there was no end to it, as they endlessly charged over.
These skeleton soldiers had no emotions, knew no pain, and only knew to battle. This made them terrifying killing machines. More importantly, there were too many of them.𝐟𝐫𝕖𝗲𝘄𝚎𝗯𝕟𝐨𝕧𝐞𝚕.𝕔𝕠𝐦
Just how big was this ancient battlefield?
They were all corpses, and now all of them had gotten back to their feet. There was no end in sight. How long would he have to continue fighting?
If it was another person, they would definitely be fighting and retreating at the same time, wanting to leave this ancient battlefield, because there was a limit to a man’s power.
However, Ling Han didn’t retreat.

In terms of power alone, he could only rival those at the peak stage of the Ultimate Dao Foundation, but in terms of the reserves of mystical power, he could completely challenge the Spirit Transformation True Lord or even Sect Master. It couldn’t be helped. Who asked him to have innumerable dimensions inside his body that had all become his Mystery Realms?
Fight, fight, fight.
Hong, hong, hong! Ever since Ling Han had advanced into Celestial Path, he had never battled to his heart’s content like this, which made him feel very pleased.

In truth, he was completely capable of summoning the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. This was the embryonic form of an Imperial Weapon, and the strength of the defense of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower would probably need the combined attacks of several Ultimate Dao Foundations to be able to break through it. The attacks of Human Dao Foundation were completely negligible.
But now, Ling Han only wanted to battle, and wanted to use his fists to pacify everything.
If he could avoid relying on external power, then he should avoid relying on external power. This was the same even if it was his own Spirit Tool.

The intensity of this battle was extremely high. If it was another Foundation Building cultivator, even if it was the Ultimate Dao Foundation cultivator, he would be exhausted after two to three hours, at most. However, this did not apply at all to Ling Han. He had endless power, and was completely capable of battling at this kind of intensity for a few months.
Of course, it was one thing for the mystical power to last, but one also had to take into account the limits of the body’s burden. A few months was too much, but a few days was no problem at all.
After a night of hard fighting, at dawn, the first ray of sunlight appeared, illuminating the ground.
instantly, the corpses that had just been incredibly fierce seemed to have lost their motivation all of a sudden. They all fell to the ground, and became dead again.
It was dawn.
Ling Han looked at the dazzling sunlight, thinking that these corpses should only move at night, but what was the meaning of their existence?
Yi?
He was startled, and saw a streak of light enshroud him. Then, it left a mark on his wrist, and disappeared with a flash.
Why did they all like to do this?

Ling Han touched his wrist; he had been given a stamp again. Was this very fun? They might as well directly give him some benefits, such as allowing his cultivation level to leap greatly. This was the practical thing.

He sat down in a cross-legged position, planning to cultivate, but he immediately discovered that this power of heaven and earth was extraordinarily weak. It was not enough to support his cultivation at all. It could only help him recover mystical power.
This was because… the ground beneath their feet was not a planet, but only a shard of a planet. Could it only be considered a larger meteorite?
Ling Han still ingested an Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill. Since he couldn’t rely on the power of heaven and earth, he could only rely on the alchemical pill.

He used the Great Sun Lotus Technique to stimulate the medicinal effects, and the effects of the Silver Dragon Fish were also taking effect. Thus, even without the help of the power of heaven and earth, Ling Han’s cultivation level was also rapidly improving, and his Human Dao Foundation Stone was becoming stronger and stronger.
In the beginning, this was only the size of a soybean, but now, it was already slightly larger than a human head.

This could be considered a Spiritual Power Spirit Tool. It could shrink in size, but its weight was extremely light. Thus, even if it was used for attack, the effects were completely incomparable to a Spiritual Power Spirit Tool. Ordinarily, the limit of the foundation stone of Human Dao was the size of a manhole cover. Going by this calculation, Ling Han would probably be able to reach the end of Human Dao Foundation after cultivating for a few more months.
However, he wasn’t an ordinary Foundation Building Tier cultivator. Thus, it was unknown to what extent his Human Dao Foundation Stone could reach.
He thought for a moment, then decided to retreat first, and meet up with Sixth Baby, Princess Bixiao, and Zhuang Bufan. Then, he would return here, and continue to challenge this ancient battlefield.

chapters.title: Chapter 3711: Top 290,000 on the Galaxy Network
paragraphs: Chapter 3711: Top 290,000 on the Galaxy Network
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations𝘧𝓇ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝘣𝓃ℴ𝓋𝑒𝑙.𝑐𝘰𝑚
Ling Han returned to the place where he had split up with Princess Bixiao and
Sixth Baby. Not long after, he saw Princess Bixiao and Sixth Baby appear, but Princess Bixiao wasn’t alone. Instead, there was an imposing-looking young man beside her.
Yi?
“Who are you?” Without waiting for Ling Han to begin, the young man shouted at Ling Han, his tone extremely harsh, filled with animosity towards Ling Han.

Ling Han immediately understood. That person had encountered Princess Bixiao when she had been travelling alone. He had probably been astounded by her divine beauty, and had thus followed Princess Bixiao all this while. Now that he had seen her having a “secret rendezvous” with a man like him, he was naturally burning with jealousy.
“None of your business,” he stated calmly.

“Oh, I know. You’re the guy who has a bounty placed on your head. Your name is Ling something.” The young man very quickly recognized Ling Han’s identity. He humphed, “I don’t want to kill a nameless pawn like you, and others will think that I covet that tiny bit of Dao Stones. Get lost!”
“Shameless!” Sixth Baby said in a sweet voice. “Father, beat him up. Beat him so hard that even his mother doesn’t recognize him.”
Sigh, even Sixth Baby had become so violent.
Ling Han turned his head, and said seriously, “How many times have I taught
you? We have to convince others with virtue!”
Princess Bixiao couldn’t help but ridicule in her mind. ‘You’re using virtue to convince others? You couldn’t be more violent.1
The young man was enraged by Ling Han and Sixth Baby’s exchange, and he balefully said, “How dare you! You actually dare to act insolent in front of me, Zhan Hong! Do you know who I am?”
Ling Han smiled, “I do. Didn’t you say it yourself, that your name is Zhan Hong?”
That, that’s right.
Zhan Hong was taken aback, but he kept feeling like something was off?

“Did your parents call you Zhan Hong because they wanted you to make a name for yourself?” Sixth Baby asked?. “However, names are usually the opposite of the future. For example, if someone’s name is Changsheng, they usually won’t live forever, but rather die early.?”
This damn child, how could she speak like this?
Then if my name was Zhan Hong, then wouldn’t I achieve nothing at all?
Zhan Hong’s eyes were baleful, and he said darkly, There is no benefit in saying such words in front of me! For the sake of Lady Bixiao, I will be lenient, so get lost immediately!”
Ling Han smiled as he looked at Princess Bixiao, asking, “Do you know this idiot?”
Princess Bixiao spread her hands and said, “He’s the one who’s been following me all this while. I can’t get rid of him no matter what.”
This was also a clarification for Ling Han. ‘I have absolutely no intention of flirting with him.’

“B@stard!” Zhan Hong roared loudly, and charged towards Ling Han. He obviously did not have the simple idea of just giving Ling Han a good thrashing, instead, he had the intention of killing Ling Han. A blood-coloured long saber appeared in his hand, and he slashed out at Ling Han.
Shua, Saber Qi swept out unhindered, turning into a shrill rainbow, incredibly thick and long.
Ling Han activated the Celestial Crossing Finger and tapped out.
Peng!

The force of the finger collided with the Saber Qi, yet it was completely unable to block the Saber Qi, and was forcibly shattered. Furthermore, the Saber Qi still majestically slashed over, as if even if there was a Divine Metal fortress in front of it, it could still be broken through with a single strike.
A disdainful smile spread across Zhan Hong’s face. Just how powerful was he?
How could he be matched by a nameless nobody like Ling Han?
Peng, the Saber Qi struck, creating a brilliant light, as well as a great explosion of energy.
He was a dead man.
Zhan Hong thought. Even with such strength, he still dared to be insolent in front of him. He really did not know where his confidence came from.

However, when the energy surged out, he revealed an astounded expression, because Ling Han just happened to be standing there unscathed, and there was starlight flickering on his body, turning into something like a bell.
He didn’t die? Not only did he not die, he was completely unscathed.
Was that starlight activated by some kind of cultivation technique that Ling
Han had channelled, or was it activated by a precious tool?
Zhan Hong immediately regained his composure. So what if he had blocked a saber strike from him? It could only be said that the other’s strength could still be considered passable.

“That’s right. Being able to block a strike from me, you can be considered an elite among those in the Foundation Building Tier,” he said proudly, “I am ranked 290,000 th in the Galaxy Network Tournament, ranked in the top three of the younger generation of Linyang Planet.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, “Ranked over 200,000, and you still dare to call yourself an elite?”
Are you an idiot!

Zhan Hong shook his head, “Truly an ignorant native from a backward place! You have absolutely no idea how colossal the whole galaxy is, and how many cultivators there are. Foundation Building Tier is the first tier of the Celestial Path, so naturally, they have the most numbers.

“I might as well give you a general introduction. The total number of Foundation Building Tiers is about ten billion. As long as you can rank in the top one million, you would be a one in ten thousand prodigy!” “just how many Foundation Building Tier cultivators are there on a planet? No more than 100,000.”
Hence, though he was ranked in the 200,000s, on some planet, this result would be enough to squeeze into the top three, and he could be considered a prodigy among prodigies.

Ling Han sighed, and looked at him with pity, “I didn’t realize that you were ? also a chatterbox. I didn’t askyou, and you just spouted a bunch of nonsense.” Zhan Hong’s mouth was half-gaping. Are you a f****** idiot?

Didn’t you hear my commentary? I am an existence ranked in the top 200,000 in the universe. On some planet, that would be a super genius ranked in the top three. Who would not feel deep veneration or be scared out of their wits when they heard this?
You actually call me a chatterbox?
He had lost all patience, and once again brandished his saber as he charged out. This time, he was going to crush Ling Han into dust.
Ling Han smiled calmly, and used the Demonic Monkey Fists. Instantly, it was as if they had returned to the primitive era. A Demonic Monkey appeared, wanting to pierce a hole into the skies.
Peng!
His fist was enshrouded in the Heavenly Dao Flames, and he greeted the saber’s blade, using his bare fists to take on the Spirit Tool head-on.
“You’re seeking death!” Zhan Hong smirked coldly. Even if your battle prowess is higher than mine, using your physical body to clash head-on with a Spirit Tool was still an incredibly stupid move.

However, he immediately paled, because when the saber’s blade struck his fist, there was actually no splash of blood. Instead, an incredibly deep power assaulted him, penetrating directly into his body, as if it wanted to shatter his internal organs.
What was even more frightening was the fact that a scorching flame was also burning over. In front of this flame, his mystical power defense was completely useless.
He hurriedly retreated, but it was already too late. The flames had melted his protective shield, and the power of Ling Han’s punch was endlessly surging over, causing direct damage to him.
“Wa!” He opened his mouth, and spat out a mouthful of blood, but before it had even landed on the ground, it had already turned into steam, and evaporated completely.
Hiss, he had already dodged fast enough. He had only suffered a little bit of the power of the flames, and it actually still had such terrifying might?
“This is the battle prowess of the top three of that whatever planet?” Ling Han’s expression was filled with disappointment.
Though it was just a simple sentence, for Zhan Hong, these words were like knives, stabbing directly into his heart, causing blood to flow.
Damn it, damn it!

He stared at Ling Han, “Then come and experience my Blood Demon Saber!” “Three seals, fully open!” He shot out three consecutive fingers at the sanguine saber in his hand. Boom, instantly, this originally very ordinary sanguine saber immediately shone with a sanguine light, soaring into the skies. A frightening murderous aura spread out like a tidal wave.

He really did not know where his confidence came from.

However, when the energy surged out, he revealed an astounded expression, because Ling Han just happened to be standing there unscathed, and there was starlight flickering on his body, turning into something like a bell.
He didn’t die?
Not only did he not die, he was completely unscathed.
Was that starlight activated by some kind of cultivation technique that Ling
Han had channelled, or was it activated by a precious tool?
Zhan Hong immediately regained his composure.
So what if he had blocked a saber strike from him?
It could only be said that the other’s strength could still be considered passable.
“That’s right.

Being able to block a strike from me, you can be considered an elite among those in the Foundation Building Tier,” he said proudly, “I am ranked 290,000 th in the Galaxy Network Tournament, ranked in the top three of the younger generation of Linyang Planet.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself, “Ranked over 200,000, and you still dare to call yourself an elite?”
Are you an idiot!
Zhan Hong shook his head, “Truly an ignorant native from a backward place!
You have absolutely no idea how colossal the whole galaxy is, and how many cultivators there are.
Foundation Building Tier is the first tier of the Celestial Path, so naturally, they have the most numbers.
“I might as well give you a general introduction.
The total number of Foundation Building Tiers is about ten billion.
As long as you can rank in the top one million, you would be a one in ten thousand prodigy!” “just how many Foundation Building Tier cultivators are there on a planet?
No more than 100,000.”
Hence, though he was ranked in the 200,000s, on some planet, this result would be enough to squeeze into the top three, and he could be considered a prodigy among prodigies.
Ling Han sighed, and looked at him with pity, “I didn’t realize that you were ? also a chatterbox.
I didn’t askyou, and you just spouted a bunch of nonsense.” Zhan Hong’s mouth was half-gaping.
Are you a f****** idiot?
Didn’t you hear my commentary?
I am an existence ranked in the top 200,000 in the universe.
On some planet, that would be a super genius ranked in the top three.
Who would not feel deep veneration or be scared out of their wits when they heard this?
You actually call me a chatterbox?
He had lost all patience, and once again brandished his saber as he charged out.
This time, he was going to crush Ling Han into dust.
Ling Han smiled calmly, and used the Demonic Monkey Fists.
Instantly, it was as if they had returned to the primitive era.
A Demonic Monkey appeared, wanting to pierce a hole into the skies.
Peng!
His fist was enshrouded in the Heavenly Dao Flames, and he greeted the saber’s blade, using his bare fists to take on the Spirit Tool head-on.
“You’re seeking death!” Zhan Hong smirked coldly.
Even if your battle prowess is higher than mine, using your physical body to clash head-on with a Spirit Tool was still an incredibly stupid move.
However, he immediately paled, because when the saber’s blade struck his fist, there was actually no splash of blood.
Instead, an incredibly deep power assaulted him, penetrating directly into his body, as if it wanted to shatter his internal organs.
What was even more frightening was the fact that a scorching flame was also burning over.
In front of this flame, his mystical power defense was completely useless.
He hurriedly retreated, but it was already too late.
The flames had melted his protective shield, and the power of Ling Han’s punch was endlessly surging over, causing direct damage to him.
“Wa!” He opened his mouth, and spat out a mouthful of blood, but before it had even landed on the ground, it had already turned into steam, and evaporated completely.
Hiss, he had already dodged fast enough.
He had only suffered a little bit of the power of the flames, and it actually still had such terrifying might?
“This is the battle prowess of the top three of that whatever planet?” Ling Han’s expression was filled with disappointment.
Though it was just a simple sentence, for Zhan Hong, these words were like knives, stabbing directly into his heart, causing blood to flow.
Damn it, damn it!
He stared at Ling Han, “Then come and experience my Blood Demon Saber!” “Three seals, fully open!” He shot out three consecutive fingers at the sanguine saber in his hand.
Boom, instantly, this originally very ordinary sanguine saber immediately shone with a sanguine light, soaring into the skies.
A frightening murderous aura spread out like a tidal wave.

chapters.title: Chapter 3712: Emperor of Tools
paragraphs: Chapter 3712: Emperor of Tools
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
The blood saber’s seal was fully opened, and the murderous aura surged, soaring straight into the clouds.

A haughty expression appeared on Zhan Hong’s face. This was a precious tool that had been passed down through the generations of the Zhan Clan. Though its grade was not high, the most outstanding members of the Zhan Clan of every generation would use it, beheading their enemies and the blade drinking the blood of their enemies.
After countless years of slaughter, this saber had consumed who knew how many people’s blood, which had also formed an endless murderous aura.
Usually, it would be sealed to prevent the murderous aura from seeping out. It looked very ordinary, but once the seal was removed, this would be the strongest weapon within Foundation Building Tier.
However, after opening the seal, the murderous aura would disperse, and this was something that could not be helped.
Zhan Hong felt a bit of pity, but also a bit of pride. He was the most outstanding heir of this generation of the Zhan Clan, and that was why he was qualified to use the Blood Demon Saber.
“Being able to force me to open the Blood Demon Saber’s seal, you would die without regrets.”

He did not waste any time, and immediately charged towards Ling Han. Boom, the murderous aura circulated, and even if Princess Bixiao was not facing him directly, her pretty face was still pale, and it was as if her heart was being pulled by a large, cold hand, making her feel incredibly terrible.
Even she was like this, so what about Ling Han?

Princess Bixiao couldn’t help but feel anxious. Concern would cause confusion, and her slender hand couldn’t help but clench into a fist, extremely nervous. Yet Ling Han did not take it to heart at all. His willpower was incredibly firm, and his Celestial Foundation was also incredibly sturdy. Only he was qualified to intimidate others, so how could others possibly affect him?
Hong, hong, hong! However, the might of the Blood Demon Saber was really not to be underestimated. As the saber slashed over, blood shadows surged, incredibly terrifying.

The murderous aura of this kind of Blood Demon Saber increased the sharpness of the saber, and even Ling Han did not dare to use his bare fists to parry the saber’s blade. He could only avoid a head-on confrontation.
“Hahaha, die! Die!” Zhan Hong laughed wildly.

Now that the Blood Demon Saber’s seal had been unlocked, not only did the murderous aura suppress his opponent, even he himself would be affected. It was hard to say now whether he was controlling the Blood Demon Saber, or the Blood Demon Saber was controlling him.
Ling Han humphed. He had a considerable number of ways to defeat Zhan Hong.
For example, if he used the technique of setting up formations with steps, added with the help of formations, he had full confidence that he could suppress his opponent.
For example, he could summon the Heavenly Dao Flames and directly burn his opponent to death.

This was a flame that even Saints would frown at. How easy would it be to burn a mere Foundation Building cultivator to death? However, he would exhaust a whole floor with a single use, and Ling Han only had eight chances left to use it, so he was naturally unwilling to waste it on Zhan Hong.

Another method would be if he used the Imminent Skyline, then used the Heavenly Dao Flames and Destructive Energy to attack a weak point, he could also succeed, though this would take a little bit of time.
Ling Han set all these plans aside. The other had a precious tool, so how could it be that he didn’t have one?
Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, out!

Weng, this precious treasure appeared, and floated above Ling Han’s head. Multiple flashes of Primal Chaos aura descended, and lightning flickered. This time, the precious tool did not keep a low profile, exuding a supreme aura.

The aura emanating from the Blood Demon Saber was immediately suppressed, continuously shrinking the area of murderous aura surging out. Finally, it actually retreated completely back into the saber’s blade.
F***,what was going on here?

Zhan Hong was transfixed with shock. It was as if he had just started peeing, when he suddenly encountered a peerless elite walking in front of him, scaring him to the point that he sucked his pee back in.
But that was the Blood Demon Saber, which had drunk endless blood. In the first place, it was an existence with a murderous aura soaring sky-high, and it was actually afraid?
This, this, this, this was unimaginable!

That precious tower… the atmosphere was too shocking. What kind of aura was that? It was dripping down in shreds, yet felt heavier than even a planet, and that lightning; he felt that if one was struck by it, even he could only be shattered into pieces.
“What kind of treasure is this?” Zhan Hong stared at the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower with greed in his eyes.
“A dead man, where does he get so much curiosity?” Ling Han charged over, his fists firing out rapidly.

Zhan Hong hurriedly brandished his saber to parry, but the Blood Demon Saber in his hand was restrained, and he could not release the slightest bit of might. Furthermore, when the saber’s blade struck the Primal Chaos Qi, it could not penetrate it at all. Just how heavy was that existence?
Zi, zi, zi! Multiple bolts of lightning shot out from the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, dazzling and blinding.

This was a future Imperial Weapon. Even if its might was only at the level of the Foundation Building Tier, it was still an overlord of Foundation Building Tier. Multiple bolts of lightning shot out, and it was not something that Zhan Hong could dodge at all. Instantly, he screamed in pain from being electrocuted, and the aroma of meat quickly wafted out.
“Yo, it’s a little burnt.” Ling Han was still teasing.
Zhan Hong was both furious and anxious. He, a dignified prodigy, was actually going to be killed by someone?

However, though he still had a great many secret techniques that he had yet to use, the Blood Demon Saber was his strongest trump card. Even this was already suppressed by Ling Han, so what was the use of using other techniques? If they continued fighting, he would definitely die.
An expression of heartache appeared on his face, but he still took out a talisman paper without hesitation, and slapped it onto his body.
This was the Ten Thousand Mile Escape Talisman, which could instantly send him thousands of miles away. It was his life-saving trump card.
“Want to flee?” Ling Han’s eyes were sharp, and he humphed. Boom, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower spun lightly, and multiple flashes of Primal Chaos Qi instantly pressed down on Zhan Hong.
Ka, the sound of bones cracking was immediately heard from Zhan Hong’s body. His whole person shrank, and then with a bang, sprawled out on the ground.

The true Primal Chaos Qi was as heavy as a planet, and now, because of Ling Han’s cultivation level, it was unable to reach such a terrifying extent. However, it was still not something that a Foundation Building cultivator could contend against, at least Zhan Hong could not.

“Ah—” Zhan Hong screamed tragically, all the bones in his body were still crackling. This pressure was too terrifying, causing his internal organs to feel a strong pressure, and it was possible that they would explode into mush at any moment.
Ling Han easily confiscated the Ten Thousand Mile Escape Talisman and Blood Demon Saber. He couldn’t help but smile and say, “Don’t you know that I’m a famous thief?”
There should still be legends about him among those who participated in the Metal Element Fruit Gathering, right?
Of course, everyone thought that the masked man was Niu Jianhua.
“I admit defeat,” Zhan Hong said through gritted teeth. This was a great humiliation to him. He was a young prodigy ranked in the top three of Linyang Planet, and he had actually lost so terribly.
“All right, then just accept your fate.” Ling Han threw a punch. Peng, Zhan Hong’s head exploded. The Heavenly Dao Flames curled up, and Zhan Hong’s corpse was also instantly burned to ashes.
Zhan Hong would definitely die with remaining grievances.11 have already admitted defeat, so why are you still so ruthless?’

Ling Han naturally would not leave any future troubles. Towards this kind of person that wanted to kill him, what need was there for him to be polite? In any case, this was a Mystery Realm, so even if he died, he could only resign himself to his fate.
“When it gets dark, if Zhuang Bufan still hasn’t come, we won’t wait for him,” Ling Han said.

Princess Bixiao and Sixth Baby recounted their experiences—after walking a long way ahead, they entered an ancient battlefield, and at night, those corpses came back to life, launching attacks at them.

Princess Bixiao charged back at the first instant, and with Sixth Baby’s unique attributes, she could directly enter into the Void and wouldn’t be attacked at all. If it weren’t for the fact that they agreed to meet back in one day, she could completely advance easily.

chapters.title: Chapter 3713: Formation versus Skeleton Soldiers
paragraphs: Chapter 3713: Formation versus Skeleton Soldiers
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations

Three different directions, and they had all set foot on the ancient battlefield? Ling Han could only conclude that their current location was within the ancient battlefield. It was just that there were no corpses in this area.
“Forget about it. Well just find a random direction and continue onwards,” he said very irresponsibly.
“What an unreliable father.” Sixth Baby shrugged, looking very helpless. They waited until night fell, but still did not see Zhuang Bufan return.
“Hehe, Father, looks like your little lackey has run away!” Sixth Elder laughed at Ling Han.

Ling Han rubbed his nose. It was rare that he wanted to take in a lackey. Logically speaking, with a tremor from his powerful body and the exuding of a domineering aura, shouldn’t he be able to instantly make others prostrate themselves in admiration?
The next time he saw that brat, he would definitely beat him into a pig’s head. “Let’s go.”
They set out, and after walking for a few hours, they arrived at the border of the ancient battlefield.

At this time, all the corpses had already stood up, but within the range of Ling Han and his group’s vision, no cultivator had entered. These corpses were all standing blankly, as if they were statues.
But when Ling Han and his group approached, these corpses seemed to have become excited. They all turned their heads, and looked towards the three of them.
What was it? Were the three of them very special?𝒇𝒓𝒆𝒆𝙬𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝒎
Thankfully, the army of corpses was strictly restricted within the ancient battlefield, and could not possibly escape.
“How do I get out of here?”
These damn things are all around us, surrounding us.”
“Though we can pass through by day, there is only half a day’s time. With the size of this battlefield, there is no way to pass through at all.”
“I’ve seen the information left behind by predecessors, and weneed to travel three days at least to be able to pass through this area.”
“Three days! In other words, we have to hold on for at least two nights, and be ganged up on by these skeleton soldiers.”
“How is this possible?”
“I can’t even last ten minutes.”
There were quite a number of people in the surroundings, and they all looked disappointed.
They had come with enthusiasm and full of confidence, but in the end they had not even managed to take the first step, and were already defeated. How could they not feel dejected?
“Why don’t we join forces to barge in?”
“All right, the more the merrier.”
“Who knows, we would have to work together to be able to pass.”
Someone suggested joining forces, which gained the agreement of the others.
A small-scale alliance was soon formed.
Initially, some people had already formed teams with others outside, but after entering this place, they were teleported to different places. Thus, they could only temporarily form another team.
“Ling Han, join us.” Someone came to find Ling Han.
He had a tone of charity. If it was not for the fact that Ling Han was a
Formation Master, he wouldn’t even bother to invite someone from a backward place.
Who knows, he may not be able to help in any way, and would only be a burden.
Ling Han shook his head, “No need. I like to move alone.”

That person was startled. He had not thought that Ling Han would actually refuse, and couldn’t help but show a hint of anger in his expression. “I gave you face, yet you still refuse. You really don’t know what’s good for you. Do you think that just because you are a Formation Master, you consider yourself high and important?”
Forget it, forget it. Everyone has their own aspirations!” Another person came over, and he advised the first person.
That person thought for a moment, but did not flare up. After all, there were a great many people recruiting Ling Han in this place, and there were some that he really could not afford to offend.

Aside from Ling Han and the others, the others had all formed teams. They wouldn’t charge into the ancient battlefield at this time; wouldn’t that be asking for trouble? However, in order to get used to it, they still barged in and stayed on the fringes.

They mainly wanted to practice their coordination, as well as get used to the strength. If even they could not hold up like this, they would not have to go in tomorrow. Who knows, they may not even be able to charge back, and die inside.

They battled for over half an hour, and very soon, their cooperation was well coordinated. After all, they were all prodigies, so as long as they set aside their arrogance and cooperated sincerely, they would still be very effective Meanwhile, Ling Han and the others rested. Tomorrow, as soon as the sun rose, they would immediately set out.
The night passed, and the sun had just risen.
“Let’s go.” Two groups of people moved out at the same time, entering into the ancient battlefield.

They were heading in the same direction, and in order to travel as much as possible during daytime, they did not stop to eat, but rather rushed on with all their might. However, the killing intent in the ancient battlefield was like blades, and their speed was not very fast. At most, it was only one third to half the speed of sound.
Half a day later, the sun set in the west, and the skies darkened.
When the last corner of the sun disappeared into the horizon, an endless darkness suddenly surged over.
Ka, ka, ka! Those corpses all got back to their feet, dark flames burning in their eye sockets. It was as if they had suddenly entered into the ghostly realm.
“Stop, and prepare for battle.”
Those who had formed teams immediately stopped. They were divided into a total of three groups, and took turns to rest.
Ling Han, Princess Bixiao, and Sixth Baby also stopped, advancing against the attacks of the skeleton soldiers. This was an unwise move.

“What do we do?” Princess Bixiao asked. Actually, she was in favour of forming a team with others. This way, they could share the pressure on the defense, and they could also take turns to rest and reorganize.
“Let nature take its course,” Ling Han said with a smile. As he walked, he set up the formation foundations.

Boom, but the army of skeletons would not give him the chance to calmly set up the formation. They all charged over. Strangely, the majority of the skeleton soldiers actually charged towards them, while the number that charged towards the other group was much lesser.
What, was there any such thing as being biased?
Ling Han was astonished. He continued to set up formations as he threw punches.
Princess Bixiao and Sixth Baby hurriedly helped, battling fiercely with the skeleton army.

Ling Han could see very clearly that the reason why the skeleton army was so “warm” towards them was completely because of Sixth Baby. That was because these skeleton armies had practically ignored Princess Bixiao, and were simply attacking Sixth Baby madly.
He hurriedly said, “Sixth Baby, turn invisible.”
Yes, Father.” Sixth Baby immediately dove into the void.
With her disappearance, the skeletal army instantly returned to normal. The corpses that had initially been sent over rushed towards another group of people.
“F***, what’s going on here?”
“Why have there been more skeleton soldiers?”
“Could it be that the three people on the other side have been completely annihilated?”
The pressure here increased greatly, so they were naturally complaining endlessly.

“Don’t panic. We have already rehearsed it yesterday, and there is absolutely no problem,” a man in red robes said. He had the highest cultivation level in this team, so he was duty-bound to bear the burden of captain.
This person was called Jin Jingtian, and he was a one-star genius of Ultimate
Dao Foundation. His abilities were quite extraordinary.
Everyone nodded, calming themselves down. Following yesterday’s drill, one group rested, while the other group battled.
Once the situation had stabilized, they turned to look in the direction of Ling
Han and the others. These three people should have all died, right? Sigh, it was
a pity about that beautiful girl. She was very uniquely beautiful.
‘Huh? F*ck!’
This glance swept over them, and they were all stunned.
What had they seen?

Ling Han and the others were actually sitting upright, and were just starting a fire to cook rice. Meanwhile, one after another, the skeleton soldiers rushed over, and they were all struck by the light pillars that surged out, exploding in an instant.
The formation was formed!

But when Ling Han and his group approached, these corpses seemed to have become excited.
They all turned their heads, and looked towards the three of them.
What was it?
Were the three of them very special?𝒇𝒓𝒆𝒆𝙬𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝒎
Thankfully, the army of corpses was strictly restricted within the ancient battlefield, and could not possibly escape.
“How do I get out of here?”
These damn things are all around us, surrounding us.”
“Though we can pass through by day, there is only half a day’s time.
With the size of this battlefield, there is no way to pass through at all.”
“I’ve seen the information left behind by predecessors, and weneed to travel three days at least to be able to pass through this area.”
“Three days!
In other words, we have to hold on for at least two nights, and be ganged up on by these skeleton soldiers.”
“How is this possible?”
“I can’t even last ten minutes.”
There were quite a number of people in the surroundings, and they all looked disappointed.
They had come with enthusiasm and full of confidence, but in the end they had not even managed to take the first step, and were already defeated.
How could they not feel dejected?
“Why don’t we join forces to barge in?”
“All right, the more the merrier.”
“Who knows, we would have to work together to be able to pass.”
Someone suggested joining forces, which gained the agreement of the others.
A small-scale alliance was soon formed.
Initially, some people had already formed teams with others outside, but after entering this place, they were teleported to different places.
Thus, they could only temporarily form another team.
“Ling Han, join us.” Someone came to find Ling Han.
He had a tone of charity.
If it was not for the fact that Ling Han was a
Formation Master, he wouldn’t even bother to invite someone from a backward place.
Who knows, he may not be able to help in any way, and would only be a burden.
Ling Han shook his head, “No need.
I like to move alone.”
That person was startled.
He had not thought that Ling Han would actually refuse, and couldn’t help but show a hint of anger in his expression.
“I gave you face, yet you still refuse.
You really don’t know what’s good for you.
Do you think that just because you are a Formation Master, you consider yourself high and important?”
Forget it, forget it.
Everyone has their own aspirations!” Another person came over, and he advised the first person.
That person thought for a moment, but did not flare up.
After all, there were a great many people recruiting Ling Han in this place, and there were some that he really could not afford to offend.
Aside from Ling Han and the others, the others had all formed teams.
They wouldn’t charge into the ancient battlefield at this time; wouldn’t that be asking for trouble?
However, in order to get used to it, they still barged in and stayed on the fringes.
They mainly wanted to practice their coordination, as well as get used to the strength.
If even they could not hold up like this, they would not have to go in tomorrow.
Who knows, they may not even be able to charge back, and die inside.
They battled for over half an hour, and very soon, their cooperation was well coordinated.
After all, they were all prodigies, so as long as they set aside their arrogance and cooperated sincerely, they would still be very effective Meanwhile, Ling Han and the others rested.
Tomorrow, as soon as the sun rose, they would immediately set out.
The night passed, and the sun had just risen.
“Let’s go.” Two groups of people moved out at the same time, entering into the ancient battlefield.
They were heading in the same direction, and in order to travel as much as possible during daytime, they did not stop to eat, but rather rushed on with all their might.
However, the killing intent in the ancient battlefield was like blades, and their speed was not very fast.
At most, it was only one third to half the speed of sound.
Half a day later, the sun set in the west, and the skies darkened.
When the last corner of the sun disappeared into the horizon, an endless darkness suddenly surged over.
Ka, ka, ka!
Those corpses all got back to their feet, dark flames burning in their eye sockets.
It was as if they had suddenly entered into the ghostly realm.
“Stop, and prepare for battle.”
Those who had formed teams immediately stopped.
They were divided into a total of three groups, and took turns to rest.
Ling Han, Princess Bixiao, and Sixth Baby also stopped, advancing against the attacks of the skeleton soldiers.
This was an unwise move.
“What do we do?” Princess Bixiao asked.
Actually, she was in favour of forming a team with others.
This way, they could share the pressure on the defense, and they could also take turns to rest and reorganize.
“Let nature take its course,” Ling Han said with a smile.
As he walked, he set up the formation foundations.
Boom, but the army of skeletons would not give him the chance to calmly set up the formation.
They all charged over.
Strangely, the majority of the skeleton soldiers actually charged towards them, while the number that charged towards the other group was much lesser.
What, was there any such thing as being biased?
Ling Han was astonished.
He continued to set up formations as he threw punches.
Princess Bixiao and Sixth Baby hurriedly helped, battling fiercely with the skeleton army.
Ling Han could see very clearly that the reason why the skeleton army was so “warm” towards them was completely because of Sixth Baby.
That was because these skeleton armies had practically ignored Princess Bixiao, and were simply attacking Sixth Baby madly.
He hurriedly said, “Sixth Baby, turn invisible.”
Yes, Father.” Sixth Baby immediately dove into the void.
With her disappearance, the skeletal army instantly returned to normal.
The corpses that had initially been sent over rushed towards another group of people.
“F***, what’s going on here?”
“Why have there been more skeleton soldiers?”
“Could it be that the three people on the other side have been completely annihilated?”
The pressure here increased greatly, so they were naturally complaining endlessly.
“Don’t panic.
We have already rehearsed it yesterday, and there is absolutely no problem,” a man in red robes said.
He had the highest cultivation level in this team, so he was duty-bound to bear the burden of captain.
This person was called Jin Jingtian, and he was a one-star genius of Ultimate
Dao Foundation.
His abilities were quite extraordinary.
Everyone nodded, calming themselves down.
Following yesterday’s drill, one group rested, while the other group battled.
Once the situation had stabilized, they turned to look in the direction of Ling
Han and the others.
These three people should have all died, right?
Sigh, it was
a pity about that beautiful girl.
She was very uniquely beautiful.
‘Huh?
F*ck!’
This glance swept over them, and they were all stunned.
What had they seen?
Ling Han and the others were actually sitting upright, and were just starting a fire to cook rice.
Meanwhile, one after another, the skeleton soldiers rushed over, and they were all struck by the light pillars that surged out, exploding in an instant.
The formation was formed!

chapters.title: Chapter 3714: Shameless
paragraphs: Chapter 3714: Shameless
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations

The unique trait of the Skeleton Soldiers was that they were unafraid of death. Their battle prowess was very strong, but their disadvantage was that they were very stubborn, and were especially stupid. They only knew how to attack. In any case, so what if they were destroyed? On the second night, they were still a “good skeleton”.
Additionally, the defenses of these skeleton soldiers were extremely weak, and could be considered trash-level.

This caused them to appear especially dazed and fragile when they encountered a formation. When a pillar of light shot over, they were completely unguarded. Pa, pa, pa, a good number of skeleton soldiers were destroyed by a flash of light.

Ling Han’s formation was capable of shooting out thirty-six pillars of light at the same time, and with a sweep, at least a hundred skull soldiers would be destroyed, which was extraordinarily efficient.

This allowed Ling Han to have time to prepare dinner. Meanwhile, Princess Bixiao’s beautiful figure danced around, and she only needed to destroy some that had slipped through the net. The intensity of this kind of battle was completely within her abilities.

Sixth Baby naturally did not appear. The moment she appeared, she would attract a large number of skeleton soldiers, greatly increasing the burden on them. After all, though the might of the formation was extraordinary, there was also a gap in the sweep of the light pillars, and they would only fire one round every second or so.
Even so, in comparison, the two sides could be said to be on two completely different levels.

Ling Han and the others were extremely relaxed. They actually had the leisure to prepare dinner, and on the other side, it was a tough battle! The remaining people also had to hurry up and take alchemical pills to recover their mystical power, so how could they have the mood and time to do other things?
Was this the effect of a Formation Master?
A considerable number of people felt regret. If they had known earlier, they would have formed a team with Ling Han.
No wonder he was so confident. It wasn’t that he was too proud, but rather that Formation Masters were truly extraordinary.

Actually, Ling Han still had other ways to resist these skeleton soldiers, and that was the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. This future Imperial Weapon only needed to release Primal Chaos Qi, and what corpse would be able to barge through?
However, there were too many outsiders now, so Ling Han naturally wouldn’t expose the secret of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
“Come, let’s eat.” Ling Han had already prepared the food, and called over Sixth Baby and Princess Bixiao.
Sixth Baby immediately appeared. Eating was one of her hobbies.
But the moment Sixth Baby appeared, it immediately drew out the madness of the nearby skeleton soldiers, surging over like a tidal wave.
Princess Bixiao was instantly flustered. Though she was also a one-star genius, she had not advanced into Heavenly Dao Foundation yet, after all.

Ling Han smiled, and casually tapped out a finger. The Celestial Crossing Finger was shot out, and there was some Heavenly Dao Flames imbued within. The destructive power of the finger was astonishing. Pa, pa, pa, it destroyed at least a dozen skeleton soldiers along the way.
“Come eat, don’t worry about it,” he said. His fingers moved, and multiple flashes of energy shot out. No matter how many skeleton soldiers attacked him, he would be able to easily block them.
After all, he still had the help of the formation.
Princess Bixiao also began to eat. For Celestial Path cultivators, eating was not necessary, but if they were constantly assailed by hunger, it would definitely affect their battle prowess.
Seeing how relaxed these three people were, Jin Jingtian and the others felt like they were about to go crazy.
This was too much, wasn’t it? Have you guys come for a camping trip?
“Come, let’s go over,” Jin Jingtian immediately came to a decision.
“That’s right. With the help of formations, we can decrease the pressure by a lot.” The others nodded respectively.
This group of people slowly moved in the direction of Ling Han’s group. Their speed could not be too fast. Once they lost their footing, they would suffer heavy losses.

However, battling a defensive battle against the assault of the skeleton army and facing the assault of the skeleton army head-on were two completely different matters. The difficulty level was completely on two different levels.
Thus, it was difficult for them to advance. After spending close to twenty minutes, they finally charged to the vicinity of Ling Han and his group.
Zi, zi, zi! However, formations didn’t differentiate between human and skeletal soldiers, so barging in naturally meant getting shot.
Those people dispersed in a sorry state, but there were still many of them, after all, so they still forced their way in.
Furthermore, they had shared a portion of the firepower, and the number of skeleton soldiers that managed to charge through the formation also soared all of a sudden.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel furious. These people were really selfish.
“Get out of here,” he shouted, launching an attack at Jin Jingtian and the others.

“Ling Han, you are truly selfish. Faced with such a dangerous obstacle, you are not working together to overcome it, and still want to attack us!” Jin Jingtian took the initiative to attack first, and reprimanded Ling Han.
Everyone nodded. You clearly have the ability to help everyone, and furthermore, you have already set up the formation, so there is no need for you to expend any energy.
This was a win-win situation, so why not?
Too petty, too selfish.
Who exactly was the selfish one here?
What reason did Ling Han have to help these people?

They were completely unrelated. Previously, when he had been setting up the formation, why had he not seen these people step out to help him? Oh, now that he had set up the formation, these people saw that there was a chance for them to take advantage of him, and crowded over one after another, their expressions filled with righteousness.
Pei, could they be even more shameless?
Ling Han humphed and said, “Since you people aren’t getting lost, I’ll kill you until you’re terrified!”

Boom, he used the Three Styles of the God of War. The power of heaven and earth instantly centered around him, surging endlessly towards him. However, this power of heaven and earth could not be used to cultivate, and could only stay in his body for a short while. Then, it was all blasted out.
This was not only a burst of power from him, but also boosted by the power of heaven and earth, so his power was incredibly boundless.
Instantly, figures flew and danced, filling the skies.
“Ahhh!” someone wailed in agony. The skeletal army wouldn’t hold back when they fell into the sea of skeletal soldiers, and they would directly slash them to death with their ice-cold blades.
In this short while, five people had already died.
“Ling Han, you are practically deranged!” Jin Jingtian rebuked angrily.
Ling Han merely smirked coldly. Was it his duty to protect others?
Not at all!

Moreover, this was a contest for treasures in a Mystery Realm, and everyone was fighting over that sliver of fated opportunity. In the first place, they were competitors. He had already clearly stated that they would not be forming a team. If you guys wanted to bask in his glory, and were rejected by him, and still wanted to force your way in, could it be that he should just accept being taken advantage of?
He once again used the second form of the Three Styles of the God of War. A vigorous power swept out. Pa, pa, pa! Instantly, figures were seen flying, like a celestial maiden scattering flowers.
Screams rang out again, and this time, another three people were sent flying and killed by the skeleton soldiers.
“Ling Han, you’ve gone too far!”
“Kill him!”
Everyone’s eyes were bloodshot, as they charged towards Ling Han.

Actually, if they didn’t come, they could completely block the combined attacks of the skeleton soldiers. However, they would also expend a lot of energy, yet they wanted to take advantage of the situation. In the end, they did not manage to take advantage of the situation, but instead caused themselves to suffer heavy losses.
Ling Han’s eyes were cold. These people disgusted him.
“I’m about to die from fury!” Sixth Baby said in a childish voice as she launched an attack at the others.

She was born with a Divine Physique, and her battle prowess was naturally powerful. More importantly, she could enter the Void, and no attack would be able to hit her. This was something that would render one extremely speechless.𝕗𝐫𝚎𝗲𝘄𝐞𝕓𝐧𝕠𝘃𝕖𝐥.𝐜𝚘𝚖
Only Princess Bixiao’s abilities were the weakest. She had already put on the Battle Armor to increase her defenses, so as to avoid causing trouble for Ling Han.
However, everyone present was smart, and immediately saw this weakness.
“Capture this woman!” Jin Jingtian commanded.
If they could capture Princess Bixiao, they would be able to threaten Ling Han..

chapters.title: Chapter 3715: Trump Card fully unleashed
paragraphs: Chapter 3715: Trump Card fully unleashed
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
“Despicable,” Princess Bixiao said through gritted teeth.

Yet Ling Han’s expression was natural, “This is their nature, and that is how vile they are.” In the Genesis World, he had spent epochs, so he naturally did not lack a deep understanding of the human heart.
What kind of ugly face had he not seen before?
It was fine to just kill them.

As he protected Princess Bixiao, he attacked madly. The Heavenly Dao Flames and Destructive Energy were used in turns. His offensive power was incomparably violent, and no one dared to take it head-on.

The scene was extremely chaotic. At present, there were three parties, Ling Han and his group, as well as Jin Jingtian’s team and the skeleton soldiers. All three parties were presently in an opposing state. However, Ling Han, Jin Jingtian and the others were intelligent, after all. If they encountered danger, they would first give up the battle among themselves, and concentrate on dealing with the skeleton soldiers. Only then would they target each other.
The formation was also showing its might, and pillars of light danced madly, as
if it was creating a dazzling stage.

Time passed continuously, and Jin Jingtian and the others finally couldn’t hold on any longer. They had to face the attacks of Ling Han and the skeletal soldiers at the same time. This was much more dangerous than facing the skeleton soldiers alone.
“Retreat! Retreat! Retreat!”
Jin Jingtian issued a command, and everyone hurriedly retreated out of the formation circle. They re-formed their ranks, blocking the attacks of the skeleton soldiers.
There was lingering fear in their hearts, and they were filled with fear of Ling
Han’s battle prowess.

Who would have thought that a Formation Master would actually possess such terrifying battle prowess, blasting them into submission? Of course, this was also related to the environment. With so many skeleton soldiers joining in on the excitement, they had to divide their united battle prowess considerably.
“When the sun rises, we’ll definitely kill this person,” Jin Jingtian said balefully.

“En!” Everyone nodded. As they saw it, Ling Han was really despicable. He clearly had a formation that could resist the army of corpses, yet forcibly kept them outside, and caused quite a number of them to die.
Who were they?

Which one of them was not an outstanding successor of a great sect or noble clan? Even if they were not the best, they were still one of the very best. A mere native actually dared to screw them over? This naturally could not be tolerated.
Just wait.
The long night finally ended. The first ray of sunlight shone down, and instantly, all the skeleton soldiers lost their power all of a sudden. They all crashed onto the ground.
immediately, Jin Jingtian and the others leaped out, surrounding Ling Han and his group.
“You guys still haven’t learnt your lesson?” Ling Han swept an eye over these people, his killing intent surging.

“Humph, this time, there are no foot soldiers around to help you. Furthermore, we would not be so foolish as to step into the formation.” Jin Jingtian stated calmly. In his eyes, Ling Han’s battle prowess was indeed extraordinary, but the real threat still came from his formation.
Thus, if they didn’t step into the formation, Ling Han’s battle prowess would be halved.
“You guys stay here,” Ling Han said to Princess Bixiao and Sixth Baby as he strode out of the formation.
Yi?
Jin Jingtian and the others faltered upon hearing this. What was going on? Ling Han had actually walked out by himself?
If you were in the formation, then we would still have some reservations, and would only launch long-distance attacks, but if you came out, then what else would we have to be wary about?
“You’re truly seeking death!” Jin Jingtian said balefully.

“Attack together, and kill him!” Everyone was filled with killing intent. Ling Han shook his head, and said, “A bunch of weaklings. I’ll send you on your way to the afterlife, lest you tarnish my eyes.”

“Impudence!” Seeing that Ling Han was getting closer and closer, and had already left the formation far behind, Jin Jingtian’s heart was also becoming more and more certain. In his eyes, Ling Han was already a corpse.

“Charge!” These people all shouted loudly, and charged towards Ling Han. So what if you were a prodigy? There were still more than 30 of them, and there was no shortage of Ultimate Dao Foundation cultivators among them. Each of them could defeat you with a single move.
Jin Jingtian also felt that Ling Han was purely seeking death. No matter how he thought about it, he could not think of any other chance for Ling Han to turn the tables.
Ling Han smiled faintly, and drew out his own cornerstone of the Celestial Path.
En, the cornerstone of the Celestial Path?
Everyone faltered slightly. ‘What do you mean by that?’

Do you think that you are an Ultimate Dao Foundation cultivator, so you can use the cornerstone of the Celestial Path as a deterrent? Too naive. There was no shortage of elites that had attained Ultimate Dao Foundation here.
Weng, a frightening aura spread out, and everyone’s faces turned pale, feeling a strong suffocation.
They couldn’t move anymore. It was as if they were being suppressed by heaven and earth. If they advanced a single step further, it was as if the cornerstone of his Celestial Path would crush them.
What was going on here?
Could it be because of that foundation stone of the Celestial Path?
Everyone stopped. They did not want their foundations of the Celestial Path to shatter for no reason, even if it was only a possibility.
Different, it was really different.
Everyone stared at Ling Han’s celestial foundation stone. The veined patterns were different from their celestial foundation stone, exuding an aura that surpassed the ancients, as if it was eternal.

How could there possibly be such a terrifying cornerstone of the Celestial Path? Ling Han had even taken out the cornerstone of the Celestial Path, so he naturally had the determination to annihilate all of them. Weng, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower also appeared above his head, sending down streaks of Primal Chaos Qi that could suppress the heavens and the earth.
“W-what kind of precious tool is this?”
“My Three Star Whip is trembling, as if I have encountered the empero of all tools.”
“Heavens, first there is the cornerstone of the Celestial Path that has the ability to suppress, and then there is this terrifying precious tower. Who exactly is this brat?”
“A backward land? Pah, a backward land. How could a backward land possibly nurture such a prodigy, and birth such a treasure?

Everyone was astounded. Whether it was Ling Han’s foundation stone of the Celestial Path, or the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, they both made them feel endless fear. This was a suppression from a higher level.

chapters.title: Chapter 3716: Unparalleled battle prowess
paragraphs: Chapter 3716: Unparalleled battle prowess
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations

The supreme cornerstone of the Celestial Path, the Imperial Weapon that would suppress everything in the future, if the two appeared at the same time, just how overwhelming would it be in the Foundation Building Tier?
Everyone trembled, and felt that even breathing was difficult for them. How could they still fight back?

Jin Jingtian roared loudly, and blasted out at Ling Han. He was the coordinator and commander of this temporary alliance, and now, he definitely had to be the first to step out. Otherwise, this team would be done for.
He held a sword in hand, and with a tap of his feet, his figure streaked through the air.

Unfortunately, he was suppressed by Ling Han’s foundation stone of the Celestial Path, and could not even unleash 30% of his full battle prowess. Furthermore, the sword in his hand was also a Spirit Tool. However, it was suppressed by the Imperial Weapon, and similarly did not have any power at all. It could only be considered a tool.
What battle prowess could this kind of Jin Jingtian have?

Ling Han stepped forwards, and shot out both fists in a furious barrage. Peng, peng, peng, peng! In an instant, he had broken through Jin Jingtian’s defenses, and a dozen over punches landed on his body at the same time.
He didn’t even glance at Jin Jingtian, and continued to rush toward the others. Peng! Peng! Peng!
He killed them one by one with a single punch. As the power of his punch surged past, all of them were sent flying. There was no exception.
The first person had not yet landed, when the second person had already flown up. Instantly, figures danced madly in the skies.
At this time, Jin Jingtian slowly turned around, but because of this action, his whole person suddenly disintegrated, turning into a pile of rotten flesh and shattered bones.

—Just now, Ling Han had shot out a dozen over punches consecutively, and his body had already been shattered. However, he was a prodigy that had built Ultimate Dao Foundation, after all, so his aura was extremely enduring. That was why he had not died on the spot, but the moment he moved, he had shattered.
The others were stunned. This was Jin Jingtian, the strongest elite among them, but even the strongest elite had fallen to such a state. Who would still have the courage to fight Ling Han?
The remaining twenty or so people hurriedly turned around and fled, completely losing their courage.
But this was the ancient battlefield; who could run fast enough?
The killing intent in the air was as sharp as blades, capable of easily slicing through skin and tearing through the body.
Xiu, Ling Han went on a killing spree. The aura of Primal Chaos descended. He completely ignored the existence of the killing intent, and could use his speed to the extreme.

After all, this Mystery Realm was only built by a Saint, and could perfectly suppress most people. However, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was the embryonic form of the Imperial Weapon. It was naturally more than enough to protect one person.
Otherwise, if the Imperial Weapon really came, and shook lightly, this Mystery Realm would probably collapse.
One side could only exert one-third of, or at maximum, half of the speed of sound, while the other side could reach twenty times the speed of sound, so who would be able to flee?

The terrible screams did not cease. Ling Han’s battle prowess was fully unleashed. On his left fist was Heavenly Dao Flames, and on his right fist was Destructive Energy. He did not have a deep grasp of these two high-level energies, and could only stimulate a sliver of them, but a sliver of their might was already terrifying enough.
With this punch, his opponent would either be incinerated into ashes, or be completely annihilated. There was no one that needed him to follow up with another punch.
Princess Bixiao was dumbfounded with shock. Was Ling Han really a Human Dao Foundation cultivator?
No, no, no. Even if it was the Ultimate Dao Foundation, could he be as strong as this?
Freak, monster, supreme prodigy, any kind of compliment could be heaped on Ling Han. There was definitely not the slightest bit of exaggeration.
In just five to six minutes, more than 30 people were completely annihilated.
Only then did Ling Han put away the foundation stone of the Celestial Path and the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, and began to plunder the treasures on these people.
He had already killed them, so how could it be that it would be wasted?

Unfortunately, the connection device was tied to the soul. Even if he took it, he would only be able to browse through the Galaxy Network, but would not be able to complete the transaction, and participate in the tournament battles, and such core elements.
“Father, you’re so awesome!” Sixth Baby praised.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Of course.”
This was very arrogant, but Princess Bixiao instead felt that Ling Han was being modest. If this kind of battle merit was known to others, it should be able to shake the universe.
“You’re probably invincible in the Foundation Building Tier!” she said with emotion.

Ling Han shookhis head, “It’s not that exaggerated. If I used all my trump cards, it should be no problem for me to match a four-star genius of Ultimate Dao Foundation. However, if a five-star genius of Ultimate Dao Foundation came, or two, or three four-star geniuses that have achieved Ultimate Dao Foundation, I probably wouldn’t be able to hold up either.”
After all, whether it was him or the Primal ChaosExtreme Lightning Tower, they were still only at the level of Human Dao Foundation.
Princess Bixiao was speechless. This show-off was really high-profile enough.
“Let’s go.”
They hurriedly set off. If they did not rush in the day, they would only be able to fight a tough battle at night, and could not possibly advance any further.
A day passed, and the sky instantly darkened.
Needless to say, all the corpses stood up at practically the same time.

Now that they had reached this place, aside from the ordinary skeleton soldiers, there were also many more of those skeleton riders. They all rode on tall skeletal horses, and pointed at Ling Han and his group. Wu, an ancient battle drum sounded, and a deep horn sounded in the skies.
All the skeleton soldiers moved, launching an attack towards Ling Han and his group.

Since the might of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower had already been exposed, Ling Han might as well not hide it any longer. He summoned it and floated it above his head, sending down streaks of Primal Chaos Qi, while multiple bolts of lightning struck out repeatedly.
Pa, pa, pa! The power of lightning was terrifying. When it landed on the skeleton soldiers, they directly exploded into pieces. It was probably impossible to put them back together tomorrow.
As expected of the Imperial Weapon. Even if it was only in its infancy, its destructive power was still impressive.𝕗𝗿𝕖𝐞𝐰𝗲𝕓𝐧𝕠𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝐨𝚖
There was no need for Ling Han and the others to have any kind of defense. The aura of Primal Chaos descended, and was not something that could be penetrated by any skeleton soldier at all.

According to Ling Han’s estimation, if one wanted to break through the defenses of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower at this stage, they would have to be a four-star genius of Ultimate Dao Foundation, at least. This was also what Ling Han had said before. If he used his trump cards fully, he would be able to battle this kind of super elite.”

In the case of the skeleton soldiers, no matter how many there were, they were useless. The aura of Primal Chaos was continuously seeping out, and there was absolutely no need to worry that it would be weakened before being destroyed. Hong! Hong! Hong!

Heavy footsteps were heard, like thunder. Ling Han looked over, and saw that a skeletal knight was presently charging towards them. The hooves of the skeletal horse landed, releasing a world-shaking sound.
Just how heavy was this man and horse? They had actually caused an earthquake-like sound.
In an instant, the skeletal rider had already rushed in front of Ling Han and the others. Then, he brandished the battle spear in his hands, stabbing towards Sixth Baby.
Peng!

The battle spear arrived, and its power was extraordinarily great, yet it was completely unable to do anything to the defenses of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. Under the massive rebound of power, the skeletal knight was instead thrown off its feet, and both man and horse fell heavily onto the ground.
A skull rolled out. That was the fall of the skeletal knight, and its head had directly been knocked off.
However, that headless body very quickly walked towards the skull, picked it up, and placed it on his neck.
“Pu!” Sixth Baby instantly laughed loudly. That was because the skull knight had installed its head the wrong way round, but it immediately twisted its neck 180 degrees. All right.
Ling Han was curious. Why would the army of corpses here target Sixth Baby like this?
She was just a child; was there any need to be so filled with killing intent?

chapters.title: Chapter 3717: Confirming a conjecture
paragraphs: Chapter 3717: Confirming a conjecture
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations
Though it was completely ineffective, the army of corpses was still barraging them wave after wave, completely lacking the adaptability of intelligent creatures.
This was because they did not have much intelligence in the first place, and had only managed to crawl up under a mysterious power. It would be more appropriate to call them marionettes.

However, though it was safe and there was no need to worry, Ling Han did not dare to advance at this time. It was one matter if he could block them, but to advance while bearing the barrage of countless skeleton soldiers was’another matter.
Rest for a while. We’ll set out tomorrow morning,” Ling Han said.
The night passed, and when the sun rose, the three of them immediately advanced.
Ling Han discovered that there was no mark on his hand.
Previously, after his first bloody battle for a night, he had been stamped by something unknown here, but whether it was yesterday or today, he had not been stamped with a second stamp.
Was it that he only needed to be stamped once, or that he had not managed to survive the night with his own battle prowess, so it did not count?
When day was about to pass, a massive canyon appeared ahead of them.
The three of them adjusted their course, and headed towards the canyon’s entrance. However, they still hadn’t reached the canyon’s entrance even when the sun had set.
The army of corpses had come again.

With a thought from Ling Han, he enshrouded the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower over Princess Bixiao and Sixth Baby. Meanwhile, he charged into the army of corpses, brandished his fists, and massacred them to his heart’s content.
He wanted to give it a try to see if he would be able to get another stamp in this way.
When Princess Bixiao saw this, she was rendered speechless.
What could she say?

However, Ling Han’s battle prowess was truly freakish. She wouldn’t be able to hold on for long under such a siege. Thankfully, she hadn’t gone too deep at the time, and she had worn the Battle Armor, allowing her to escape.
But looking at Ling Han, he was very much at ease.
Moreover, wouldn’t this guy’s mystical power be exhausted? How long had he been fighting for? Could it be that this guy wanted to fight like this for an entire night?
There was no benefit to be gained at all, so why did he have to do it?
A long night passed, and the moment the sun appeared, all the corpse armies collapsed onto the ground.
Er, there was no stamp.
Ling Han sighed. Looks like this mark would only be struck once.
He went to ask Princess Bixiao and Sixth Baby, but neither of them had any experience of being “stamped”.
Yi, then his judgement was still a bit correct. This stamp could only be stamped on those who had battled alone for a night. Take note that it was battle, and not hiding for a night like Sixth Baby.
“This seal… should have some effect,” Ling Han murmured.
The three of them continued to advance. This time, they only spent two hours, and they had already arrived at the entrance to the canyon.
This canyon was colossal, and the entrance was also astonishing. The width of the canyon was as much as 100 km.
“Yi, why aren’t you coming?” Princess Bixiao turned around to look at Ling Han.?s
Ling Han shook his head and said, “We’re not advancing today.”
“Why?” Princess Bixiao was confused.
“I have a conjecture to verify,” he said with a smile.

F***, this show-off.
