chapters.title: Chapter 3718: Meeting Hou Qingbai again
paragraphs: Chapter 3718: Meeting Hou Qingbai again
Translator: Henyee Translations | Editor: Henyee Translations

Everyone had a mindset of blind obedience. When everyone saw that Ling Han was staying here and not leaving, they all thought that there was some kind of treasure here, or that he had found some clue about the inheritance of the Saint, so they all began to search outside the canyon.
But no matter how hard they tried, they did not discover anything.
In truth, there was indeed nothing here.
After a while, this team finally left reluctantly.
When night fell, Princess Bixiao returned with Sixth Baby. Not far away, the army of corpses on the ancient battlefield stood up again.
Ling Han released a battle cry, and charged in.
Princess Bixiao’s mouth was slightly agape. ‘This is what you want to verify?’
She didn’t even have the energy to complain anymore. If Ling Han walked out now, she would definitely touch his forehead. Had he developed a high fever, that even his brain was muddled?
Speechless, she was really speechless.

Ling Han didn’t use any external power, and he simply continued to battle with his fists. Peng, peng, peng! His battle prowess was astounding, and each punch sent at least a dozen skeleton soldiers flying. Bones rained down.
A long night passed, and the army of corpses collapsed at the same time.
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face. He had guessed correctly, because he could feel that the power of heaven and earth had given him another stamp.
Could this be related to obtaining the inheritance of the Saint?

Throughout these countless years, there must have been a great many prodigies that had come here, and there was no shortage of supremely talented people among them. Perhaps, they may not be as freakish as Ling Han, but there were definitely seeds that could become Saints.
Why hadn’t any of them obtained the inheritance of the Saint?

This signified that this wasn’t simply a matter of natural talent. Rather, it signified that they did not match the criteria of choice of the Ancient Sun Saint. Thus Ling Han thought that merely having high natural talent was useless. Perhaps, it would be the same for any Great Emperor who entered when he was young. He would still have to return in disappointment.
This “stamp” was very possibly a key point.
“Can we leave now?” Princess Bixiao asked in irritation. She was about to go
crazy from being angered by Ling Han.
Ling Han shook his head, “Let’s wait a few more days.”
Still waiting?
A muscle twitched in Princess Bixiao’s cheek, “You can’t be saying that you want to continue battling there at night, right?
“You’re really smart,” Ling Han said with a smile.
Princess Bixiao instantly felt like she was about to go crazy. ‘Are you a battle maniac? Are you complaining that you didn’t fight enough yesterday?’

Even if she was driven mad, she could not possibly leave Ling Han alone. To her, the inheritance of a Saint did not seem to be all that important. As long as she’had such a person by her side, even if she was angered half to death, she would still have sweet feelings for him.
After an entire day, another seven teams walked out of the ancient battlefield
and entered into the canyon.
Seeing that Ling Han and the others were actually spacing out in the valley,
they all showed expressions of disdain.
How foolish. They had come early, yet did not hurry up and continue onwards. Instead, they were just sitting here and wasting time? They were as stupid as could be.
Ling Han only smiled slightly. There were at least several million people who had entered this space before them, even if not ten million, so why hadn’t any of them succeeded?
Thus, time was not the most important factor, and it would be useless even if
they were faster.
When night fell, Ling Han rushed into the ancient battlefield and continued the
battle.
A night passed, and Ling Han received another stamp.
“Are you still not leaving today?” Princess Bixiao asked weakly.
“Tsk, not only are you intelligent now, you even know how to read minds,”
Ling Han said with a smile.
Princess Bixiao merely rolled her eyes at him, not wanting to speak at all.

These few days were the peak period for passing through the ancient battlefield. Every day, there would be a considerable number of teams passing through, and at most, there would be seventeen in a single day.
It was probably because they had thought of a way to gather the people that had entered this place at such a late time that they had begun to barge into the ancient battlefield.
There was no shortage of teams that had invited Ling Han to join them, but
Ling Han politely refused all of them.

He had already battled here for four days. Every time he battled until the morning of the second day, an additional mark would appear on his wrist, invisible to the naked eye. Furthermore, every mark overlapped on the same spot.
There were already five marks, was that still not enough?

It would only take three days to pass through the ancient battlefield. Even if they walked slowly, four days would be enough to pass. Going by that calculation, they would just have to battle for three nights. Ling Han had already battled for five nights, but it was still the same.
Could it be that his thought process was incorrect, and this mark would be endlessly superimposed like this?
This thought only flashed through Ling Han’s mind for a moment, before he tossed it out of his mind.
Even if that was the case, he would still stick to his initial idea to the end. On the path of cultivation, there would be times when he would not turn back even if he had hit a wall.
From the fifth day onwards, there were fewer and fewer teams passing through the ancient battlefield, dropping to two to three in a day.
On the eighth day, Ling Han encountered a team.
This wasn’t strange. What was strange was the fact that Hou Qingbai was in the team.
Now that enemies had met, both sides were naturally furious.
When Hou Qingbai saw Ling Han, he immediately sneered, and said, “Whoever kills this person for me, I’ll give him 5000 Dao Stones!
All of a sudden, the bounty had increased fivefold. That was because he wanted to personally see Ling Han die in front of him.
However, no one accepted this mission.

The members of their team were all heirs of great sects and noble clans. Though 5000 Dao Stones was tempting to them, they were also people who cared about their pride. No one could afford to lose face like this when they had to obey the commands of others.
When Hou Qingbai saw this, he gritted his teeth and said, “I’ll throw in another Cloudy Smoke Celestial Stone!”
This time, everyone looked interested.
The Cloudy Smoke Celestial Stone was a Two Star material, and not only that, it was also a Spiritual Power Spirit Tool.

Because there were too few ingredients for Spiritual Power, its value was much higher than ingredients of the same level. Furthermore, there was practically no lack of buyers but no one willing to sell.
Hou Qingbai was willing to take out the Cloudy Smoke Celestial Stone; it seemed like he really hated Ling Han to the core.
Under heavy rewards, there would definitely be brave men. The temptation of a Spiritual Power Spirit Tool was really too great.
“I’ll go!”
“Let me doit!”
Immediately, five people scrambled out, then attacked Ling Han together.
So what if he was a Formation Master? He was only a native from a backward place, so they would kill him!
Ling Han moved, only dodging and not attacking.
His reaction was in line with everyone’s understanding oh, with five prodigies working together, how could it be that Ling Han still had the strength to counter? Of course, he could only dodge.
“Since we’ve made our move, let’s hurry up and get rid of him,” a man in white said coldly.
“All right!”
There were a total of 12 people in this team, and immediately, another three charged towards Ling Han, while the other four charged towards Princess Bixiao and Sixth Baby.
“Ling Han, if you continue to flee, these two beauties, one big and one small, will suffer,” the white-robed man said. He held a sword in his hand, his expression filled with killing intent.

“Brother Hai, I took a fancy to this beauty,” Hou Qingbai hurriedly said. He only wanted Ling Han to die, but he hadn’t played with Princess Bixiao yet. Even if he wanted to kill her, it would have to wait until he was bored of playing with her.

“Shut up! Wasting everyone’s precious time for the sake of you, yet your mind is filled with women? Are you a stud pig?!” the white-robed man chided. If it weren’t for the fact that Hou Qingbai had given him a large number of Dao Stones to join this team, he would have definitely thrown him out at this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 3719: Resolved
paragraphs: Chapter 3719: Resolved
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations

With this shout from the white-robed man, Hou Qingbai could only shut up. He looked somewhat reluctantly at Princess Bixiao. This woman was really very beautiful. Furthermore, she had an elegant temperament, unlike the women that he used to play with. They would all take the initiative to throw themselves into his arms just for the sake of his background. It was really too boring.

The white-robed man pointed the tip of his sword at Princess Bixiao, and said calmly, “I am in Ultimate Dao Foundation. Killing a Human Dao Foundation cultivator would only need one strike. Ling Han, I will count to three. If you continue to dodge, I will draw my sword.”
“Despicable!” Princess Bixiao rebuked angrily. ‘It’s one thing for you people to bully with numbers, but you actually want to use me as a hostage as well? How utterly shameless!’
The white-robed man was unmoved. It was naturally not difficult to kill Ling Han, but he did not want to waste time. He wanted to end the battle as soon as possible.
Since the result was the same, what need was there to be concerned about the process?
Whatever he did, he had never been concerned about means.

Ling Han humphed, and said, “Do you guys really want to seek death?” Hou Qingbai had a Sect Master-level background. Once he was killed, as long as the others were not silenced, it was very possible that he would attract a great elite of Sect Master-level. With the current martial arts background of the Celestial Sea Planet, how could they withstand the might of a Sect Master? The Heavenly Dao Flames could indeed destroy an elite of Sect Master-level, but what if it attracted the attention of the Holy Land of Metal Element? They were seeking death!

A cold smile appeared on the white-robed man’s face. One against eight? Immediately, he would see Ling Han being crushed into dust.

Boom!

Just how terrifying was the power of this kind of punch?
TWO punches landed, and two of the eight opponents directly collapsed. Their chests were penetrated, and then one was burnt to nothing, while the other had turned into nothing.
F***lf***if***i

The white-robed man’s expression also changed drastically, a powerful chill rising up in his heart.

Absolutely impossible!

Of course, he stumbled, and his face was also slightly pale.
Peng, before he could even speak, Ling Han’s second punch had already smashed over.
Then, it was the third punch, the fourth punch. Each punch was faster than the last, and each punch was stronger than the last.

Hou Qingbai wore a long face. At this moment, he was truly filled with regret.
If he had known that Ling Han was so powerful, he definitely wouldn’t have provoked him here..

chapters.title: Chapter 3720: How to break through
paragraphs: Chapter 3720: How to break through
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Hou Qingbai felt extreme regret, but it was already too late.
He hated himself. Why was he in such a rush? Why couldn’t he have others deal with Ling Han? Why did he have to provoke Ling Han here? Why did he have to do it himself?

“Don’t kill me!” he said in a trembling voice. “I can give you money, a lot, a lot of money, as well as treasures! My father is a Sect Master great elite. No matter what treasure you want, he can get it for you.”
Ling Han patted his shoulder, and said, “Don’t be afraid. I’m actually a very easygoing person.”
A look of delight instantly appeared on Hou Qingbai’s face. As it turned out, Ling Han was a money grubber. This made things easier. What he lacked the least was wealth.
“I will definitely satisfy you,” he said.
“En!” Ling Han nodded, but his palm strike used Destructive Energy. It instantly spread from Hou Qingbai’s shoulder to his entire body.
Hou Qingbai’s expression was filled with disbelief. ‘Didn’t you promise to spare my life?’
“I forgot to tell you, I like to joke more,” Ling Han said with a smile. “These ups and downs are very exciting, right?”
Exciting your sister!

Hou Qingbai wanted to curse, yet he couldn’t make a sound. His vitality had already been annihilated by the Destructive Energy, and his body instantly swayed. Before he fell to the ground, his entire body had already disappeared. “Ling Han, I’m sorry,” Princess Bixiao said in a low voice. This was all because of her. Otherwise, Ling Han wouldn’t have faced off against Hou Qingbai. At that time, he wouldn’t have needed to kill so many people.
Everyone here had a very strong background. Once the truth was revealed to the world, Ling Han would be in great trouble.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “There is no need to worry about having too many debts. Furthermore, there is no shortage of this kind of trash.”
He had even done something like burning down a Holy Land. He really did not take a mere Sect Master-level to heart.
Moreover, there was no one alive now. As long as the three of them didn’t say anything, there was no need to worry.

Ling Han put away the Spatial Celestial Tools that Hou Qingbai and the others had left behind. However, there were pitifully few Dao Stones, because these people all had connection devices, and their wealth was all virtual.
From this, it could also be seen just how wealthy the Chang Clan that operated this Galaxy Network was, because every Universe Coin corresponding to every Dao Stone was in their possession.
At night, Ling Han battled the army of corpses again.
He made up his mind. He was going to fight to the death here. Even if he ultimately did not gain anything, he would not regret it.

On the path of cultivation, one needed this kind of determination to not turn back even if they had hit a wall. Otherwise, how would they survive those difficulties? When they encountered setbacks, they would retreat, and find other ways. They were destined to have no chance of becoming the strongest. Eight days, ten days, fifteen days!
Sixteen seals had already been placed on Ling Han’s wrist, but there was still no change.
If there really was one, it was that his cultivation level had finally reached the peak of Human Dao Foundation.

It seemed like this was due to the fact that this was not a real planet. The power of heaven and earth was completely unsuited to cultivating. At most, it could only replenish the mystical power that had been expended, and lacked some kind of key item.
Theoretically speaking, Ling Han’s cultivation should have stagnated.

However, he had eaten a large amount of Silver Dragon Fish before, and he also ingested Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pills every day. Thus, he had accumulated a lot. Most importantly, he had to battle fiercely every night, stimulating all the benefits of the Silver Dragon Fish in his body.
“I can now attempt to form my Heavenly Dao Foundation,” Ling Han murmured to himself.

Breaking through to Heavenly Dao Foundation required the Treasured Fruit of Life. He had long since prepared for this. Previously, when he was still outside, he had bought ten Foundation Building Tier-level Treasured Fruits of Life, and believed that they should be enough.
How did one go from Human Dao Foundation to Heavenly Dao Foundation?

It was simple. On the basis of Human Dao Foundation, the impurities within would be removed, and with the essence as the core, the Celestial Foundation would be rebuilt, and that would be the Heavenly Dao Foundation.
Thus, Human Dao Foundation was definitely more perfect than Human Dao Foundation. This was one level higher, so it naturally had a suppressive effect on Human Dao Foundation.

However, to Ling Han, his Human Dao Foundation were already perfect. He could even suppress those at the Ultimate Dao Foundation level. Even Saints and Great Emperors couldn’t make his Human Dao Foundation bow, so how could he advance any further?
However, what could he do now?

If he did not complete a metamorphosis, his cultivation level would be limited to this place. Whatever Cauldron Forging Tier, Core Formation Tier, Saint Tier, Ancestral King, they all had nothing to do with him.
This cultivation was too perfect; could it be that this was a mistake?
Because the foundation stone of the Celestial Path was too perfect, there was actually no way to improve further. If this was known to others, wouldn’t they laugh themselves to death?
How could this be resolved?
“Since I have already cultivated the cornerstone of the Celestial Path to perfection, and am unable to advance into another level, I will change my angle.”
“I will directly build the Heavenly Dao Foundation Stone!”
Ling Han thought internally. No one had stipulated that there could only be one cornerstone of the Celestial Path, right?

This was really the case of the ignorant being fearless. No matter where they were placed, who did not know that the foundation stone of the Celestial Path was one piece? The Heavenly Dao Foundation, the Ultimate Dao Foundation was merely continuing to transform the foundations of the Celestial Path, and finally reach a “perfect” level.
Two, or even three foundation stones of the Celestial Path?
This was unheard of.
“Just because it hasn’t appeared before doesn’t mean that it’s impossible! Perhaps there are Great Emperors and Saints who have long since formed their three foundation stones, but no one knows.”
“However, even if no one has ever reached the three foundation stones before, so what?”
“I, will create history!”
Ling Han left the canyon entrance far behind. Even if more than ten days had passed, who knew if anyone was especially slow? Who knew if they had just passed through the ancient battlefield?

Building the second cornerstone of the Celestial Path was easy to say, but it had never been heard of in history. Putting aside the question of whether it would work or not, even if it did, the difficulty level would definitely be astonishing.
Ling Han sat down in a cross-legged position, and began to build his second cornerstone of the Celestial Path.

He had already experienced it once. This Celestial Foundation building was naturally a walk in the park for him, but the problem was, the second Celestial Dao Foundation had just condensed into a particle, and the original Celestial Dao Foundation seemed to have been threatened. Immediately, with a light tremor, the second Celestial Dao Foundation was shattered.

This was a replica of the primitive Celestial Gate, and could suppress all the foundation stones of the Celestial Path. This was applicable even for Ling Han himself. The newly born foundation stone of the Celestial Path was no match at all, and would crumble with a single shake.

Ling Han was depressed. The foundation stone of the Celestial Path was so perfect that it could not be transformed. If even the second foundation stone could not be built, could it be that his path of cultivation would really be severed?
No way!

Ling Han immediately gathered his confidence. He had never heard of the logic of not being able to advance because he had cultivated to perfection. The reason why he had not built a second foundation stone was because he had not worked hard enough, or rather, he had not found the right method yet.
At night, Ling Han didn’t have a clue anyway, so he stopped breaking through and continued to battle the corpse army. In the end, by the second morning, he had another stamp.

Another day passed, and no matter how he condensed the foundation stone of the Celestial Path, he would still be unable to escape the fate of it being shattered, and the problem was that condensing the foundation stone of the Celestial Path required the price of his life force. Even if it was broken or shattered, the expenditure was real.
In the past two days, he had used up two Treasured Fruits of Life..

Ling Han sat down in a cross-legged position, and began to build his second cornerstone of the Celestial Path.
He had already experienced it once.

This Celestial Foundation building was naturally a walk in the park for him, but the problem was, the second Celestial Dao Foundation had just condensed into a particle, and the original Celestial Dao Foundation seemed to have been threatened.
Immediately, with a light tremor, the second Celestial Dao Foundation was shattered.
This was a replica of the primitive Celestial Gate, and could suppress all the foundation stones of the Celestial Path.
This was applicable even for Ling Han himself.
The newly born foundation stone of the Celestial Path was no match at all, and would crumble with a single shake.
Ling Han was depressed.
The foundation stone of the Celestial Path was so perfect that it could not be transformed.
If even the second foundation stone could not be built, could it be that his path of cultivation would really be severed?
No way!
Ling Han immediately gathered his confidence.
He had never heard of the logic of not being able to advance because he had cultivated to perfection.
The reason why he had not built a second foundation stone was because he had not worked hard enough, or rather, he had not found the right method yet.
At night, Ling Han didn’t have a clue anyway, so he stopped breaking through and continued to battle the corpse army.
In the end, by the second morning, he had another stamp.

Another day passed, and no matter how he condensed the foundation stone of the Celestial Path, he would still be unable to escape the fate of it being shattered, and the problem was that condensing the foundation stone of the Celestial Path required the price of his life force.
Even if it was broken or shattered, the expenditure was real.
In the past two days, he had used up two Treasured Fruits of Life..

chapters.title: Chapter 3721: Second Celestial Foundation
paragraphs: Chapter 3721: Second Celestial Foundation
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations

Because he hadn’t entered into prime condition, Ling Han would still battle with the army of corpses at night. On one hand, he would continue to “collect stamps”, and on the other, it was also to vent his frustration. After all, anyone would be extremely displeased if this happened to them.
Was it wrong for me to cultivate to perfection?
There was definitely a way. Worse come to worst, he could just demolish the Celestial Foundation, and then cultivate the Celestial Foundation again.
But this would definitely be a great waste.
As Ling Han battled, he thought about how he could build the second foundation stone of the Celestial Path.
In fact, it wasn’t difficult to construct. What was difficult was how to protect it from being shattered by the first foundation stone.
A night passed, and he came up with a bold idea.
‘Let’s try it!’
When the sun shone brightly, Ling Han immediately sat down in a cross-legged position, ingested a Treasured Fruit of Life, and began to break through to Heavenly Dao Foundation again.
Weng, he drew out the foundation stone of the Celestial Path. Since you are affecting me from building my second Celestial Foundation inside my body, then I just have to get you out, all right?
However, in this way, his attention would definitely be divided, but breaking through was a matter that required his full concentration. This would be very dangerous, and he did not want to go mad.

If it was any other person, they would definitely not take such risks like Ling Han. Even if it was a risk, they would definitely find a senior of their sect or clan to watch over them. If they really encountered danger, their senior could also immediately suppress their injuries and treat them.
But where was Ling Han going to find one now?
Even if he returned to Celestial Sea Planet, he could only look for Brother
Monkey and Chen Fengyan.

However, Brother Monkey was suppressed at the foot of the mountain, so he could only produce a spiritual manifestation. It was uncertain whether it would be able to help him or not, and Chen Fengyan kept hiding and cultivating in seclusion. Seeing him was as difficult as ascending the heavens.

Ling Han was also an impatient person. For such a grand feat like building a second Celestial Foundation, since he had already thought of it, and could already begin, how could he possibly restrain himself?

Cautiously, he formed the second cornerstone of the Celestial Path in his mind. The core took form, but even if he had drawn the first cornerstone of the Celestial Path out of his body, when the second cornerstone took form, it still vibrated slightly, releasing an incredibly majestic might.𝗳𝚛𝗲𝕖𝚠𝚎𝚋𝗻𝗼𝕧𝗲𝐥.𝚌𝚘𝐦
Pa, the core of the second Celestial Foundation immediately exploded.
It still didn’t work.
Ling Han frowned upon seeing this. ‘I’ve already drawn you out, yet you’re still so ruthless?’
Since that was the case, I would completely suppress you.
Ling Han gritted his teeth and summoned the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, using it to suppress the first Celestial Foundation.

He would never allow his precious tool to clash head-on with the foundation stone of the Celestial Path. He only wanted to use the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to suppress the aura released by the first Celestial
Foundation.
The Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower expanded slightly, sending down streaks of Primal Chaos Qi that completely wrapped around the first Celestial
Dao Foundation.
This looked like protection, but in truth, it was a shield.
All right, again.
Ling Han went to form a second Celestial Foundation, and very quickly, the core was formed.
The first Celestial Foundation seemed to have sensed something, and immediately released a wave, that surged towards Ling Han’s mind.
This was harmless to Ling Han himself, but was enough to destroy the newborn cornerstone core of the Celestial Path.
Weng, the Primal Chaos Qi showed its might, blocking this wave.
It was effective!
Ling Han was delighted, but he had not been happy for too long. Pa, the core of the second celestial foundation had already crumbled.
That was because there was still an incredibly weak wave spreading out, and the core of the Celestial Foundation was really too fragile when it had just formed.
Ling Han tried again, but it was useless. The core of the Celestial Foundation continued to shatter.

And this was still because the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower had been forged from Origin Gold. Otherwise, even if it was a Saint Tool that could crush Ling Han into dust with a light tremor, it was still far inferior to the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower when it came to suppressing the fluctuations of the foundation stone of the Celestial Path.
Even the Imperial Weapon was ineffective, so what else could truly suppress the cornerstone of the Celestial Path?
This was not pure power at all, but rather a fundamental connection. He was originally one with the foundation of the Celestial Path, so how could it possibly be completely severed?
They would live together forever, and they would die together.

Thus the effects of external power were limited. Thankfully, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower was forged from Origin Gold. Otherwise, it wouldn’t even have the slightest effect, because this didn’t require any destructive power. Even a Saint Tool wouldn’t be effective.
What could be done?
A thought flashed through Ling Han’s mind. Since external power could not easily restrain it, he would use his internal power.
Power of Dimensions!
With a single thought from him, all the living creatures of the inner world contributed their own spiritual power, turning into a tiny ball of light in Ling
Han’s mind.
Even though it was small, it was condensed from the spiritual power of millions and millions.

He condensed the core of the second Celestial Foundation, while the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower continued to suppress the first Celestial Foundation, weakening the energy fluctuation as much as possible.
Weng, there was still a slight wave of power assailing him, but Ling Han wrapped his spiritual power around his second Celestial Foundation.
The shockwave surged over, and when it touched the ball of light, it was instantly absorbed. However, the ball of light was also being consumed at a very fast speed.
Give me some more power!
Ling Han continued to extract the spiritual power of the beings of the inner worlds, replenishing the expenditure of the ball of light.
On the other hand, his second Celestial Foundation core was rapidly forming and solidifying.

As long as it solidified, then he would have succeeded. Both were of the same quality. Ling Han did not believe that the first Celestial Foundation would be able to shatter the second Celestial Foundation.
Hold on, hold on, hold on!

The first Celestial Foundation was trembling lightly. It was formed from imitating the primitive Celestial Gate, and possessed a supreme status, capable of suppressing all Celestial Foundations. It should have been unique, but now, a second Celestial Foundation that was identical to the primitive Celestial Gate had actually appeared?
This naturally was seen by it as a challenge, that it wanted to suppress and destroy.

Ling Han gritted his teeth, continuously extracting spiritual energy. This wasn’t inexhaustible. In the inner worlds, even for a Seventh Tier Heavenly Venerate, they were slightly weaker than mortals once they came out, so the spiritual energy that each person could provide was truly extraordinarily weak. Thankfully, there were enough of them, and they had condensed and united, which was why they had such amazing effects.
However, extracting too much Spiritual Power could lead to death.
Ling Han made some adjustments. The individual strength was the weakest, so he would no longer extract the essence of the soul.

However, this was actually the largest contribution. With such a stop, the spiritual power that Ling Han extracted instantly decreased by half, and the recovery speed of the ball of light also decreased greatly.
He could clearly “see” that this sphere of light was continuously shrinking, and the core of the second Celestial Foundation was about to be revealed.

However, there was nothing that could be done. Time would not wait for him, so Ling Han could only wait for a second chance. It was impossible for him to sacrifice all the living beings of the inner world.
It should be known that he still had to build his third Celestial Foundation in future, so how could he just kill the goose that lays the golden egg?
Weng, the shockwaves continued, and the ball of light finally dispersed completely.
Ling Han was just about to give up, when an astonishing scene appeared. The second Celestial Foundation also released a wave, which blocked the wave from the first Celestial Foundation.
It didn’t shatter!

Ling Han faltered for a moment, then was overjoyed. As the ball of light continued, he had finally formed the core of his second Celestial Foundation, which had reached a stable enough level. It had finally become the cornerstone of the Celestial Path, and was not just a core.
At present, though it was still very fragile, with the help of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, it was already qualified to stand against the first Celestial Foundation.
Hahahaha!

Ling Han broke into a grin, and hurriedly continued to work hard, continuing to strengthen the second Celestial Foundation. By now, it could only be considered to be in its infancy, and was still far from reaching the stage of taking form..

chapters.title: Chapter 3722: Covered completely
paragraphs: Chapter 3722: Covered completely
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han’s spirit was greatly energized, using his own life essence to nurture the second Celestial Foundation.
This had finally passed the most fragile period. Now, it was like a baby that was crying out for food, greedily absorbing Ling Han’s life energy.
Very soon, Ling Han had no choice but to ingest another Treasured Fruit of Life. Otherwise, his life force would be greatly expended.
However, the second Celestial Foundation was like a bottomless pit. It still hadn’t reached the stage of forming, and continued to absorb life energy.
*F*ck! Are you trying to suck me dry?’

Ling Han mocked internally, but he also knew that what he was building now was a flawless foundation of the Celestial Path, so the expense was naturally great. Furthermore, the Heavenly Dao Foundation of others were all built on the Human Dao Foundation, so the expense was naturally smaller, but for him?
Starting from zero, could this consumption be compared in the same breath?
He was going to give it his all.

Ling Han ate Treasured Fruits of Life one after another. In just a few hours, the nine Treasured Fruits of Life had been completely expended, but the problem was that the second Celestial Foundation was still not completely stabilized.

He had already reached this point, so how could he give up halfway? Ling Han could only grit his teeth, and use his own life force to supply it. Worse come to worst, he could live a few less years. In any case, he was still very young, and a Foundation Building Tier had a lifespan of a thousand years.
After advancing into Heavenly Dao Foundation, one could gain another three hundred years of lifespan. He could just give it his all even if it meant sacrificing these three hundred years, all right?
Boom, right at this moment, a powerful life force suddenly surged out of his body, replacing the expenditure of his lifespan.
Yi, what was this?

Ling Han faltered for a moment before coming to his senses. At the Metal Element Fruit Gathering, he had eaten a few Treasured Fruits that were used to heal life force. At the time, he hadn’t felt any change, but now, it had released its effects.
With the addition of this colossal amount of life energy, the second Celestial Foundation finally stabilized after extracting another portion of life energy. It didn’t extract any more life energy.

Ling Han was a little anxious. His two foundations of the Celestial Path were practically as incompatible as fire and water. If he removed the suppression of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and stored the two Celestial Foundations into his mind, would they directly come to blows?
That was his mind, and if it was damaged, something big would happen.
But they couldn’t stay like this forever, right?
Ling Han put away the Primal Chaos Lightning Tower. Then, he also stored the first Celestial Foundation into his mind.
Instantly, the two foundation stones of the Celestial Path both released an extraordinarily domineering, ancient aura, opposing each other.
Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief. Thankfully, they had not come to blows in the end.
It was good that they had not fought.

The second Celestial Foundation was presently only the size of a soybean, and was far from being able to compare to the first Celestial Foundation that was the size of a well’s lid. However, in terms of quality, it was not the slightest bit inferior, and was enough to stand against the first Celestial Foundation.

Fights couldn’t be started. After all, the Celestial Foundation was still a part of Ling Han’s body. At most, it would only cause minor disturbances. However, previously, the second Celestial Foundation was really too fragile. Even the slightest bit of emotional fluctuation could shatter it.

The power of heaven and earth here was extremely thin, and it was practically impossible to cultivate. Ling Han naturally wouldn’t waste time. He stood up and moved his limbs slightly, experiencing the feeling of majestic power.
From Human Dao Foundation to Heavenly Dao Foundation, this was a leap, enough to increase Ling Han’s battle prowess by two stars.
Now, he could even thrash five-star geniuses of Ultimate Dao Foundation.

Looking at the sky, there was still more than an hour’s time until dark. Ling Han was filled with anticipation. Later, he would use the army of corpses to test out his current strength.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝚠𝕖𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝕖𝚕.𝚌𝗼𝗺
Kuang, just at this moment, thunderclouds rolled out in the skies, gathering towards him.
The heaven’s calamity was coming.
As expected, a human figure of lightning entered Ling Han’s mind, wanting to obliterate his consciousness.
“Die!” the internal demon roared.

“An!” Ling Han directly attacked it with the Six Characters Bright King Curse. After a few dozen attacks, the internal demon’s entire body cracked and shattered. A warm power surged out, nourishing his divine sense and suddenly strengthening it.
The internal demon wasn’t completely useless either. Killing it would release pure energy that could replenish one’s divine sense.
“Father!”
“Ling Han!”
Sixth Baby and Princess Bixiao both ran over. They had seen the dense thunderclouds.

“You actually broke through to Heavenly Dao Foundation here?” Princess Bixiao’s expression was filled with shock. This was really too inconceivable. It should be known that the power of heaven and earth here was completely unsuited to cultivating. How did you do it?

Furthermore, this time was really too short, wasn’t it? She had clearly broken through to Foundation Building Tier first, and had even cultivated for a year in the Holy Land of Metal Element. Such good conditions had not allowed her to break through to Heavenly Dao Foundation, and she still lacked some accumulation.
Ling Han smiled and said, “I just felt like I was about there, and just broke through.”
Something like that could be done?
Princess Bixiao was rendered speechless for a moment. After a while, she finally said, “Then you have been battling constantly these few days. Is it for the sake of breaking through?”
In this way, Ling Han wouldn’t be stupid anymore. On the contrary, he was simply extremely smart.
Ling Han shook his head, “No, this breakthrough was just in passing.”
Pu!
Princess Bixiao instantly coughed, feeling a little injured.
She really could not communicate with this kind of freak.
Since Ling Han had said so, it was clear that he was still unwilling to leave.
At night, Ling Han continued to battle against the army of corpses.

He charged over, and he was like a ferocious dragon as he charged forward. The Starlight Screen spread open, and it could be said that it was unbreakable. No matter how many Skeleton Soldiers attacked him, faced with this kind of defense, they would only be defeated.
On the other hand, Ling Han’s punch was extremely powerful.

He summoned the Heavenly Pattern Jade, compressed it with his Spiritual Power, and shot it out. Peng, peng, peng! This was too terrifying. As the attack passed, an absolute space of three hundred meters long and six meters wide appeared ahead of him. All the skeleton soldiers were blasted into smithereens. Though the Heavenly Pattern Jade was small in size, when it shot out at that kind of high speed, the force it brought with it had exceeded the speed of sound several times over. Furthermore, it had the destructive power of a Two Star material. Thus, the force that seeped out was extremely destructive.
Ling Han charged forward, unleashing the Three Styles of the God of War. Boom! With a single strike, the space within 30 meters of him was reduced to a vacuum.
After three moves, he also rushed to the Heavenly Pattern Jade, and stowed it away.
He continued to test out the might of his various techniques, and only when the sun had risen did he stop. There was no more battle left for him.
Just like before, he was placed with another stamp.
Ling Han smiled faintly. He then sat down in a cross-legged position on the ancient battlefield, and began to temper the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.

It was naturally impossible for him to change the structure of the Origin Gold, but now that his cultivation level had increased, he could naturally strengthen this future Imperial Weapon and increase its strength slightly.

-The starting point for the precious tool was too high. If he advanced a minor level, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower’s improvement would only be negligible. Unless he advanced into the Cauldron Forging Tier, only then would there be a qualitative change.
At night, Ling Han battled again.
By the morning of the second day, he had already accumulated 21 stamps. However, as this night passed, and when the sunlight shone on him, Ling Han was startled. There was no new stamp placed on him.
Yi, he had reached his limit?
Ling Han nodded in understanding. Since that was the case, he would take his leave.
He beckoned Princess Bixiao and Sixth Baby over, saying, “Let s go..

Even the slightest bit of emotional fluctuation could shatter it.
The power of heaven and earth here was extremely thin, and it was practically impossible to cultivate.
Ling Han naturally wouldn’t waste time.
He stood up and moved his limbs slightly, experiencing the feeling of majestic power.
From Human Dao Foundation to Heavenly Dao Foundation, this was a leap, enough to increase Ling Han’s battle prowess by two stars.
Now, he could even thrash five-star geniuses of Ultimate Dao Foundation.
Looking at the sky, there was still more than an hour’s time until dark.
Ling Han was filled with anticipation.
Later, he would use the army of corpses to test out his current strength.𝚏𝗿𝗲𝐞𝚠𝕖𝐛𝗻𝗼𝐯𝕖𝚕.𝚌𝗼𝗺
Kuang, just at this moment, thunderclouds rolled out in the skies, gathering towards him.
The heaven’s calamity was coming.
As expected, a human figure of lightning entered Ling Han’s mind, wanting to obliterate his consciousness.
“Die!” the internal demon roared.
“An!” Ling Han directly attacked it with the Six Characters Bright King Curse.
After a few dozen attacks, the internal demon’s entire body cracked and shattered.
A warm power surged out, nourishing his divine sense and suddenly strengthening it.
The internal demon wasn’t completely useless either.
Killing it would release pure energy that could replenish one’s divine sense.
“Father!”
“Ling Han!”
Sixth Baby and Princess Bixiao both ran over.
They had seen the dense thunderclouds.
“You actually broke through to Heavenly Dao Foundation here?” Princess Bixiao’s expression was filled with shock.
This was really too inconceivable.
It should be known that the power of heaven and earth here was completely unsuited to cultivating.
How did you do it?
Furthermore, this time was really too short, wasn’t it?
She had clearly broken through to Foundation Building Tier first, and had even cultivated for a year in the Holy Land of Metal Element.
Such good conditions had not allowed her to break through to Heavenly Dao Foundation, and she still lacked some accumulation.
Ling Han smiled and said, “I just felt like I was about there, and just broke through.”
Something like that could be done?
Princess Bixiao was rendered speechless for a moment.
After a while, she finally said, “Then you have been battling constantly these few days.
Is it for the sake of breaking through?”
In this way, Ling Han wouldn’t be stupid anymore.
On the contrary, he was simply extremely smart.
Ling Han shook his head, “No, this breakthrough was just in passing.”
Pu!
Princess Bixiao instantly coughed, feeling a little injured.
She really could not communicate with this kind of freak.
Since Ling Han had said so, it was clear that he was still unwilling to leave.
At night, Ling Han continued to battle against the army of corpses.
He charged over, and he was like a ferocious dragon as he charged forward.
The Starlight Screen spread open, and it could be said that it was unbreakable.
No matter how many Skeleton Soldiers attacked him, faced with this kind of defense, they would only be defeated.
On the other hand, Ling Han’s punch was extremely powerful.
He summoned the Heavenly Pattern Jade, compressed it with his Spiritual Power, and shot it out.
Peng, peng, peng!
This was too terrifying.
As the attack passed, an absolute space of three hundred meters long and six meters wide appeared ahead of him.
All the skeleton soldiers were blasted into smithereens.
Though the Heavenly Pattern Jade was small in size, when it shot out at that kind of high speed, the force it brought with it had exceeded the speed of sound several times over.
Furthermore, it had the destructive power of a Two Star material.
Thus, the force that seeped out was extremely destructive.
Ling Han charged forward, unleashing the Three Styles of the God of War.
Boom!
With a single strike, the space within 30 meters of him was reduced to a vacuum.
After three moves, he also rushed to the Heavenly Pattern Jade, and stowed it away.
He continued to test out the might of his various techniques, and only when the sun had risen did he stop.
There was no more battle left for him.
Just like before, he was placed with another stamp.
Ling Han smiled faintly.
He then sat down in a cross-legged position on the ancient battlefield, and began to temper the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.

It was naturally impossible for him to change the structure of the Origin Gold, but now that his cultivation level had increased, he could naturally strengthen this future Imperial Weapon and increase its strength slightly.
-The starting point for the precious tool was too high.
If he advanced a minor level, the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower’s improvement would only be negligible.
Unless he advanced into the Cauldron Forging Tier, only then would there be a qualitative change.
At night, Ling Han battled again.
By the morning of the second day, he had already accumulated 21 stamps.
However, as this night passed, and when the sunlight shone on him, Ling Han was startled.
There was no new stamp placed on him.
Yi, he had reached his limit?
Ling Han nodded in understanding.
Since that was the case, he would take his leave.
He beckoned Princess Bixiao and Sixth Baby over, saying, “Let s go..

paragraphs: Chapter 3723: Chapter 3725’A favour from me is more than
100 Dao Stones
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Princess Bixiao faltered for a moment before coming to her senses.
Her beautiful eyes were filled with confusion, “We’re leaving? Why?”
■Is there any need to ask why? Haven’t you always wanted to leave?’
After staying for too long, she thought that Ling Han would continue fighting until the Mystery Realm closed.
Ling Han chuckled. Looks like this princess of the Demon Race had been bored silly.
“Let’s go, let’s go. This place is boring. What’s the point of staying here?”
‘Boring, but you’ve already stayed here for 20 days?’
Princess Bixiao was powerless to complain.
“Hehe, Father is so fun,” Sixth Baby said with a chuckle.
Princess Bixiao rolled her eyes. This baby had already been led astray by Ling
Han.
The three of them set out, heading towards the canyon.

The canyon was very long and wide. The mountain walls on either side were more than 50km away, but they were as high as thirty thousand meters, piercing straight into the clouds, making for an incredibly grand sight.
“Father, doesn’t this canyon look like it was cut out with a single slash?” Sixth Baby asked.

Ling Han was taken aback. ‘Oh, that’s right. The passageway to this canyon is a little too straight, isn’t it?’ Furthermore, looking at the mountain walls on either side, though they had been corroded by the winds and frosts of time, and were mottled, it could still be seen that they should have been incredibly smooth all those years ago.
Though the power of creation of nature was amazing, to create this kind of canyon was really too inconceivable.
It would be more logical to say that it had been manually excavated.
Was it the Ancient Sun Saint?

With a slash of the sword, a majestic great mountain was severed in half. Ling Han couldn’t help but sigh in admiration. The power of a Saint was truly extraordinary. The power of a single slash had actually reached such a level.
No wonder it was rumored that Saints could easily shatter the stars in the skies. This should not be an exaggeration.
The three of them walked for a while, and saw that a crowd had appeared ahead of them.
Yi, why were these people still here?

Previously, Ling Han had been at the canyon entrance, but after seeing wave after wave of people enter into the canyon, the latest batch to enter was also quite a few days ago, but now, they were actually all here.
Was there any treasure?
Ling Han was instantly in high spirits. After entering into the Moon Occult Mystery Realm, he still hadn’t obtained a single treasure. This made him slightly displeased.
And this was a Mystery Realm built by a Saint? How stingy.
He approached, but was soon disappointed.
These people had gathered here not because of some treasure, but because there was a formation of rocks ahead of them. It was very, very difficult to pass through.

It wasn’t that it couldn’t be passed. Many people had already passed, but it would take a long time to sort out the routes inside. This involved a very complicated deduction and took a very long time. Thus, those who came later were stuck here.
Was it a formation?

Ling Han’s interest was piqued. Ordinarily, there were two ways to break through a labyrinth. The first was to deduce all the variations, and one would naturally be able to walk out. The second was to directly suppress the formation.
The first method was suitable for cultivators with lower abilities, and the second method was suitable for Formation Masters and cultivators with higher abilities.

There was nothing much to say about Formation Master breaking formations, and when one’s strength reached a certain extent, he could break through a planet with a single punch, so what formation would be able to suppress him?

It should be known that formations were meant to manipulate the power of heaven and earth, and make use of the power of heaven and earth. Then, if even the power of heaven and earth could be suppressed, what use would formations be?
However, this was a formation set up by a Saint. Even if it wasn’t Saint-level, it naturally couldn’t be forcefully broken through by a Foundation Building Tier cultivator.
Thus, everyone could only use the first method, deducing all the variations, and then pass.
This required time to observe and grasp all the possible variations. “Brother Ling, you’re a Formation Master, so why don’t we follow you?” someone immediately approached.
“Brother Ling, bring me along.” There were a lot of shameless people, and another person approached.
“Take me too.”
“Me too.”

Although most of the people here were prodigies, and even if they didn’t need the help of others, as long as they were willing to spend time, they would be able to deduce all the variations in this stone formation no matter what.
However, if they could save time, why not?
Ling Han smiled, and said, “Alright, give me a hundred Dao Stones each, and
I’ll bring you along.”
Everyone couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat. ‘Just how greedy are you?
You still want to earn a sum at a time like this?

“Brother Ling the favor I would owe you is not worth just a hundred Dao Stones!” someone immediately said. They felt that Ling Han did not know the rules of the game. A great many of them came from great sects and noble clans, and being able to help them was actually also beneficial to Ling Han. Ling Han glanced at him, and said with a smile, “En, it was my oversight.” That person was instantly proud, and felt that he had gained a lot of face.
-Your favour is worth more than too Dao Stones, so I’ll accept 1000 from you,” Ling Han said.
That person’s expression instantly crumbled, becoming very, very dark.
This was a slap to the face.
‘My favors are valuable, yet you’re charging me more money. What kind of logic is that?’
pu quite a number of people laughed out loud. Their backgrounds were similarly extraordinary, and there was absolutely no need for them to be wary of that person.
That person flew into a humiliated rage, pointed at Ling Han, and said, “Ling Han, I’m giving you face so don’t throw it onto the ground!”
Pa, Ling Han delivered a palm strike, and that person instantly fell onto the ground. “I hate it the most when someone threatens me, and also hate it when someone bargains with me!”
With this palm strike, even those who had been laughing earlier shut their mouths, a powerful chill rising up from the bottom of their hearts.
The guy that had been knocked over was called Zuo Zishi. He had an extraordinary background, and he himself was a one-star genius of Dao Foundation.
But it was this kind of elite that had actually been smacked onto the ground with a single palm strike from Ling Han?
Gasp! Just how powerful was Ling Han?

Previously, everyone had been very cordial and polite. That was because of Ling Han’s status as a Formation Master, but whether it was an alchemist or a Formation Master, they could not possibly win the true respect of cultivators. At most, they could only be polite and cordial.
But now that Ling Han had displayed powerful strength, it was a completely different story.

Cultivators valued abilities the most, and Ling Han’s strength was strong enough. In fact, Ling Han’s strength even made them feel a chill in their hearts. Ling Han swept an eye over the masses, “too Dao Stones, thanks for your patronage.”
“Haha, Brother Ling is willing to lead the way for us, so how could we not be grateful?” Immediately, someone changed his words, and handed over a hundred Dao Stones.

Ling Han stowed the Dao Stones away without any reservations. Though these people all had connection devices, and the majority of their wealth had been converted into the form of Universe Coins, they would definitely still have some Dao Stones on them. There would definitely be places where the Galaxy Network was not connected, or they would need to actually use Dao Stones for transactions.

Furthermore, there were two types of Dao Stones. The first was naturally formed by the power of heaven and earth, and the second was formed by elites using their own comprehension of martial arts to condense the power of heaven and earth, but whichever it was, it could help cultivators cultivate.
Thus, everyone would usually bring some Dao Stones with them, so they could appreciate the power of heaven and earth at any time, as well as the elites’ understanding of martial arts.
Ling Han didn’t ask for too much because he knew that these people couldn’t possibly carry too many Dao Stones with them.
One hundred per person, and if there were many of them, that would also be a considerable gain.
Sigh, he had to quickly get his own connection device and register his own account. Otherwise, even earning money would be difficult..

chapters.title: Chapter 3724: Swampland
paragraphs: Chapter 3724: Swampland
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations

Not everyone was willing to be exploited by Ling Han. Furthermore, some people had also studied it for a long time, and thought that they would soon be able to deduce all the variations in the formation, so there was naturally no need for them to depend on Ling Han.
A total of 72 people handed over their Dao Stones. Going by that calculation, Ling Han had instantly earned 7200 Dao Stones. This speed of earning money was not the slightest bit slower than robbery.
From the look of things, Formation Master was also a good money-making profession.
Ling Han smiled. Since he had accepted the money from them, he still had his own professional ethics.
He entered into the formation, and began to study it.
Even when a Formation Master was breaking a formation, he still had to observe the formation first. Without a clear understanding, how could he possibly break the formation right off the bat?

At present, he only knew how to set up a single formation, but his understanding of formations was already very deep. Furthermore, setting up a formation and breaking it were two different things, because it was always easier to destroy than to construct.
Not long after, he already had a considerable understanding.
He was already confident that he could break the formation, so he said to
everyone, “Come, follow me.”𝙛𝒓𝓮𝙚𝔀𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝒐𝒎

Everyone followed. After Ling Han had walked for a while, he threw out a formation foundation. Instantly, the area ahead of him that was originally entwined in mist was now clear and bright, and could be seen clearly.
“As expected of Brother Ling’s natural talent in formations.”
“It’s only been a short while, and you’ve already seen through this formation
and deciphered it. We’re impressed.”

Everyone did not hide their words of praise. As for Ling Han, he only smiled upon hearing this. Elites did not need to be praised, because they had enough confidence. It would be more practical to give a few more Dao Stones.
After walking for a while, Ling Han inserted the second formation foundation.
Then, he walked back and put away the first formation foundation.
Right now, formation foundations were extremely valuable, so it was naturally impossible that they could only be used once.
Continuously travelling like this, their speed wasn’t fast, but they didn’t take the wrong path either. In less than half an hour, everyone walked out from the other side of the rock formation.
And this was still within the canyon. This stone formation was like a barrier, stopping a great many people.

Everyone continued onwards. However, the ability to fly was restricted here, yet the speed of their sprint was practically unaffected. Not too long after, they had already reached the end of the canyon. Ahead of them, a precipice appeared, and there was a very large cave on the precipice.

Some people wanted to climb the precipice, but flight was not allowed here, so when they climbed to a higher height, they would be crushed by a terrifying pressure. Even Ling Han announced that he would give up after trying it out once.
This pressure was too terrifying. It was not something that could be endured just by gritting one’s teeth.
Then they would just enter the cave. This should be the next stop.
The cave was large enough, so they didn’t need to walk in a single file. They could walk side by side.
The cave wasn’t pitch-black, as some of the rocks would actually glow.
Although it wasn’t very bright, it was enough to allow one to see.
They were advancing underground, and after advancing for a distance, the mountain cave was becoming narrower and narrower, and the line that they formed became longer and thinner.
Slightly less than half a day later, the line that had initially been parallel had completely become a long line.

Ling Han didn’t stubbornly walk in front. Whoever wanted to take the lead would just have to walk in front. His left hand carried Sixth Baby, while Princess Bixiao followed behind him. They were both in the middle.

After walking for so long, they should have gone deep underground, but there was no obvious change in the temperature. It was just that the humidity had increased, and the walls of the cave were wet. There was water everywhere.
“We’re finally out!” someone cried out, filled with joy.
“Yi, there is actually a moon in the skies!”
“That can’t be, right? We are underground, so how could there be a moon?”
The people in front of him all exclaimed, filled with shock.
Ling Han also walked out. As expected, there was a golden full moon hanging in the skies, decorated with stars, just like a normal night sky.
However, this was impossible.
Ling Han activated his eye technique and looked at the sky. Instantly, he saw something different.

This moon was only tens of thousands of meters away from him, and it was only a massive round rock. There were multiple golden veined patterns on it, as if it was embedded with metal, and that was why it was exuding a golden brilliance.
If it had to be claimed that this was a moon, it was also artificially created.
A Saint’s techniques were indeed extraordinary. Not only could he easily
shatter the stars, he could even create a moon.
“Yi, why is there no way back?” someone asked in surprise.
Ling Han looked back, and sure enough, the cave entrance that they had come out of previously had strangely disappeared.
Was this a smokescreen?
He groped around on the mountain wall, but could not find the cave mouth no matter how hard he tried.
It was useless even if they blasted it. This was a solid mountain, and there was no cave at all.
Everyone clicked their tongues in amazement. It was obviously impossible for them to go back the way they had come, so they could only continue onwards.
“Since we are already here, we’ll take things as they come.”
“With so many people, who should we be afraid of?”
Everyone appeared to be filled with confidence, and walked forwards one after another.
This was a plain, but there was no grass growing here. Instead, there was dark red moss. Under the golden moonlight, it exuded a strange aura.
“Have you guys realized that there is something off about this place?” someone asked.
“That’s right. It’s too quiet here, and there doesn’t seem to be any life here — aside from these mosses.”
“Yes.”
As soon as they finished speaking, they saw the first living being that could move. That was a cockroach.
“I hate cockroaches the most.” A female cultivator raised her foot, and pa, stomped this cockroach to death.
Don’t say, there were quite a lot of cockroaches here, but this thing basically wouldn’t make any sound. Hence, the entire plain was extremely silent.
“Why does this look like a ghost land?”
“That’s right, I think so too.”
Though there were plants here, as well as living creatures that could move, they still gave off a harrowing feeling.
As they walked, the moon gradually set. However, there was no sun, and they could only see the hazy light in the sky.
This was underground, so it was already very impressive that there was such light. How could it be that they would really be hoping to see the sun?
That would be too unrealistic.
They all headed in a certain direction, and after traversing a few mountains, a stretch of waters and meadows appeared ahead of them.

They walked up, and immediately discovered that this was actually a swamp. Thankfully, with their strength, they only needed to channel mystical power, and they would naturally be able to make themselves as light as a feather. There was absolutely no need for them to worry that they would be trapped.
“Wu, so smelly.” Sixth Baby immediately covered her nose.
Although Princess Bixiao didn’t speak, her expression wasn’t any better.
It was indeed smelly. This swamp was practically a smelly pool, and the stench directly seeped into their noses, making them want to vomit.
However, were they going to turn around just because it was smelly? Impossible, and there was no way back either. The path that they had come from did not exist at all.

Everyone could only brace themselves and walk forwards. After walking for more than ten minutes, with a splash, the surface of the water split open, and mud flew everywhere. A smell that was several hundred times worse spread out, instantly causing many people’s faces to turn green.
Right at this moment, a colossal creature also scuttled out of the water, biting towards a cultivator.

everyone, “Come, follow me.”𝙛𝒓𝓮𝙚𝔀𝒆𝒃𝓷𝒐𝓿𝙚𝓵.𝙘𝒐𝒎
Everyone followed.
After Ling Han had walked for a while, he threw out a formation foundation.
Instantly, the area ahead of him that was originally entwined in mist was now clear and bright, and could be seen clearly.
“As expected of Brother Ling’s natural talent in formations.”
“It’s only been a short while, and you’ve already seen through this formation
and deciphered it.
We’re impressed.”
Everyone did not hide their words of praise.
As for Ling Han, he only smiled upon hearing this.
Elites did not need to be praised, because they had enough confidence.
It would be more practical to give a few more Dao Stones.
After walking for a while, Ling Han inserted the second formation foundation.
Then, he walked back and put away the first formation foundation.
Right now, formation foundations were extremely valuable, so it was naturally impossible that they could only be used once.
Continuously travelling like this, their speed wasn’t fast, but they didn’t take the wrong path either.
In less than half an hour, everyone walked out from the other side of the rock formation.
And this was still within the canyon.
This stone formation was like a barrier, stopping a great many people.
Everyone continued onwards.
However, the ability to fly was restricted here, yet the speed of their sprint was practically unaffected.
Not too long after, they had already reached the end of the canyon.
Ahead of them, a precipice appeared, and there was a very large cave on the precipice.
Some people wanted to climb the precipice, but flight was not allowed here, so when they climbed to a higher height, they would be crushed by a terrifying pressure.
Even Ling Han announced that he would give up after trying it out once.
This pressure was too terrifying.
It was not something that could be endured just by gritting one’s teeth.
Then they would just enter the cave.
This should be the next stop.
The cave was large enough, so they didn’t need to walk in a single file.
They could walk side by side.
The cave wasn’t pitch-black, as some of the rocks would actually glow.
Although it wasn’t very bright, it was enough to allow one to see.
They were advancing underground, and after advancing for a distance, the mountain cave was becoming narrower and narrower, and the line that they formed became longer and thinner.
Slightly less than half a day later, the line that had initially been parallel had completely become a long line.
Ling Han didn’t stubbornly walk in front.
Whoever wanted to take the lead would just have to walk in front.
His left hand carried Sixth Baby, while Princess Bixiao followed behind him.
They were both in the middle.
After walking for so long, they should have gone deep underground, but there was no obvious change in the temperature.
It was just that the humidity had increased, and the walls of the cave were wet.
There was water everywhere.
“We’re finally out!” someone cried out, filled with joy.
“Yi, there is actually a moon in the skies!”
“That can’t be, right?
We are underground, so how could there be a moon?”
The people in front of him all exclaimed, filled with shock.
Ling Han also walked out.
As expected, there was a golden full moon hanging in the skies, decorated with stars, just like a normal night sky.
However, this was impossible.
Ling Han activated his eye technique and looked at the sky.
Instantly, he saw something different.
This moon was only tens of thousands of meters away from him, and it was only a massive round rock.
There were multiple golden veined patterns on it, as if it was embedded with metal, and that was why it was exuding a golden brilliance.
If it had to be claimed that this was a moon, it was also artificially created.
A Saint’s techniques were indeed extraordinary.
Not only could he easily
shatter the stars, he could even create a moon.
“Yi, why is there no way back?” someone asked in surprise.
Ling Han looked back, and sure enough, the cave entrance that they had come out of previously had strangely disappeared.
Was this a smokescreen?
He groped around on the mountain wall, but could not find the cave mouth no matter how hard he tried.
It was useless even if they blasted it.
This was a solid mountain, and there was no cave at all.
Everyone clicked their tongues in amazement.
It was obviously impossible for them to go back the way they had come, so they could only continue onwards.
“Since we are already here, we’ll take things as they come.”
“With so many people, who should we be afraid of?”
Everyone appeared to be filled with confidence, and walked forwards one after another.
This was a plain, but there was no grass growing here.
Instead, there was dark red moss.
Under the golden moonlight, it exuded a strange aura.
“Have you guys realized that there is something off about this place?” someone asked.
“That’s right.
It’s too quiet here, and there doesn’t seem to be any life here — aside from these mosses.”
“Yes.”
As soon as they finished speaking, they saw the first living being that could move.
That was a cockroach.
“I hate cockroaches the most.” A female cultivator raised her foot, and pa, stomped this cockroach to death.
Don’t say, there were quite a lot of cockroaches here, but this thing basically wouldn’t make any sound.
Hence, the entire plain was extremely silent.
“Why does this look like a ghost land?”
“That’s right, I think so too.”
Though there were plants here, as well as living creatures that could move, they still gave off a harrowing feeling.
As they walked, the moon gradually set.
However, there was no sun, and they could only see the hazy light in the sky.
This was underground, so it was already very impressive that there was such light.
How could it be that they would really be hoping to see the sun?
That would be too unrealistic.
They all headed in a certain direction, and after traversing a few mountains, a stretch of waters and meadows appeared ahead of them.
They walked up, and immediately discovered that this was actually a swamp.
Thankfully, with their strength, they only needed to channel mystical power, and they would naturally be able to make themselves as light as a feather.
There was absolutely no need for them to worry that they would be trapped.
“Wu, so smelly.” Sixth Baby immediately covered her nose.
Although Princess Bixiao didn’t speak, her expression wasn’t any better.
It was indeed smelly.
This swamp was practically a smelly pool, and the stench directly seeped into their noses, making them want to vomit.
However, were they going to turn around just because it was smelly?
Impossible, and there was no way back either.
The path that they had come from did not exist at all.
Everyone could only brace themselves and walk forwards.
After walking for more than ten minutes, with a splash, the surface of the water split open, and mud flew everywhere.
A smell that was several hundred times worse spread out, instantly causing many people’s faces to turn green.
Right at this moment, a colossal creature also scuttled out of the water, biting towards a cultivator.

chapters.title: Chapter 3725:100 Dao Stones, thanks
paragraphs: Chapter 3725:100 Dao Stones, thanks
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
What was this thing?
Ling Han activated his eye technique, and in an instant, he had a panoramic view of every single detail of that colossal creature.
Loach?

This thing was definitely a loach. It was completely black, and there wer long whiskers at the corners of its mouth. However, when its mouth opened, it revealed terrifying fangs, exuding a cold glare, as if they were forged from Divine Metal.
“Go!”
Although the loach had caught them off guard, the people here were all prodigy-level, so they could react extremely quickly. Immediately, three people moved together, blasting towards the loach.
The force of the blow landed, but the loach’s skin was extremely slippery. The force of the blow slid away, and could not injure it in the slightest.
However, the loach’s body was still beaten to a slight slant, and did not manage to bite its target.
Shua, the loach suddenly flicked its tail, and with a massive wave of power, the three people that were facing it were instantly sent flying.
Tong! Tong! Tong!

The three of them fell into the water at the same time, and the loach also fell into the water. Immediately, it dived into the water. Gururu, only bubbles appeared, but there was no sign of this big guy.
“Be careful!” someone hurriedly shouted at a person who had fallen into the water.

That person spread out a shield of mystical power to stop the invasion of the dirty water. That would stink for a few days and nights. Just at this moment, an undercurrent surged from below. Hua, that loach appeared again, biting out at him.
With a crack, the entire lower half of that person’s body was bitten into the loach’s mouth. Countless sharp fangs bit onto the mystical power shield, and brilliant light flashed wildly.

Its bite was astonishing, and it was rapidly expending the mystical power shield, and once the mystical power shield disappeared, that person would definitely not be able to withstand those two rows of sharp fangs that seemed to have been forged from Divine Metal.
The loach was still very smart. It kept biting people and dragging them underwater. That was its home ground.

That person hurriedly struggled with all his might. If he was dragged underwater, his battle prowess would definitely drop by another level, and it would be difficult for others to save him. This water was too dirty, and there was mud everywhere, which greatly affected vision.
“Humph!” Ling Han charged over and threw a punch. A terrifying power surged.

The loach tugged twice, wanting to drag its prey into the water, but that person struggled with all his might. After all, he was also a prodigy of Heavenly Dao Foundation. It would be difficult for it to do so in a short while, so it had no choice but to loosen its bite, and turn around and dive.
—It could sense how terrifying the power of Ling Han’s punch was, because the Heavenly Dao Flames were entwined around it.

“Still trying to escape?” Ling Han smirked coldly, and waved his fist on the water’s surface. Boom, a terrifying force broke through the water’s surface. Heavenly Dao Flames was extremely violent, and wherever it touched, large amounts of liquid evaporated, heading straight for that loach.

The loach released a squeak, and tried its best to dodge, yet was completely unable to do so. It was still struck head-on by the Heavenly Dao Flames, and instantly combusted, emitting a charred smell. However, there was no aroma of meat wafting out. Instead, it was extremely smelly.
It lived forever in this kind of filthy water, and the stench had already penetrated deep into its bones and internal organs, and could not be dispersed.
“Thank you.” The person who had been saved hurriedly thanked Ling Han.
“100 Dao Stones, thanks,” Ling Han said to that person with a smile.
That person was instantly dumbfounded. Have you become greedy for money?
“You’re not saying that your life isn’t even worth 100 Dao Stones, are you?” Ling Han said in an exaggerated tone.

That person hurriedly took out a hundred Dao Stones and handed them over. If he didn’t pay these hundred Dao Stones, he would be laughed at by others in future. The only son of the dignified True Lord Ma was actually not worth a hundred Dao Stones?
Ling Han put away the Dao Stones and picked up Sixth Baby again, walking ahead of them.
Hua, the mud split apart, and another colossal loach scuttled out, charging towards Ling Han.
“Are you seeking death?” Ling Han asked coldly. He shot out a punch. It was very simple, but it was entwined with the Heavenly Dao Flames, so its might was incredibly terrifying.
Peng!
The punch landed, and a hole appeared on the loach’s body.

Originally, its body was slippery and unaffected by force, but with the power of Ling Han’s punch wrapped with the Heavenly Dao Flames, this wasn’t a simple power attack. It directly burned through its body, and the terrifying power carried out a second attack. This naturally maximized its destructive power.
Ling Han didn’t even glance at it, and left with his head held high.
The big loach struggled a few times, and soon stopped. It was completely dead.

When everyone saw this, they all looked stunned. This battle prowess was too terrifying, wasn’t it? When others delivered a blow, they couldn’t even break through the big loach’s skin, and this guy had punched a hole in it with a single punch. The contrast was stark.
This was natural. At present, Ling Han was confident that he could completely thrash even a five-star genius of Ultimate Dao Foundation. So, what was a big loach worth?
Some women revealed smitten expressions. A prodigy Formation Master, and astonishing natural talent in martial arts… this was a rising star.

Moreover, Ling Han was a native of this backward place, so his background could be said to be very clean. If he could marry into their clan, their clan would definitely add another helping hand in the future.

With this in mind, the gazes that these women directed at Princess Bixiao were no longer so friendly. They only felt that she was an eyesore. If Ling Han wasn’t here, they would definitely push Princess Bixiao into the water, so that she would drown, or be eaten by the giant loach.

With Ling Han leading the way ahead, the group was naturally unobstructed, and the more time passed, the more stunned they were. What was the Mystery Realm that Ling Han had opened when he was in Mystery Realm Tier? The mystical power that was stored inside was too shocking, wasn’t it?
Some big loaches chose to attack the others, and Ling Han couldn’t be bothered to make a move. He wasn’t a babysitter, and had no obligation to do so.
Of course, if someone was willing to offer a hundred Dao Stones, he wouldn’t mind giving them a hand.
Thankfully, everyone was prepared, so it was not difficult to disperse the attack of the big loach, and there was no mishap.

The day passed, and night fell. They still hadn’t walked out of the swamp, so they continued their journey. There was no way to rest here. As long as they stopped releasing their mystical power, they would fall into the mud. The stench alone was enough to kill.
After walking for another midnight, they finally walked out of the swamp area.
Ahead of them was a rugged stone plain. The rocks rose and fell, and dark moss similarly grew on the rocks.
Everyone also walked over the ups and downs. After walking for over another 50km, a valley appeared ahead of them. Walking in, they discovered that there were stone houses everywhere in the valley.
However, the stone houses were all empty, and had been abandoned for a very long time. There was a thick layer of dust accumulated on the stone tables and beds.
“Logically speaking, someone should have lived here before.”
“Judging by the size of the furniture, this race is extremely tall. The height of adults is at least nine feet.”
“There are too many tribes that meet this criteria, and we can’t determine which tribe it is based on this.”
Everyone searched the stone houses, and then pieced together the clues.
“There’s another question. Those who entered here before us… where did they go?”
That’s right. They were not the first people that had entered here, so what about the people from before?
“Hey, come and take a look!” someone called out.

Everyone followed the sound, and saw a corpse that had already turned into bones lying on the ground inside a stone house. They could clearly see that the skeleton of this corpse was astonishing, and it must have been tall and sturdy when it was alive..
