chapters.title: Chapter 3726: High Priest of the Wolf Tribe
paragraphs: Chapter 3726: High Priest of the Wolf Tribe
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han also walked over to observe this corpse.
This looked very similar to a human, but was definitely not a human.
It was not because it was too tall, but rather that the details of its head, hands, feet and so on were very far from that of humans.
“Werewolf or Pantherman,” someone said.
The part of the mouth protruded, and the fingernails on his hands and feet were long and sharp. He completely looked like a beastman that had not completely taken human form.
“En.” The others all expressed their agreement.
In the past, there had been many werewolves or panthermen living here. It was also possible that the beastmen had destroyed the residents here. Was this the corpse of an invader?
“Worthless,” someone said with a shake of their head.
The others all shook their heads. Indeed, what did such a corpse reveal? What clues could it give?
“More importantly, where did those people go?” someone asked.
“I took a look. This is a dead end valley, and there is no other way to leave.”
“Moreover, we didn’t find any crossroads along the way.
“That’s strange.”
Everyone was puzzled, and a strong feeling of confusion rose up in them.
“Hehe, are you guys looking for me?” A voice rang out, causing everyone to turn around and look.
A man was striding over, a smile on his face.
“You are Xu Guanglin!”
“Didn’t you pass the formation of rocks long ago?”
“That’s right. You are not from our batch.”
A great many people recognized this man, and immediately called out his identity.
“Xu Guanglin, where did you come from?”
“Where are the others?”
Everyone was talking at once.
Xu Guanglin smiled slightly, “Come with me. I will bring you to a place, and the mystery will naturally be solved.”
Everyone looked at each other, wondering if this was a trap.

However, they hadn’t obtained the inheritance of the Saint, so what was the point of Xu Guanglin harming them? Moreover, their strength wasn’t weak, so what need was there for them to be afraid? Moreover, they had already entered a dead end, so there was nothing better to do here.
“Let’s go.”
Everyone followed Xu Guanglin, and saw that this guy had brought them into a stone house. He moved aside the stone bed inside, and a secret passage actually appeared.
Oh, no wonder this guy had suddenly popped out. As it turned out, it was because there was a secret passage through which they could go.
Xu Guanglin took the lead, and everyone followed behind him.

The tunnel was very long, and after walking for half an hour, they finally walked out of the secret passage. Suddenly, the path ahead of them became clear, revealing a small valley. There was flowing water, and colorful stones were glowing.
“Welcome to… the Holy Land of the Wolf Tribe!” Xu Guanglin turned around and said to everyone.
Holy Land of the Wolf Tribe?
Was that the Werewolf Valley before? Then the one who had died was also a Werewolf?
“Come, follow me. You guys will soon unravel all the mysteries.” Xu Guanglin smiled, and continued to lead the way.
Not long after, they saw a large group of people either sitting or standing, or pacing back and forth.
These were all people who had passed through the stone formation earlier and entered into this space.

Everyone greeted each other. There were a great many people here that knew each other. Some had even formed alliances before, but they had been separated after entering this place, and did not get together.
Ling Han swept his gaze around, but did not see Zhuang Bufan.
Yi, where was this guy?
What exactly is going on here?” someone couldn’t help but ask.
Don’t be impatient. Someone will answer your questions.”
“Who?”
“This old man.” An old voice rang out, causing those who had just arrived to all turn to look at him.

This was a tall, broad-shouldered man. His whole body was enshrouded in a cloak, and he was as tall as ten feet. He was a few heads taller than the majority of people. Wherever he stood, anyone would lose their luster from his brilliance.
His left hand held a black walking stick, which seemed to be extremely heavy. When it landed on the ground, it emitted a muffled ‘tong’, and the whole valley shook.
Ling Han swept an eye over him, and could already see that this man’s left hand that was holding a walking stick was furry, and the tips of his fingers were extraordinarily long, like small knives.
“I am the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe.” This tall man stopped, and used his right hand to remove the cloak on his head, revealing a furry face.
This was basically a wolf’s head, its yellow-green eyes exuding a strange light.
Ling Han activated his ocular technique, yet shockingly discovered that he actually couldn’t see through this wolfman’s cultivation level.

This glance was actually discovered by the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe. He too turned to look at Ling Han, but his gaze did not stop on him. He just swept a glance over Ling Han and then looked away.
“You guys must be very curious. Fine, this old man will explain it to you.”
This High Priest of the Wolf Tribe began to speak.

“Our Wolf Tribe has lived here for generations, but many years ago, a plague swept over, causing almost all the citizens of our Wolf Tribe to die. To preserve the flame of hope, my ancestors sealed the surviving young children, and when we found the solution to the plague, only then would we unseal them.”
“And according to the Divine Decress, the hopes of the Wolf Tribe would be placed on you brave warriors from outside.”
Enter the Sky Suspension Cave and retrieve the Godly medicine!”
Of course, there’s also something you guys need there.”
When Ling Han and the others heard this, tsk, tsk, tsk, asn’t this the standard setting of an ancient site?
What Divine Decree? It must have been the Ancient Sun Saint who had brainwashed them when he had created or drawn in these wolves, and had them act as guides for this place.
This was an arrangement of the script, and the script was written by the Ancient Sun Saint.
They naturally would not reveal it, because the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe may not believe them. Instead, it would destroy the High Priest’s hopes, and cause him to fly into a humiliated rage.
Thus, everyone should act according to the script.
“There’s something that you guys need.” That would definitely be referring to the inheritance of the Saint.

Everyone was eager to give it a try, wanting nothing more than to immediately move out, but the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe told them not to be anxious. According to convention, they would have to wait for a while longer, so that more people could come here, and move together.
Alright, those who entered first indeed did not have much of an advantage.
It couldn’t be helped. One couldn’t hold a saber to the neck of the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe and make him reveal the location of the Sky Suspension Cave right?
Thus, Ling Han and the others were the same as those who had entered first.
They were either sitting, standing, or pacing around. They were extremely bored.
Ling Han wasn’t so worried. He sat down in a cross-legged position and continued to deduce formation patterns. He was still far from grasping all the formation patterns.
Day after day, time passed very quickly.

People came one after another, and the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe would suddenly appear, saying that a new batch of warriors had entered into the Werewolf Valley, and wanted them to go and receive them. Then, what Ling Han and the others experienced previously would be repeated.
And just like that, another half month’s time had passed, and the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe finally walked out again.
“It’s about time,” he said. His yellow-green eyes seemed to be exuding light, appearing to be extremely excited, “Whether our Wolf Tribe can revive or not will depend on you guys.”

sentences.text: Chapter 3726: High Priest of the Wolf Tribe
Translator: Henyee Translations Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han also walked over to observe this corpse.
This looked very similar to a human, but was definitely not a human.
It was not because it was too tall, but rather that the details of its head, hands, feet and so on were very far from that of humans.
“Werewolf or Pantherman,” someone said.
The part of the mouth protruded, and the fingernails on his hands and feet were long and sharp.
He completely looked like a beastman that had not completely taken human form.
“En.” The others all expressed their agreement.
In the past, there had been many werewolves or panthermen living here.
It was also possible that the beastmen had destroyed the residents here.
Was this the corpse of an invader?
“Worthless,” someone said with a shake of their head.
The others all shook their heads.
Indeed, what did such a corpse reveal?
What clues could it give?
“More importantly, where did those people go?” someone asked.
“I took a look.
This is a dead end valley, and there is no other way to leave.”
“Moreover, we didn’t find any crossroads along the way.
“That’s strange.”
Everyone was puzzled, and a strong feeling of confusion rose up in them.
“Hehe, are you guys looking for me?” A voice rang out, causing everyone to turn around and look.
A man was striding over, a smile on his face.
“You are Xu Guanglin!”
“Didn’t you pass the formation of rocks long ago?”
“That’s right.
You are not from our batch.”
A great many people recognized this man, and immediately called out his identity.
“Xu Guanglin, where did you come from?”
“Where are the others?”
Everyone was talking at once.
Xu Guanglin smiled slightly, “Come with me.
I will bring you to a place, and the mystery will naturally be solved.”
Everyone looked at each other, wondering if this was a trap.
However, they hadn’t obtained the inheritance of the Saint, so what was the point of Xu Guanglin harming them?
Moreover, their strength wasn’t weak, so what need was there for them to be afraid?
Moreover, they had already entered a dead end, so there was nothing better to do here.
“Let’s go.”
Everyone followed Xu Guanglin, and saw that this guy had brought them into a stone house.
He moved aside the stone bed inside, and a secret passage actually appeared.
Oh, no wonder this guy had suddenly popped out.
As it turned out, it was because there was a secret passage through which they could go.
Xu Guanglin took the lead, and everyone followed behind him.
The tunnel was very long, and after walking for half an hour, they finally walked out of the secret passage.
Suddenly, the path ahead of them became clear, revealing a small valley.
There was flowing water, and colorful stones were glowing.
“Welcome to… the Holy Land of the Wolf Tribe!” Xu Guanglin turned around and said to everyone.
Holy Land of the Wolf Tribe?
Was that the Werewolf Valley before?
Then the one who had died was also a Werewolf?
“Come, follow me.
You guys will soon unravel all the mysteries.” Xu Guanglin smiled, and continued to lead the way.
Not long after, they saw a large group of people either sitting or standing, or pacing back and forth.
These were all people who had passed through the stone formation earlier and entered into this space.
Everyone greeted each other.
There were a great many people here that knew each other.
Some had even formed alliances before, but they had been separated after entering this place, and did not get together.
Ling Han swept his gaze around, but did not see Zhuang Bufan.
Yi, where was this guy?
What exactly is going on here?” someone couldn’t help but ask.
Don’t be impatient.
Someone will answer your questions.”
“Who?”
“This old man.” An old voice rang out, causing those who had just arrived to all turn to look at him.
This was a tall, broad-shouldered man.
His whole body was enshrouded in a cloak, and he was as tall as ten feet.
He was a few heads taller than the majority of people.
Wherever he stood, anyone would lose their luster from his brilliance.
His left hand held a black walking stick, which seemed to be extremely heavy.
When it landed on the ground, it emitted a muffled ‘tong’, and the whole valley shook.
Ling Han swept an eye over him, and could already see that this man’s left hand that was holding a walking stick was furry, and the tips of his fingers were extraordinarily long, like small knives.
“I am the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe.” This tall man stopped, and used his right hand to remove the cloak on his head, revealing a furry face.
This was basically a wolf’s head, its yellow-green eyes exuding a strange light.
Ling Han activated his ocular technique, yet shockingly discovered that he actually couldn’t see through this wolfman’s cultivation level.
This glance was actually discovered by the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe.
He too turned to look at Ling Han, but his gaze did not stop on him.
He just swept a glance over Ling Han and then looked away.
“You guys must be very curious.
Fine, this old man will explain it to you.”
This High Priest of the Wolf Tribe began to speak.
“Our Wolf Tribe has lived here for generations, but many years ago, a plague swept over, causing almost all the citizens of our Wolf Tribe to die.
To preserve the flame of hope, my ancestors sealed the surviving young children, and when we found the solution to the plague, only then would we unseal them.”
“And according to the Divine Decress, the hopes of the Wolf Tribe would be placed on you brave warriors from outside.”
Enter the Sky Suspension Cave and retrieve the Godly medicine!”
Of course, there’s also something you guys need there.”
When Ling Han and the others heard this, tsk, tsk, tsk, asn’t this the standard setting of an ancient site?
What Divine Decree?
It must have been the Ancient Sun Saint who had brainwashed them when he had created or drawn in these wolves, and had them act as guides for this place.
This was an arrangement of the script, and the script was written by the Ancient Sun Saint.
They naturally would not reveal it, because the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe may not believe them.
Instead, it would destroy the High Priest’s hopes, and cause him to fly into a humiliated rage.
Thus, everyone should act according to the script.
“There’s something that you guys need.” That would definitely be referring to the inheritance of the Saint.
Everyone was eager to give it a try, wanting nothing more than to immediately move out, but the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe told them not to be anxious.
According to convention, they would have to wait for a while longer, so that more people could come here, and move together.
Alright, those who entered first indeed did not have much of an advantage.
It couldn’t be helped.
One couldn’t hold a saber to the neck of the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe and make him reveal the location of the Sky Suspension Cave right?
Thus, Ling Han and the others were the same as those who had entered first.
They were either sitting, standing, or pacing around.
They were extremely bored.
Ling Han wasn’t so worried.
He sat down in a cross-legged position and continued to deduce formation patterns.
He was still far from grasping all the formation patterns.
Day after day, time passed very quickly.

People came one after another, and the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe would suddenly appear, saying that a new batch of warriors had entered into the Werewolf Valley, and wanted them to go and receive them.
Then, what Ling Han and the others experienced previously would be repeated.
And just like that, another half month’s time had passed, and the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe finally walked out again.
“It’s about time,” he said.
His yellow-green eyes seemed to be exuding light, appearing to be extremely excited, “Whether our Wolf Tribe can revive or not will depend on you guys.”
Rest assured, High Priest, we will definitely do our best,” someone immediately said.
They did not need to expend anything to curry the favour of a storyline character.
Who knows, they may be able to gain additional marks, and gain some benefits in future.
“Come with me..”

chapters.title: Chapter 3727. Obtaining the true inheritance
paragraphs: Chapter 3727. Obtaining the true inheritance
Editor: Henyee Translations

Everyone followed the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe, and arrived at the end of the small valley. Then, the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe recited something to the mountain wall, and then tapped his walking stick on the mountain wall. A cave was soundlessly created in the mountain wall.
This was the Sky Suspension Cave?
“There are restrictions targeting Werewolves here, and I cannot enter.” The High Priest of the Wolf Tribe sighed, “You all may go. I hope that you can succeed, and save the future of our Wolf Tribe.”
Everyone nodded. This was in line with the settings. Otherwise, if they themselves could enter, what was the point of them being there then?
“Rest assured, High Priest!”

Everyone scrambled over one another. This was the final test. The fact that they could come here meant that they had obtained the approval of the Saint. Then, there was naturally a high chance that they could obtain the inheritance of the Saint.
As expected, they were the true strongest prodigies.
Yet Ling Han was slightly surprised. This was too easy, wasn’t it?

If there were any challenges here, it would be that there was an ancient battlefield before, and there was a formation of rocks behind it. Next, it was a swamp. However, they could all form teams to pass, and the difficulty level was pitifully low.
They were able to gain recognition all the way through like this, and enter into the final stage?
What kind of joke was this?
To say nothing of the inheritance of a Saint, even if any Cauldron Forging Tier had died, they wouldn’t so casually find a successor for themselves, right?
Furthermore, if it was really so easy, why had the inheritance of this Saint not been taken away after so long?
Ling Han kept feeling like there was something off. Hugging Sixth Baby in his arms, he turned to Princess Bixiao and said in a low voice, “Be careful, there might be drastic changes.”
Princess Bixiao was confused, and then came to a “realization”. Could it be that Ling Han was afraid that the inheritance of the Saint would appear, and cause a great fight?
“All right,” she nodded.
Ling Han knew that she didn’t understand what he meant, but it didn’t matter. It was fine as long as she was vigilant.

They walked and walked, and it was only a matter of ten minutes at most. A massive karst cave suddenly appeared ahead of them. It was more than ninety meters tall, and the widest point was about three thousand meters, while the narrowest point was also six hundred meters.
In the middle of this karst cave, there was a stone pillar. It was nine meters tall, and appeared very abrupt.
And now that they had reached this place, it was also the end of the whole cave.
“Where’s the inheritance from the Saint?” someone called out, filled with defiance.
This was already the end?
No wonder no one had gained anything in these countless millenia. As it turned out, this was a scam.
Everyone had been deceived by the Ancient Sun Saint, so how could there be any inheritance from the Saint? They had been tricked, scammed.
This caused a great many people to fly into a thunderous rage.
“Come, let’s go back and interrogate that High Priest. Who knows, it may be him that is deceiving us.”
“That’s right. Let’s go back and find that old geezer.”
Some people wanted to return, but there would always be curious people. They walked to the stone pillar in the middle, and stretched out a hand to touch it.
Weng, this stone pillar actually lit up. Then, pa, a book appeared out of thin air.
“The inheritance, the inheritance of the Saint!” That person said shakily, incredibly excited.
He could see clearly that there were four words on the book: “Ancient Sun Divine Scroll.”
Wasn’t this the inheritance of the Saint?
As it turned out, the inheritance of the Saint was real.
All of a sudden, everyone’s eyes were focused on him. A great many people’s eyes were blazing with ferocity.
“Hand it over!” someone immediately shouted.
This was the inheritance of a Saint. To say nothing of them, even if Venerate Tiers came, they would still fight to the death over it.
How could that person be willing to listen? He hurriedly stored the book into his Spatial Tool. There was no way he would hand over such an inheritance.
“You are really courting death!” Xiu, someone immediately charged towards that person.

Where there was one, there would be two. Xiu, xiu, xiu! More and more people couldn’t help but make a move. Even those people who had wanted to leave earlier returned one after another, joining the battle.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

A chaotic battle broke out, and it was incredibly intense. For the sake of obtaining the inheritance of the Saint, none of them would show any mercy. They were all attacking with their full strength, wanting to defeat all of the others, and obtain a great opportunity for themselves.
However, there were still some people who did not join the battle. Instead, they walked towards that stone pillar, and also stretched out their hands to press down on it.
Pa, another book appeared out of thin air.
“Ancient Sun Divine Scroll!”
That person was overjoyed, and hurriedly put away the book.
However, though his movements were covert, they were still seen by others.

Those people did not fight over it. Instead, they all stepped forwards, and stretched out their hands to touch the stone pillar. In the end, pa, pa, pa! One after another, book after book appeared. They were all the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll.𝒇𝙧𝙚𝓮𝔀𝓮𝒃𝙣𝓸𝒗𝒆𝒍.𝙘𝒐𝒎
This book had appeared too many times, and even those who were battling fiercely saw it. Involuntarily, some people retreated from the battle, and then more and more such people appeared.
The battle royale ended, but seventeen corpses were left behind. How could no one die from such an intense battle?

Everyone was speechless, and they all went up to touch it. However, not everyone would be able to obtain the “Ancient Sun Divine Scroll”. Some people stretched out their hands to touch it, but there was no reaction at all.
“It seems like we’ve been tricked again.”
Everyone made a comparison of the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll, and the result was that every copy was different.
Perhaps one of them was real, or perhaps all of them were false.
“Hehe, Father, let’s give it a try too.” Sixth Baby brandished her small white hands.
“All right,” Ling Han said with a smile.
He walked forwards with Sixth Baby in his arms. First, Sixth Baby stretched out her hand and pressed down. A pillar of light flashed, and pa, a book appeared out of thin air.
‘Ancient Sun Divine Scroll’, En, who knows how many books there were already.’
Ling Han smiled, and also stretched out his hand to press down.
Yi?
He shockingly discovered that the “stamp” on his hand suddenly lit up, and then a feeling of vicissitudes instantly surged into his mind.
“Descendant of many generations after, you have finally come.”

“I have been waiting for you for a very, very long time. Since you can hear these words, it means that you have passed through the first stage of my test, and may obtain the cultivation technique of Foundation Building Tier of the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll.”
“There are still three Mystery Realms waiting for you, corresponding respectively to the Cauldron Forging Tier, the Core Formation Tier, and the True Self Tier.”
“Only if you pass all the tests, will you be able to obtain my complete inheritance.”

Instantly, a large amount of information surged towards Ling Han. This was a cultivation technique, but there was only the cultivation technique for the Foundation Building Tier. Then, there were three coordinates, as well as the method to open the three Mystery Realms.

Ling Han distinguished it slightly, and he immediately confirmed that this should be the real Ancient Sun Divine Scroll, which was broad and profound. Even if he had not cultivated this technique yet, Ling Han was sure that this was definitely ten to twenty times better than the Great Sun Lotus Technique that he was presently cultivating.

This Ancient Sun Saint really knew how to play. He actually gave them a pile of fake cultivation techniques, and furthermore, they were divided into parts one, two, three, and four. There were also three Mystery Realms that they had to pass before they could obtain the complete Ancient Sun Divine Scroll.
However, in this way, no one would know that the true inheritance of the Saint had actually fallen into his hands — it was actually in his brain.
Indeed, those bloody battles previously had not been wasted. His persistence, and his efforts had paid off.
From this, it could also be seen how a Saint’s mindset was when selecting his successor. Not only did he require powerful strength, he also required a strong enough determination.
Perseverance was indeed an invaluable quality on the path of cultivation. Oftentimes, one would have to have the determination not to turn back even if they were to hit a wall..

chapters.title: Chapter 3728: High Priest with a story
paragraphs: Chapter 3728: High Priest with a story
Editor: Henyee Translations
Ling Han remained calm and collected as he stepped back.
Princess Bixiao stood in his place. She too stretched out a hand and pressed down. Pa, another “Ancient Sun Divine Scroll” appeared. En, practically every person had a copy, and none of them missed.
The remaining people also stepped forward to give it a try. They were already here, so how could they be satisfied if they didn’t give it a try?
Some people didn’t obtain anything, while others obtained a cheap version of the “Ancient Sun Divine Scroll”.

More than an hour had passed, and everyone had tried once. A total of 739 Ancient Sun Divine Scrolls had been unearthed, and as for whether there was a real copy among them, Ling Han knew that there definitely wasn’t one but the others were not so sure. They all swept their gazes over the others, wondering if they should make a move to snatch it.
Though he had already obtained the inheritance of the Saint, a suspicion rose up in Ling Han’s heart.
Wasn’t this too smooth?

His true sacrifice was that he had battled on the ancient battlefield for 21 days. This was indeed something that the prodigies of the past eras might not have been able to persist in. However, the problem was that the subsequent stage was too simple.

According to the Ancient Sun Saint’s personality, the complete Ancient Sun Divine Scroll still had to be passed down four separate times. The Foundation Building Tier chapter of the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll was actually so easily obtained?
Why did he keep feeling that something was off?
“Gagaga, this day has finally come.” An old voice rang out, and the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe strode over with his walking stick, “The inheritance of the Saint has finally appeared!”
Yi, old geezer, what are you talking about?
Didn’t you want some Godly medicine for the sake of the future descendants of the Wolf Tribe? Didn’t you say that the Wolf Tribe couldn’t enter here?
Why had his persona suddenly collapsed?

Furthermore, how do you know about the inheritance of the Saint? As a chess piece, shouldn’t you know nothing, and could only act according to the script? The High Priest of the Wolf Tribe laughed loudly, and said disdainfully, “Do you all think that you are the high and mighty gamers? Wrong, if it was not for the fact that I have omitted countless steps for you, you all would have to experience various difficulties, and would only be able to come here after at least a few months.”
“And there is only one person that can come here!”

“However, if it’s just one person, the chances of obtaining the inheritance are too low. Thus, I’ll save you some time, and while I’m at it, allow everyone to enter this place. At the same time, I can also increase my chances of success.” “Heavens have mercy, I have finally succeeded!”
When everyone heard this, they were all at a loss.
Had the character in the script suddenly awakened, and thus decided not to act according to the script?

“There’s no hurry. We have a lot of time. I’ll also explain everything to you from beginning to end. After holding it in for so many years, if I don’t say it, I’ll really feel too terrible,” the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe said.
“Let me tell you a story first.”𝒻𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝘯𝘰𝑣ℯ𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝘮
This High Priest did not care whether the masses were willing to listen or otherwise, and had already started to speak on his own.
“A very, very long time ago, this Mystery Realm opened, and a large number of cultivators entered, coming to the Werewolf Valley.

“At that time, the Werewolf Valley wasn’t like it is now, but there were a lot of Werewolves living here. Only if outsiders won the trust of the Werewolves would they be qualified to have an audience with the High Priest, and the High Priest would arrange a lot of missions and tests, which were very, very difficult to complete.”
“Only the first person to succeed would be qualified to enter into the Sky Suspension Cave. The others would not have the chance.”
“This is only a microcosm of how the Mystery Realm has opened countless times over the generations. However, something different happened that time.”
“Because a female adventurer actually fell in love with a Werewolfn from the Werewolf Valley.”
“She stayed behind, and spent her whole life in this filthy, narrow place.”
She had no regrets, but after she told everything to her son, her son was extremely defiant.”
“Why am I trapped in this place?”
Why do I have to become a chess piece?”

“Thus, after learning of all this, I began to make plans. All of this should have been mine! However, I have half of the bloodline of a Werewolf, so it is eternally impossible for me to leave this godforsaken place.”
“Unless… the inheritance of the Saint is taken away, and this Mystery Realm shatters.”
Unfortunately, I do not meet the Saint’s requirements, and am unable to obtain the inheritance.”
“Thus, I have simplified all the procedures. As long as anyone comes to the Werewolf Valley, I will allow you to enter here.”
“When there are too many people, there will always be one or two that will be able to obtain the inheritance of the Saint.”
“And I will snatch this great opportunity!”
The High Priest of the Wolf Tribe declared proudly, appearing to be filled with confidence.

Everyone smirked coldly, looking pitifully at this High Priest of the Wolf Tribe. You ve been tricked. Who obtained the inheritance of the Saint?’ It was all a lie. “Bunch of idiots!” The High Priest of the Wolf Tribe scoffed, “How many years have I been living here? chapters.title: Chapter 3729= All suppressed
paragraphs: Chapter 3729= All suppressed
Editor: Henyee Translations
The Moon Occult Mystery Realm suppressed cultivation level. To say nothing of the Cauldron Forging Tier, even if a Sect Master came, he would have to obediently become a Foundation Building Tier.
This was the power of a Saint, and even a Sect Master great elite was no match
for it.
Thus, very few elites entered this place. If they were unlucky, and encountered a hot-headed fool, who beat them up, or even killed them in fact, where would they go to complain about the injustice?
However, the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe in front of them was not only at the Cauldron Forging Tier, but he was also able to channel the cultivation level of
Cauldron Forging Tier.
Although there was only one cauldron, and it was only the first step of the Cauldron Forging Tier, against Foundation Building cultivators, this was a crushing advantage.
However, how was this possible?

The Werewolf High Priest was extremely intelligent, and he felt as if everything was under his control. He laughed loudly, and said, “I was born here so the suppression of heaven and earth has no effect on me. Moreover, I’ve massacred all of my clansmen, and through devouring their bloodlines, I’ve successfully broken through to the Cauldron Forging Tier!”
“If that wasn’t the case, why would I be so confident?
When everyone heard this, they all frowned, their hearts incredibly heavy.

It was clear that the Werewolf High Priest had planned everything carefully. He would make use of them to obtain the inheritance of the Saint, and then kill them all in one go. With the strength of Cauldron Forging Tier, it naturally wouldn’t be a problem for him to accomplish this.

To say nothing else, once the Celestial Cauldron appeared, it would be able to suppress the Foundation Building cultivators in terms of aura, preventing them from unleashing even 10% of their true strength.
What could be done?
Even if one of them really obtained the inheritance of the Saint, and was willing to hand it over, would they still be able to live?
Once he had obtained the inheritance of the Saint, he would definitely kill them to prevent them from leaking the secret.
How were they supposed to resolve this dilemma?

Everyone was basically prodigy-level. Some were even four-star geniuses. If they were outside, they would not even cast a second look at the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe. His natural talent was too poor.
But now? A Cauldron Forging Tier elite had appeared, completely breaking the balance of strength.
If all of them joined forces, could they defeat a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator?

No matter what, they had to give it a try. Otherwise… they would definitely die. “Hand over my inheritance!” The High Priest of the Wolf Tribe looked down arrogantly, his eyes focused on a woman, and stretched out a hand to grab her. He was half-human and half-wolf, and his hands were also like wolf claws. They were thick, and his fingernails were long and sharp, like blades.
That woman was a one-star genius of Heavenly Dao Foundation, and she was originally quite extraordinary, but in front of a Cauldron Forging Tier elite, how could she compare?
Being suppressed by the Celestial Cauldron, she couldn’t unleash 10% of her battle prowess at all. Her entire body was trembling, and she couldn’t even parry.
“He!” The people beside her hurriedly moved in unison, greeting the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe.
Without the lips, the teeth feel the cold?. They had to work together.

However, the gap in strength was really too wide. Even if they joined forces, it was useless. With a swipe of the claw from the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe, those people were sent flying at the same time.

“A bunch of trash actually dares to contend with me!” The High Priest of the Wolf Tribe smirked coldly. He humphed, and drew out his walking stick again, tapping it on the ground. Instantly, everyone felt a massive power pressing down on them, making it difficult for them to even move.

“At first, this mountain cave suppressed the bloodline of the Wolf Tribe, but I modified it slightly. Now, it has become an existence that suppresses all other beings except for the bloodline of the Wolf Tribe.
p***thow were they supposed to continue like this?
in the first place, they were no match for the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe, and now, it was difficult for them to even move. This was undoubtedly adding fuel to the fire.
Even if they joined forces, so what? What use would it be?
Oh no, they was completely done for now.

The High Priest of the Wolf Tribe laughed loudly, “Now, hand over my inheritance! It’s fine even if you don’t hand it over. I have a soul searching technique, and I can search your souls one by one. Don’t think of hiding anything from me!”𝒻𝘳ℯℯ𝑤ℯ𝒷𝘯ℴ𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝑐ℴ𝑚

He grabbed a person. Pu, his sharp claws directly pierced through that person’s skull. Then, his fingernails were all exuding green light, and that person was trembling all over. Not long after, that person’s limbs drooped, completely lifeless.
“Useless trash.”
The High Priest of the Wolf Tribe humphed coldly, and tossed that person aside.
His figure was over three meters tall, and if he threw someone down, it would be like an eagle throwing away a chick.
Everyone was trembling in fear. What could they do?

Ling Han was also thinking of a way, thoughts flashing through his mind. It was actually very simple to eliminate the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe. He only had to summon the Heavenly Dao Flames contained in the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower.
The question was, would this reveal that he was the culprit who had set fire to the Holy Land?
Though this would make him very famous, Ling Han clearly did not like this kind of reputation now.
Thus, unless absolutely necessary, Ling Han didn’t want to use the Heavenly Dao Flames.
Then was there any other way?

With a thought from Ling Han, he took out the Ghostly Underworld Light. This was a tool that he had obtained from Luo Xuan. It had been personally refined by a great elite of Sect Master-level, and the lamp oil had also been refined from the corpses of at least Cauldron Forging Tier elites.
He would give it a try.

His Celestial Foundations were built from imitations of the primitive Celestial Gate Furthermore, they were two Celestial Foundations, which allowed him to have a strong immunity against suppression. He was completely unlike the pitiful others.
He silently activated the Ghostly Underworld Light, and instantly, an incredibly evil aura circulated. Ghostly flames suddenly gushed out, burning towards the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe.
“En?” The High Priest of the Wolf Tribe showed a hint of surprise. There was actually someone that could activate a precious tool?

just at this moment, shua, shua, shua! Multiple streaks of light lit up, and there were actually n people that moved, launching attacks at the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe. Some shot out sword light, some shot out Saber Qi, some drew out an ancient mirror that shone with divine light, and some drew out the Heavenly Parasol, which cast down multiple terrifying auras.
As it turned out, Ling Han wasn’t the only one who could resist the pressure here. There was no shortage of supreme prodigies here, so they definitely had a shocking trump card.

However, previously, no one knew if there was anyone else that could cooperate with them, and just how much damage could a strike from a Foundation Building Tier cause to a Cauldron Forging Tier cultivator? Thus, they all endured silently, waiting for the best opportunity to make a move.
Now that Ling Han had taken the initiative to attack, it was equivalent to blowing the horn of war. Those who had the spare energy to attack all attacked at the same time.
The High Priest of the Wolf Tribe showed a hint of seriousness. At this time, those that still had the ability to make a move on him were all prodigies of Foundation Building Tier.

If it was a one-on-one battle, he could completely ignore them, but now, he was a little careless, thinking that he could rest easy after turning around the suppressive power of this place. He had already put away the Celestial Cauldron. Without this layer of suppression, these 12 opponents had at least retained 70% of their battle prowess.

Twelve Ultimate Dao Foundation cultivators, who were at least two-star geniuses, unleashed their Spirit Tool and attacked at the same time. Even a Cauldron Forging Tier had to be careful. Otherwise, it was extremely likely that they would fail miserably.
He humphed, and struck the walking stick heavily. Weng, a wave of energy spread out with him at the centre, pushing out in all directions.
Twelve attacks came from different directions, but when they came into contact with this energy wave, they immediately stopped.
It still wouldn’t work. Cauldron Forging Tier was too powerful in this place, even if the other had only formed one cauldron.

Shua, a streak of white light streaked past, shooting towards the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe at more than thirty times the speed of sound, like it was leaving behind a trail of dust, like a strong man that would not turn back.

chapters.title: Chapter 3730: Turning the tables
paragraphs: Chapter 3730: Turning the tables
Editor: Henyee Translations
At first everyone was already in despair, but when they saw this white light, they immediately felt their hearts that had fallen to rock bottom rise up again.
Could it succeed?
The High Priest of the Wolf Tribe smirked coldly. A mere concealed weapon wanted to wound him?
Too naive.
He very casually raised his hand and pressed down, wanting to grab the white light that was attacking him. He could already clearly see that this was a white jade-like rock.
However, just as his hand touched the rock, his expression changed drastically.
So heavy,too heavy!
How was this possible? It was clearly only the size of a fist, so how could it
have such a terrifying weight?
Moreover, how could such a heavy thing be shot out at such a high speed?
To say nothing of Foundation Building Tier cultivators, even Cauldron Forging Tier cultivators like him wouldn’t be able to do it.
He had been too careless. He was going to be in deep trouble.

However, it was already too late for regrets. With a pa, his right hand instantly exploded, turning into a rain of blood. Then, the jade did not stop at all, and continued to crash forwards. Pa, pa, pa! The bones in his forearm exploded one after another, and blood rained down.
This still wasn’t the end. Next, his upper arm was also shattered by the rock.
This rock itself weighed 5,000kg, and added with the fact that it was smashing towards him at more than 30 times the speed of sound, its weight was overwhelmingly heavy in an instant.

So what if he was a Cauldron Forging Tier? His protective mystical power couldn’t block it at all, and the entire right arm of the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe turned into a rain of blood. Even half of his upper body was missing, revealing a large gash that was bleeding. This scene was terrifying beyond the imagination.
The Heavenly Pattern Jade was extremely powerful!

However, this also showed how powerful Cauldron Forging Tier was. In a moment of carelessness, he had used his physical body to face the Heavenly Pattern Jade head-on. Surprisingly, he had only lost his right arm, and half of his body was missing.
If this was a Foundation Building cultivator, his whole person would probably
be turned into a rain of blood.
At more than thirty times the speed of sound, the Heavenly Pattern Jade was extremely destructive.

Editor: Henyee Translations

The High Priest of the Wolf Tribe put his life on the line, but he was half a native, so the techniques he had grasped were really limited. Even if he wanted to throw everything on the line, there was not much he could.

He brandished the walking stick. This was indeed a Spirit Tool, but that was a tool that the Ancient Sun Saint had set for him to control the formation restrictions here. In terms of battle prowess… its help was very, very small. Thus, though he was fighting with his life on the line, his battle prowess did not increase much.
“Go, he’s already at the end of his line.”
“Kill this old b@stard!”
“You actually want to kill us? How laughable!”

Everyone smirked coldly. Which one of them did not come from a noble background? Yet now, they were actually almost completely wiped out by an old Werewolf with a lowly status. This naturally was great hatred.

■■All of you deserve to die! All of you die!” the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe roared in fury. He continued to brandish his walking stick, sending out bursts of black energy that possessed extremely strong destructive power.

He was a Cauldron Forging Tier elite, after all. Not only could the Celestial Cauldron suppress all the Foundation Building Tiers, but the destructive power of his mystical power was also considerably higher.
Under such desperate attacks, no one dared to face him head-on. They all avoided him temporarily, and only trapped the other party, slowly exhausting him.
In any case, whether it was waiting until the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe died, or the Mystery Realm collapsing so that everyone could leave, it was good news for everyone.
He went all out for three times, and the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe no longer had any remaining courage.

His injuries were far too severe. He hadn’t simply lost a small half of his body. Instead, he had been wounded by the Heavenly Pattern Jade, a Two Star Spiritual Power Spirit Tool. Thus, the damage caused by the weapon would naturally prevent his wounds from healing.
Thus, the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe was bleeding endlessly. With every second that passed, his injuries would become heavier.

Once this desperate struggle was over, he would be at a disadvantage. “Die with me, b@stard!” The High Priest of the Wolf Tribe set his eyes on Ling Han. If it was not for the fact that this person had destroyed half of his body, how could he have fallen to this state?
It was all because of this person!
Thus, if he was going to die, he would drag Ling Han down with him.
He charged over, his speed extremely fast. He was incomparably furious, causing him to burn his potential again.
Ling Han was calm and composed as he unleashed the Imminent Skyline. Xiu!
He rapidly retreated.
The High Priest of the Wolf Tribe gloomily discovered that this Foundation Building Tier cultivator actually possessed speed that was not inferior to his own.
How was this possible?
He was a Cauldron Forging Tier! Even if he was severely wounded, he was still a Cauldron Forging Tier! How could he be unable to suppress Ling Han in terms of speed?
This human was practically a freak. Not only had he severely injured him, he had even prevented him from exacting revenge.

He helplessly watched as Ling Han maintained a distance from him. Meanwhile, he could clearly sense that his vitality was continuously declining, and his life force was presently draining away at an extremely fast pace.
He was about to die.
-No! No! No!” he shouted at the sky. He had schemed and prepared for so many years, but in the end, it was all for naught?
He was really unwilling to accept this.
But what was the use of being defiant?
Peng, he could no longer steady his footing. He staggered, and fell heavily onto the ground.

Shua, shua, shua! One after another, attacks slashed over. Everyone was experienced in battle, and not one of them approached personally. They only attacked from afar. Though the destructive power had been weakened, the advantage was that they were safe.
Pu, pu, pu! The High Priest of the Wolf Tribe endured all the attacks, and multiple wounds appeared on his tall body, tearing his body apart, revealing his eerily white bones and internal organs.
He really couldn’t take it anymore.
“Old geezer!” Someone walked forwards, and delivered a slash with his saber. Pa, the head of the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe was instantly severed.
This time, this old Werewolf was definitely dead.
Everyone finally breathed a sigh of relief, feeling a layer of cold sweat on their backs.

After all, it was a Cauldron Forging Tier that wanted to kill them. Furthermore, the timing and location were both beneficial to the High Priest of the Wolf Tribe. If it was not for the fact that Ling Han had made the beautiful first move, it was probable that they would have all died here today.
“Brother Ling, thank you.”
“Ling Han, I owe you my life.”

But he had not even opened his mouth, when the whole cave trembled, and then the violent tremors could not be stopped.
“The Mystery Realm is about to collapse?”

“Could it be that that old Werewolf wasn’t lying? Someone really obtained the inheritance of the Saint, so the Mystery Realm is about to collapse?” “That may not be the case. That old Werewolf may only think that he has everything under his control. Who knows, it may be the Ancient Sun Saint that caused him to think that way. Just think, practically everyone has a copy of the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll. Just how much of a troublemaker is this Saint?”
“… True.”

As they conversed, boom, a powerful force spread out, and no one was able to match it at all. Xiu, they only felt their vision blur, as if they had entered into a strange passage of illusions. There was a dazzling, magnificent light flashing before their eyes.
Before they could see clearly, they had already fallen out of this passageway. Yi, they had already left the Moon Occult Mystery Realm and arrived at the place where they had entered.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! Immediately, a great many people shot over.
■?Have you obtained the inheritance of the Saint?” someone asked, standing in midair.
“Seventh Senior Brother, we’ve all been tricked.” A young man who had come out of the Mystery Realm took out the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll and handed it over.

The person in the sky descended, picked up the «Ancient Sun Divine Scroll» and flipped through it, not knowing whether to laugh or cry. “This is a widely circulated cultivation technique called «Universal Yang Techmque». Its grade is extremely low.”
“I also have one here.” Another person that had come out of the Mystery Realm took out the <<Ancient Sun Divine Scroll>>.

■■This is the Eighteen Styles of the Forest, a very low-level celestial technique.” Everyone took out the “Ancient Sun Divine Scroll” that they had obtained to give to their sects or the seniors of their clans. The result was the same. They were all an extremely ordinary celestial technique.

Ling Han was naturally making a fortune in secret. If he said that the real Ancient Sun Divine Scroll was actually in his head, he would probably be captured by a great elite in the next instant, and brought back to cast the Soul Searching Technique.
He quietly retreated, bringing Princess Bixiao and Sixth Baby back to the Imperial Capital.

This was the territory of the Dark North Nation, Chen Fengyan’s territory, so these people probably wouldn’t dare to use force. After all, among those who had come from other planets, the strongest was only the Core Formation Tier. Ling Han safely returned to the Imperial Capital. He immediately began to switch to cultivating the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll, and instantly felt as if he had been reborn.
As expected of the cultivation technique of a Saint. It was too awesome..

■■This is the Eighteen Styles of the Forest, a very low-level celestial technique.” Everyone took out the “Ancient Sun Divine Scroll” that they had obtained to give to their sects or the seniors of their clans.
The result was the same.
They were all an extremely ordinary celestial technique.
Ling Han was naturally making a fortune in secret.
If he said that the real Ancient Sun Divine Scroll was actually in his head, he would probably be captured by a great elite in the next instant, and brought back to cast the Soul Searching Technique.
He quietly retreated, bringing Princess Bixiao and Sixth Baby back to the Imperial Capital.
This was the territory of the Dark North Nation, Chen Fengyan’s territory, so these people probably wouldn’t dare to use force.
After all, among those who had come from other planets, the strongest was only the Core Formation Tier.
Ling Han safely returned to the Imperial Capital.
He immediately began to switch to cultivating the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll, and instantly felt as if he had been reborn.
As expected of the cultivation technique of a Saint.
It was too awesome..

chapters.title: Chapter 3732: Number One in the Galaxy
paragraphs: Chapter 3732: Number One in the Galaxy
Editor: Henyee Translations
Compared to before, Ling Han’s cultivation speed had increased by at least 50 times.
Originally, if he crossed over a minor cultivation level, he would need about ten years or so without relying on external power. Now, it was only two to three months.
The cultivation technique of a Saint was so awesome!

In fact, Ling Han had relied on the Silver Dragon Fish and Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pills to cultivate to the peak stage of Human Dao Foundation in just a few months. From this, it could be seen just how inferior the Great Sun Lotus Technique was. It was actually so much inferior to alchemical pills and natural treasures.
Now that they were compared, it was clear just how powerful the cultivation technique of a Saint was.
Good news came one after another. Lin Luo, Zhou Heng and the others all leaped over the Celestial Gate and advanced into the Foundation Building Tier.
Ling Han made some queries. They had all crossed over the bronze, silver and gold Celestial Gates, but did not see the primitive Celestial Gate.
As expected, without the Power of Dimensions in his body, it was impossible to go to the fourth Celestial Gate.
Even so, the battle prowess of Lin Luo and the others was still extremely shocking. They were at least four stars in battle prowess.

Ling Han thought for a moment, then taught the Ancient Sun Divine Scroll to Lin Luo and the others. These were truly his own people. Ling Han hoped that they would be strong, and in future, every single one of them would be of help to him.
Lin Luo and the others didn’t stand on ceremony either. In any case, they had already accepted too many favors from Ling Han, so it didn’t matter if they received one more.
They were truly a family, so what need was there for them to be polite?

Ling Han smiled faintly. The Ancient Sun Divine Scroll thad come at just the right time. Lin Luo and the others were all prodigies among prodigies. With the cultivation technique of a Saint, their future prospects were limitless.

The empress, Hu Niu, and the large black dog had also reached the Mystery Realm Tier. As long as they unlocked all the apertures in their bodies, they would also be able to break through to the Foundation Building Tier.
Everything was so wonderful.

The little loli had also returned. In a single stroke, she had bought over a hundred connecting devices. In her words, she had already made a trip anyways, so if she only bought a few, it would really be too unfair to her.
It would be good if there were more.

Ling Han took one for himself, then distributed one to Lin Luo and the others. The empress and Hu Niu naturally had one as well. However, they had not advanced into Celestial Path yet, and could not use it yet. That would need the support of an incredibly powerful Spiritual Power. Thus, it would at least have to be a Foundation Building Tier.
In high spirits, he put on the connection device. It was extremely small, only the size of a rice grain. It could be hidden in his hair, or even in his eyes, which was very convenient.

After putting it on, a cold voice suddenly sounded. “This connection device is currently not connected to any living being, and the soul of the wearer has not been tagged with any account number. May I ask if I need to create a new account number?”
“Yes,” Ling Han said mentally.
“Connecting to the Galaxy Network platform to create an account,” the voice said. After a while, it rang again. “The account has been established. You can set up a name for yourself.”
Ling Han pondered for a moment, before replying, “Number One in the Galaxy.”
The voice actually didn’t respond at the first instant. Instead, after a while, it asked in confusion, “Do you really want to use this name?”
“Of course,” Ling Han said with a smile. In any case, this was only a codename. As long as he didn’t say that “Number One in the Galaxy” on the net was Ling Han, it was fine.
“I hope you are worthy of this title.” The voice actually said something quite humane.𝘧𝘳𝘦ℯ𝓌𝘦𝒷𝘯𝑜𝑣𝘦𝓁.𝒸𝘰𝓂
Ling Han was surprised, “Yi, you actually have emotions?”

The voice had already regained its coldness, “I am the soul of the Galaxy Network. I was created by the Four Directions Great Emperor, and possess absolute fairness. The information of every connecting user is absolutely classified. As long as you do not choose to make it public, it will definitely not be leaked.”

Ling Han chuckled. He believed in the secrecy of the Galaxy Network. After all, the Galaxy Network had operated for so many years, and he had never heard of anyone being leaked by the Chang Clan, leading to trouble.
This was also one of the reasons why everyone chose to connect to the Galaxy Network. This was absolutely private.
However, this Galaxy Network soul only spoke of fairness, but avoided the topic of “emotion”. It was quite interesting.
Ling Han didn’t pursue the matter. He finally had his own Galaxy Network account, and could get rich.
“I want to go to the Galaxy Network Tournament,” Ling Han said through his consciousness.
Xiu, it was as if his consciousness had instantly leaped countless distances, and a majestic giant city appeared in front of him.

“Because entering into the tournament requires the physical manifestation of the soul, which expends energy, so we have to collect fees.” The voice of the Galaxy Network’s soul sounded again, “Every day that you stay here will be charged one Universe Coin. If there is less than a day, it will also be charged as a day.”
‘F*ck! This is daylight robbery!’
Ling Han did not lack Dao Stones in his possession, but without going to the redemption points set up by the Chang Clan to trade for Universe Coins, he could be considered extremely poor.
“Add a friend for me,” Ling Han said. He recited Lin Xiu’s account number.
“A friend request has been sent. Please wait.”
It wasn’t long before Ling Han received a notification. His friend request had been approved.
“Brother Ling, is that you?” Lin Xiu’s voice was heard.
This was naturally his consciousness. Through the Galaxy Network, he had traversed who knew how far.
Ling Han nodded, “It’s me.”

When he had applied for a friend request, he had chosen to hide his name. Thus, on Lin Xiu’s side, only Ling Han’s account number could be seen. That was a series of extraordinarily long numbers, because from ancient times until now, who knew how many people had connected to Galaxy Network. This account number was naturally chillingly long.
However, Ling Han also added a note to his application: “I am Ling Han.” It was because of this that Lin Xiu had approved at the first instant.
Of course, Lin Xiu still had to confirm it.
The two of them turned on the video communication. Instantly, the two of them were in the same room, and could clearly see each other, but they were in a virtual room.
“Now that you have your own Galaxy Network account, I’ll immediately transfer the money to you.” Lin Xiu was still very smart. He didn’t need Ling Han to explain his intentions.
Ling Han smiled and said, “Thanks for the trouble.”
“Don’t stand on ceremony with me,” Lin Xiu said. Then, he transferred all of Ling Han’s money over.
It wasn’t much, just a few hundred Universe Coins. However, as the starting capital, Ling Han felt that it was enough.
“Then I’ll get busy first. Let’s talk later.” Ling Han was in a rush to go to the competition ground.
“Alright.” Lin Xiu nodded.
Ling Han cut off the connection, then said, “Send me to the Tournament.”
This time, he was rich. After deducting a Universe Coin, he entered into the tournament.
He arrived at a room. There were no walls on the other side of the room, and he could clearly see the outside. However, it was an empty tournament ground.
“Newbie, familiarize yourself with the rules first,” The voice of Galaxy Network’s soul sounded. Pa, pa, pa! A pile of books fell from the sky and landed on the table.
This Galaxy Network soul definitely had its own willpower. Otherwise, it wouldn’t be so proud.
‘Aren’t I a manifestation of consciousness now? Can’t you directly transmit the rules to me?’
Ling Han mocked for a while, then picked up a book and flipped through it. Instantly, this information turned into a stream of consciousness that entered into his mind..

chapters.title: Chapter 3733: Battle begins
paragraphs: Chapter 3733: Battle begins
Editor: Henyee Translations
In the tournament, there were three types of spectator mode, tournament stage mode, and Galaxy Network Level Battles.

In the spectator mode, you could just sit in your room, and then you could browse through all the lists of battles that were taking place, or were about to take place. If you wanted to watch, you could just choose directly.
If this battle was not set up as a fee-paying mode, they could watch as they liked, but if it was set up as a fee-paying mode, they would have to pay to be able to watch.
If you retreated after watching half of it, you would have to pay a new fee for entering again.

There were two types of tournament stages. The first was defending champion mode, wherein you would set up your own tournament stage and allow challengers to enter. The second was challenge mode, wherein you would seek out defending champions to issue challenges.

Whether it was defending champion mode or challenge mode, there were a great many different types, such as matching of similar cultivation level, a one-on-one battle, a one-on-many battle, or a battle royale.
Of course, for everyone, the most important thing was still the Galaxy Network Level Battles, because they could only obtain points through this kind of battle, and be ranked accordingly.
Previously, it was said that someone was ranked 8o,oooth and 200,000th on the Galaxy Network, and that was through the Galaxy Network Level Battles.

With a thought from Ling Han, a virtual screen instantly appeared in front of him. There were three options on it, and they were spectator mode, tournament stage mode, and Galaxy Network Level Battles.

The Galaxy Network soul would only guide him at the entry level, and he could only operate on his own at other times. Thankfully, this was a completely mature virtual world. Even if there had been some small problems in the past, they would definitely have been fixed long ago.
Ling Han couldn’t possibly spend money to watch people fight. He was here to earn money.
Thus, he resolutely chose the tournament stage mode.

He chose to become the defending champion, and set the price for coming in to challenge him. A challenger would have to pay a Universe Coin, and if he lost, he would have to pay another ten Universe Coins.
Of course, it was the same if Ling Han lost. Ling Han would compensate the challenger with 10 Universe Coins.
The stakes were directly taken by the Galaxy Network platform. Whoever came in would immediately have ten Universe Coins taken, and whoever won would get it.
What was worse was that no matter who won or lost, the Galaxy Network platform would collect a service charge of ten thousandth the stakes.
It didn’t seem like much, but who knew how many people were fighting like this every day and every moment. That was a terrifying amount.
Moreover, Ling Han’s Universe Coins had been docked when he opened the tournament stage. This could not be refunded.
Ling Han waited and waited, but he kept seeing no one come in to challenge him.
He called up the tournament forum, and planned to ask what was going on.𝙛𝒓𝒆𝙚𝒘𝒆𝓫𝙣𝓸𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝒄𝒐𝓶
Yi?
He was astounded, because he saw a main theme post that wrote, “An idiot has shockingly appeared, setting up a tournament stage and actually asking for money.”
Er, this wasn’t talking about him, was it?
Ling Han stretched out a hand and tapped on the virtual screen. This thread immediately opened.

Someone wrote a few words, and sure enough, they were targeting him. They mocked him mercilessly, and said that a rookie actually wanted to collect money for setting up a tournament stage, and was just thinking about money.
Actually, it was not inconceivable that one would have to pay to challenge others. Otherwise, the tournament would not have such a setting.
Most importantly, he was a pure rookie, and did not have any battle merits. Who would challenge him?
So that was the case.
Ling Han nodded. He turned off the defending champion mode, and entered into challenge mode.
He began to look for a suitable opponent.
“Welcoming Cauldron Forging Tier.”
“Looking for fellow cultivators of Core Formation Tier to spar with.”
“Are there any friends at the peak stage of True Self Tier? Waiting.”
On the virtual screen, there were multiple stage numbers that set the conditions for accepting challenges, such as cultivation level, fees, bets, and whatnot.
Ling Han made his choice. He chose Foundation Building Tier, and instantly, the information of the challenges from the other cultivation levels was no longer displayed.
“Welcoming a Foundation Building Tier cultivator, let’s spar.”
“Foundation Building Tier, ranked around 30 million.”
“Ranking of around 50 million may enter.”
Ling Han took a look. F***, they basically all required a ranking.
Then let’s fight the Galaxy Network Level Battles first.
Ling Han summoned the virtual screen and chose the level battle. He immediately received a notification that an opponent was being searched for. He estimated that he would have to wait for an hour.
F***,so long?
“Forget it, I’ll go and challenge first.”

Ling Han chose a tournament stage that didn’t require levels. He stretched out a finger and pressed down on the virtual screen. Instantly, his figure turned into bits of light and disappeared. When he reappeared, he was already in a massive tournament ground.

On the other side, there was a tall, broad-shouldered young man. He looked quite handsome. However, the appearance that he showed here could all be disguised. Ling Han, for example, had completely become a different person.
Otherwise, merely using a code name would definitely not be enough to completely conceal his identity.
“Haha, Number One in the Galaxy?” That person was stunned. He had also discovered the code name that Ling Han had come up with. This was really daring, and looking at Ling Han’s past battle merits.
— Galaxy Network Rankings: Zero, ranked 1,286,753,433.
—Battle experience, zero.
Number of victories: zero wins and zero losses, zero draws.
‘Oh, so he’s a pure rookie. This is his first battle in the tournament.’

“Haha, what shameless boasting. A rookie actually dares to come up with such an exaggerated name.” That person laughed loudly, and charged towards Ling Han. “Today, let me teach you a lesson, and let you know the cruelty of the world.”
Ling Han moved. He had never battled in Galaxy Network Tournament before, so he needed to familiarize himself with it first.

At present, he was purely a soul, but he felt that his battle prowess had been completely replicated. Whatever celestial technique or whatever other technique, he could use it as normal, and there was no problem at all.
The power of a Great Emperor was truly kickass.
“Brat, aren’t you Number One in the Galaxy? What is it? Do you only know how to dodge?” That person laughed loudly, closing in on him with every move.
Ling Han felt that he was more or less familiarized now, so he raised a fist, which directly penetrated the other’s defense. With a peng, the other was instantly sent flying.
Pa, that person fell onto the ground, and his figure instantly turned into bits of light that disappeared.
This was the Galaxy Network’s judgement that he had already been “killed” by Ling Han, and had lost the right to continue fighting.

Xiu, Ling Han also retreated out of the battle area, and entered into the room from before — perhaps it had been changed, and the arrangements here were all the same. Who knew if he had entered into the same room.
He looked at his battle merits, which had become one win, zero loss and zero draw. However, Galaxy Network’s ranking was still a pitiful zero.
He hadn’t participated in the ranking battles yet, so he naturally wouldn’t have Galaxy Network’s rankings.
Again.
He searched again. As long as there was no requirement for rankings, he would enter and begin the battle.
In the Foundation Building Tier, he was already rarely matched. Once he familiarized himself with his current battle style, he instantly displayed an invincible battle prowess.
Peng! Peng! Peng!
He crushed everything in his path, and no one could withstand a single punch from him. In a short ten minutes, he had already defeated thirteen opponents.
This time, he had also gained some fame in the tournament forum.
—A mysterious elite had shockingly appeared, and had won all eleven battles.
Someone posted a thread, which instantly caused a great many people to discuss spiritedly..

‘Oh, so he’s a pure rookie.
This is his first battle in the tournament.’
“Haha, what shameless boasting.
A rookie actually dares to come up with such an exaggerated name.” That person laughed loudly, and charged towards Ling Han.
“Today, let me teach you a lesson, and let you know the cruelty of the world.”
Ling Han moved.
He had never battled in Galaxy Network Tournament before, so he needed to familiarize himself with it first.
At present, he was purely a soul, but he felt that his battle prowess had been completely replicated.
Whatever celestial technique or whatever other technique, he could use it as normal, and there was no problem at all.
The power of a Great Emperor was truly kickass.
“Brat, aren’t you Number One in the Galaxy?
What is it?
Do you only know how to dodge?” That person laughed loudly, closing in on him with every move.
Ling Han felt that he was more or less familiarized now, so he raised a fist, which directly penetrated the other’s defense.
With a peng, the other was instantly sent flying.
Pa, that person fell onto the ground, and his figure instantly turned into bits of light that disappeared.
This was the Galaxy Network’s judgement that he had already been “killed” by Ling Han, and had lost the right to continue fighting.
Xiu, Ling Han also retreated out of the battle area, and entered into the room from before — perhaps it had been changed, and the arrangements here were all the same.
Who knew if he had entered into the same room.
He looked at his battle merits, which had become one win, zero loss and zero draw.
However, Galaxy Network’s ranking was still a pitiful zero.
He hadn’t participated in the ranking battles yet, so he naturally wouldn’t have Galaxy Network’s rankings.
Again.
He searched again.
As long as there was no requirement for rankings, he would enter and begin the battle.
In the Foundation Building Tier, he was already rarely matched.
Once he familiarized himself with his current battle style, he instantly displayed an invincible battle prowess.
Peng!
Peng!
Peng!
He crushed everything in his path, and no one could withstand a single punch from him.
In a short ten minutes, he had already defeated thirteen opponents.
This time, he had also gained some fame in the tournament forum.

Someone posted a thread, which instantly caused a great many people to discuss spiritedly..

fight me. I’ll open the tournament stage.”

“If anyone is dissatisfied, come fight me.” He created a new post on the forum, and began the path of mass ridicule.
It wasn’t long before someone chose to battle him.

“Ceng Huayun, Galaxy Network’s ranking is 975,884,250. He has participated in 1006 battles, winning 305 battles, lost 701 battles, with 0 draws.” Looking at the spectators’ seats around them, more than twenty people had entered, which could be considered pitifully few.
Though Ling Han had become slightly popular on the forums, there were still not many people that were willing to “waste” time to watch a rookie battle.
“Number One in the Galaxy, haha, brain muddled—
Peng!

Resolved.
Clean, decisive, and relaxed.
p***l

“Hurry up and watch the replay.”

“We can only wait for the next battle.”
Ling Han continued to wait for another challenge. This time, he had earned 10 Universe Coins. Very good, he finally had a good start.

In just a short while, another person came in to challenge him, and because of the previous battle, the spectators called their friends over, and a dozen over people surged in. At the first instant, they paid to have the tournament platform record the battle.
This time, Ling Han’s opponent was a middle-aged man. Without another word, he immediately charged towards Ling Han.
Ling Han didn’t hold back either. He simply threw a punch. Peng! The battle was over.
In the spectators’ seats, though everyone was already mentally prepared, they still could not hide their shock.
“This guy’s strength can definitely rank in the top 100 million.”
“Hence, those ranked below 100 million should not come here to ask for a
rebuff.”

Someone immediately went to post, directly posting the battle video that had just been recorded. This quickly attracted the attention of a great many people, and they all replied with posts, expressing their admiration for Ling Han s strength.
“I boldly predict that this will be a new star, destined to dazzle the universe in future.”
“Hehe, do you really think that he is Number One in the Galaxy?”
“Now, his opponents are all ranked below 800 million, so it’s naturally difficult for them to block a punch from him. Let’s wait until his opponents charge into
100 million first.”
“That’s right. 100 million is the first dividing line. Being able to rise above ten people within 100 million, he is qualified to be called a prodigy.
Most of the people who replied thought that Ling Han was far from being a supreme prodigy, what more the Number One in the Galaxy.
However, there were more and more people challenging Ling Han, but every single one of them was instantly “killed” with a single punch, causing Ling Han’s reputation to become greater and greater.

Someone posted on the forum: “I beg the top 100 million elites of the Foundation Building Tier to appear and teach a madman a lesson.” In the post, there was a detailed list of the opponents that Ling Han had defeated, and some were even accompanied by battle videos.
“Heh, who dares to use the title of Number One in the Galaxy? Let me teach him a lesson, and tell him to immediately scram and change his name!” someone replied.
“Yi, this is Almighty Guan!”
“He’s an elite ranked above 90 million.”
“Haha, it’s assured now.”
Ling Han received a notification from the tournament platform. Someone was challenging him, and just as he was about to confirm it, he received another notification.
He had finished queuing up, and it was time for the level battles.
Without the slightest hesitation, Ling Han chose the level battle. He waited for this for an hour, so its priority was naturally high.
“Yi?”
“Why hasn’t the battle begun yet?”
“That’s not right. There isn’t even a tournament stage left.”
“Has this guy fled?”
‘■Haha, what a joke. He ran away the moment he saw Great God Guan.” “It can’t be helped. Guan Xuan is an elite ranked above 90 million, so it’s normal that he doesn’t dare to accept the challenge.”
“Sigh, I’ve been anticipating for nothing.”

When everyone saw that the battle had not begun for a long time, they all shook their heads repeatedly, and Guan Xuan, who had issued a challenge to Ling Han, smirked coldly. He immediately went to the forum to post a post, mocking Ling Han.

At this moment, Ling Han was currently spacing out in a tournament hall in boredom. This level battle was different from the tournament stage mode. After entering into the tournament hall, he had three minutes to adjust his condition, and this was compulsory.
How depressing. No matter what, he could still fight two to three tournament battles in three minutes, and earn twenty to thirty Universe Coins.
Finally, the three minute countdown had passed, and the invisible barrier that had been restricting his movement area had disappeared, allowing him to move unhindered in this massive tournament area.

Of course, his opponent had also left the space that bound him, and strode out. In these three minutes, Ling Han naturally looked at his opponent s information as well, but very coincidentally, the latter was also a rookie of Galaxy Network, just like him. This was his first tournament battle.

“You are really unfortunate.” The person on the other side was called Zhao Yongsi. It was unknown whether it was his real name or just a random name. He was tall and slender, and had a handsome face. It was also unknown whether it was his true appearance.

He crossed his arms behind his back, and looked towards Ling Han, “Though like you, this is the first time that I have connected to the Galaxy Network, I had previously been cultivating in seclusion, and had absolutely no chance to obtain the connection device.”
“I’m a four-star genius of Heavenly Dao Foundation!
His expression was filled with arrogance. This was definitely not faked..
