chapters.title: Chapter 3735: Being looked down on
paragraphs: Chapter 3735: Being looked down on
Editor: Henyee Translations

Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh in spite of himself. How could this Zhao Yongsi have imagined that he wasn’t some rich second-generation young master who had only gotten a connection device right after advancing into the Foundation Building Tier?
They were both Foundation Building Tier cultivators, and he was confident that he could completely thrash even five-star geniuses of Ultimate Dao Foundation. Then what was this Zhao Yongsi worth?
“Come, you win if you can block ten moves from me.” Ling Han crooked a finger at him.

Zhao Yongsi couldn’t help but feel enraged. He was a well-known existence among the younger generation of the Flying Origin Planet, and came from an extraordinary background. It was also because of this that the rules of his clan were very strict. Only after passing the mental trial, was he allowed a connection device and come into contact with the wider world.

The reason why he was not allowed to come into contact with Galaxy Network at the first instant was because he feared that his Dao Heart would be unstable, and he would lose all confidence from being beaten by an even stronger prodigy.

After this mental trial, his Dao Heart had stabilized. No matter how badly he was thrashed, he would not be so dispirited that he would lose his fighting spirit, that he would become a piece of trash right after losing a battle.

Thus, even though he wasn’t ranked in the Galaxy Network, in terms of true strength, he could be ranked in the top 20 Foundation Building Tiers on the Flying Origin Planet. This was still because he was a Heavenly Dao Foundation.
When he advanced into Ultimate Dao Foundation, he should be the top elite. After all, he was a four-star genius, and only one would appear in each generation.
Of course, in the universe, there were quite a number of four-star geniuses, and there were even freakish geniuses surpassing four stars.
A great prodigy like him, a great elite, and someone actually said that he would be defeated within ten moves?
Hehe, what a joke, the biggest joke in the world.

“Shameless boasting!” he smirked coldly. Then, with a leap, he charged towards Ling Han, “Brat, today, I will let you know what the difference in strength means. Remember this lesson and my name. Very soon, I, Zhao Yongsi, will become famous throughout the world!”
Ling Han stood still, waiting for his opponent to reach him. Only then did he throw a punch.
Zhao Yongsi faced the attack head-on. Boom! The two powers collided, and his expression immediately changed drastically. However, the majestic energy had already surged over, sending him flying.
Actually, there was no real clash of power. It was just that the Galaxy Network platform had simulated their mystical power, Spiritual Power, and corresponding techniques.
Why did it seem so real?

That naturally was the power of the Great Emperor. Every Ancestral King stood at the pinnacle of the world, and had been invincible for an era. Aside from being unable to attain immortality, they were definitely omnipotent.
Ling Han shook his head, and said, “Is that all you’ve got? Then you mightn’t even be able to withstand three moves.”𝒻𝑟𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝑛𝘰𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝘤𝘰𝘮
He did not use his full strength, but even so, the power of that punch was still not something that Zhao Yongsi could contend against.

Zhao Yongsi was slightly taken aback. If it was not for the fact that the number of Ling Han’s battles could not be faked, he would really suspect that this was a Cauldron Forging Tier or even stronger prodigy that had suppressed his cultivation level and was battling him.
Why was he so strong?
He was already a super rookie, so how could there be anyone more outstanding than him?
Zhao Yongsi did not believe this. He roared loudly, and charged towards Ling Han again.

Ling Han was completely unconcerned. He stretched out a hand to press, lay, control and parry, yet easily blocked all of Zhao Yongsi’s attacks. Furthermore, after each time he had defended, he still had excess power to blast towards Zhao Yongsi, causing him to feel incredibly terrible.
“Nine moves?” he asked with a smile.

Zhao Yongsi did not speak. He already knew that it was impossible for him to defeat Ling Han. His only hope was to withstand ten moves from Ling Han. In that way, at least he would not lose completely.
“Ah!” he roared loudly, channelling his strongest celestial technique. High- level energy surged, and his right hand actually turned into a green dragon’s head, which blasted towards Ling Han.
Ling Han also became slightly more serious as he unleashed his Demonic Monkey Fists at Zhao Yongsi.
Peng!

The Demonic Monkey Fists gave rise to boundless might, and was not something that Zhao Yongsi could stand against at all. With a single strike, he was sent flying, and his body turned into bits of light that immediately disappeared without a trace.
“Congratulations on obtaining your first victory. In this battle, you have obtained ten points. Seven hours later, the rankings will be updated according to the points.”

The basis for matching for the level battles was points. It was always those who had about the same points that would be exchanging blows with each other. Those who were stronger would rapidly rise, and those whose abilities were weak would be stuck at a certain point range, neither high nor low.
Because a loss would result in a deduction of points.
—Of course, for example, Zhao Yongsi had zero points in the first place, so there were no points to be deducted. There would not be any situation of negative points.
Ling Han also left the battle area. He returned to his “room” and continued to line up for the ranking battles. Another hour or so passed.

According to the rules of the tournament, the ranking battles would only be effective for the first three battles every day. Afterward, in any consecutive battle, and no matter who won or lost, there would be no points added or subtracted — the same was true for the opponent.

The ranking battles would be matched according to points. If one defeated someone who was ranked higher than himself, the points they would obtain would correspondingly be slightly more, and if they lost to someone who was ranked lower than themselves, the points deducted would also be slightly more.

Some people had calculated that even if they maintained a battle merit of complete victory, and fighting three rounds every day, it would still take at least a year to be able to enter into the top 1000.

If they could directly issue a challenge, perhaps a rookie would immediately become the strongest person in the rankings, but that was too exaggerated, and the current level battles could guarantee those in the top 1000 or top 10,000 were definitely true prodigies.

Ling Han went to the forum to take a look, and discovered that there were a great many additional posts on it. They were all directed at his “fleeing before battle”, expressing strong disdain towards him.

He went to open the tournament stage again, but no one came to accept the challenge. Instead, they sent him private messages, and insulted him for a while, forcing Ling Han to activate the function of only receiving private messages from his friends. Only then did the commotion finally calm down.
Yi, previously, he had only gone to participate in the level battle, and that was actually seen by others as abandoning the battle and becoming a deserter?

Forget it. He had also earned a considerable amount of Universe Coins today. Furthermore, as an elite, he could not stay at this level all the time. That was beneath him, and it would not be easy for him to earn a lot of money in future.
Ling Han didn’t exit the Galaxy Network platform. Instead, he went to the Alchemical Pill Hall.

Here, there were a great many alchemists selling alchemical pills. As long as you paid, you could directly get someone to pick up the goods. Of course, you could also choose to have the goods sent over, as long as the place you were at had a galaxy-level Transfer Formation.
—The transportation fees would be covered by the buyer.

Alchemists were a very rare profession, and the appearance of the Galaxy Network was extremely beneficial for alchemists. It could allow more people to fight over limited resources, which naturally doubled the status of alchemists.
What Ling Han wanted was not alchemical pills, but rather suitable pill recipes.

Pill recipes were unique. As long as they appeared once on the Galaxy Network platform, only the first seller would be able to continue selling them. The others would be counted as pirated copies, and if they were discovered, the culprit would be heavily punished.
Ling Han searched for the pill recipe that was most suited to him at this moment.

Firstly, he was presently only Foundation Building Tier, so his spiritual power was limited. At most, he could only concoct Two Star alchemical pills, which was also applicable to those in Cauldron Forging Tier. This was a very large restriction.

Secondly, he wanted to find a pill recipe that few other alchemists could concoct. This way, he could also concoct a cauldron’s worth of alchemical pills, but the profits would be ten times or even a hundred times that of alchemists of the same level.
“It’s you!”

High- level energy surged, and his right hand actually turned into a green dragon’s head, which blasted towards Ling Han.
Ling Han also became slightly more serious as he unleashed his Demonic Monkey Fists at Zhao Yongsi.
Peng!
The Demonic Monkey Fists gave rise to boundless might, and was not something that Zhao Yongsi could stand against at all.
With a single strike, he was sent flying, and his body turned into bits of light that immediately disappeared without a trace.
“Congratulations on obtaining your first victory.
In this battle, you have obtained ten points.
Seven hours later, the rankings will be updated according to the points.”
The basis for matching for the level battles was points.
It was always those who had about the same points that would be exchanging blows with each other.
Those who were stronger would rapidly rise, and those whose abilities were weak would be stuck at a certain point range, neither high nor low.
Because a loss would result in a deduction of points.
—Of course, for example, Zhao Yongsi had zero points in the first place, so there were no points to be deducted.
There would not be any situation of negative points.
Ling Han also left the battle area.
He returned to his “room” and continued to line up for the ranking battles.
Another hour or so passed.
According to the rules of the tournament, the ranking battles would only be effective for the first three battles every day.
Afterward, in any consecutive battle, and no matter who won or lost, there would be no points added or subtracted — the same was true for the opponent.
The ranking battles would be matched according to points.

If one defeated someone who was ranked higher than himself, the points they would obtain would correspondingly be slightly more, and if they lost to someone who was ranked lower than themselves, the points deducted would also be slightly more.

Some people had calculated that even if they maintained a battle merit of complete victory, and fighting three rounds every day, it would still take at least a year to be able to enter into the top 1000.

If they could directly issue a challenge, perhaps a rookie would immediately become the strongest person in the rankings, but that was too exaggerated, and the current level battles could guarantee those in the top 1000 or top 10,000 were definitely true prodigies.
Ling Han went to the forum to take a look, and discovered that there were a great many additional posts on it.
They were all directed at his “fleeing before battle”, expressing strong disdain towards him.
He went to open the tournament stage again, but no one came to accept the challenge.
Instead, they sent him private messages, and insulted him for a while, forcing Ling Han to activate the function of only receiving private messages from his friends.
Only then did the commotion finally calm down.
Yi, previously, he had only gone to participate in the level battle, and that was actually seen by others as abandoning the battle and becoming a deserter?
Forget it.
He had also earned a considerable amount of Universe Coins today.
Furthermore, as an elite, he could not stay at this level all the time.
That was beneath him, and it would not be easy for him to earn a lot of money in future.
Ling Han didn’t exit the Galaxy Network platform.
Instead, he went to the Alchemical Pill Hall.
Here, there were a great many alchemists selling alchemical pills.
As long as you paid, you could directly get someone to pick up the goods.
Of course, you could also choose to have the goods sent over, as long as the place you were at had a galaxy-level Transfer Formation.
—The transportation fees would be covered by the buyer.
Alchemists were a very rare profession, and the appearance of the Galaxy Network was extremely beneficial for alchemists.
It could allow more people to fight over limited resources, which naturally doubled the status of alchemists.
What Ling Han wanted was not alchemical pills, but rather suitable pill recipes.
Pill recipes were unique.
As long as they appeared once on the Galaxy Network platform, only the first seller would be able to continue selling them.
The others would be counted as pirated copies, and if they were discovered, the culprit would be heavily punished.
Ling Han searched for the pill recipe that was most suited to him at this moment.
Firstly, he was presently only Foundation Building Tier, so his spiritual power was limited.
At most, he could only concoct Two Star alchemical pills, which was also applicable to those in Cauldron Forging Tier.
This was a very large restriction.
Secondly, he wanted to find a pill recipe that few other alchemists could concoct.
This way, he could also concoct a cauldron’s worth of alchemical pills, but the profits would be ten times or even a hundred times that of alchemists of the same level.
“It’s you!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3736: Foundation Dissolution Pill
paragraphs: Chapter 3736: Foundation Dissolution Pill
Editor: Henyee Translations𝕗𝚛𝚎𝚎𝐰𝗲𝗯𝗻𝚘𝚟𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝕞
Foundation Dissolution Pill.
Ling Han chose this pill recipe. He was sure that this pill recipe would generate astonishing wealth for him.
What was the Foundation Dissolution Pill?
After consumption, it could melt the foundations of the Celestial Path.
Yi, then wasn’t this thing akin to poison to cultivators? Why would Ling Han still choose it?
That was because when a Foundation Building cultivator broke through, he would first have to melt his own Celestial Foundation, and the Foundation Dissolution Pill would be of great help.

For example, if a Human Dao Foundation wanted to break through to Heavenly Dao Foundation, they would first have to disintegrate the Human Dao Foundation, remove the impurities and preserve the purities. Then, with this as their core, they would be able to forge a new Celestial Foundation.
There was a problem with this. The foundation stones of the Celestial Path were incredibly sturdy, and some people did not have the ability to destroy it on their own.
This was not a fight, where the cornerstone of the Celestial Path could be forcefully shattered.

Thus, the Foundation Dissolution Pill could be of great help. Furthermore, the Foundation Dissolution Pill could also remove impurities, and further extract the purity of the foundation stones of the Celestial Path.

The Foundation Dissolution Pill could be ingested many times, purifying the foundation stone of the Celestial Path gradually. In this way, the Heavenly Dao Foundation that was molded would definitely be even more flawless and perfect.

The more perfect the foundation stone of the Celestial Path was, the more effective it would be in suppressing other foundation stones of the Celestial Path, and the higher the immunity to high-level foundation stones of the Celestial Path, or even the Celestial Cauldron.

For example, Ling Han. His Celestial Foundations were extremely perfect, and even Saints could not possibly suppress him. And once his Celestial Foundation was unleashed, which Foundation Building cultivator would not have their abilities decreased drastically?

After saying so much, the effects of the Foundation Dissolution Pill were naturally clear, but the problem was, since this alchemical pill was so effective, then there should be a lot of alchemists refining it, right? Once there was a large number, wouldn’t they still be worthless?
Hehe, this was linked to one of the ingredients in the Foundation Dissolution Pill.

Actually, it could not be considered raw ingredient, but when concocting the Foundation Dissolution Pill, an alchemist needed to infuse a sliver of power from his own Celestial Foundation into it. This was extremely important. Without this sliver of power from the Celestial Foundation, the Foundation Dissolution Pill would be a useless pill.
This decided that only alchemists at the level of Foundation Building Tier could concoct Foundation Dissolution Pills.
However, there was another problem. The difficulty level of refining this Foundation Dissolution Pill was extremely high. Usually, only Earth Tier alchemists would have enough skill to refine it.

Alchemists also had the requirement of cultivation level. For example, Ling Han was freakish in alchemy, but now, at most, he could only concoct Human Tier Medium Grade Celestial pills, and if he wanted to become an Earth Tier alchemist, he would have to at least have the cultivation level of Core Formation Tier,
If an Earth Tier alchemist did not have the power of the Celestial Foundation, how could he concoct the Foundation Dissolution Pill?

The Foundation Dissolution Pill was very expensive, and there was no lack of buyers but no one willing to sell it. This was because only a limited number of alchemist prodigies that could refine it. Moreover, the Foundation Dissolution Pills that they refined were not sold at all. Their own forces were already short of supply, so how could they possibly sell them?
A smile appeared on Ling Han’s face, “I am the only one who can earn this money.”
He bought the pill recipe for the Foundation Dissolution Pill. This pill recipe wasn’t too expensive. It only cost 500 Universe Coins.
Looking at the ingredients he needed, Ling Han gritted his teeth slightly. This could not possibly be gathered on the Celestial Sea Planet.
Thankfully, wasn’t there the Galaxy Network?
Ling Han could purchase it on the Galaxy Network, and have someone send it directly to Celestial Sea Planet via a Transfer Formation.

However, there were two problems with this. Firstly, would the seller not deliver the goods after receiving the money? Secondly, even if the seller delivered the goods, the Transfer Formation wasn’t his, so what if someone else took it?

Of course, Ling Han could also use the Transfer Formation or the shuttle to directly retrieve the goods from the seller’s planet. However, if he did this, it was either that the fee would far exceed the value of the Foundation Dissolution Pill or it would take too long, and it would be completely not worth it.
“Though the Celestial Sea Planet has awakened, it has been destroyed in the ancient times. In the end, it can’t compare to the real great planets.”

Ling Han sighed. Furthermore, now that the various great forces were entrenched here, they were storing all the Celestial medicines themselves, and could not be taken out to be sold at all. Even if they had the ingredients he needed, it would be useless.

By the looks of it, the Celestial Sea Planet was still unsuitable for cultivation — those below the Celestial Path could still be quickly promoted, but after coming to the Foundation Building Tier, the shortcomings were obvious.

The Galaxy Network Platform did have a mechanism to ensure the safety of goods, and that was after the buyer chose to buy, he would first have to transfer the money through the Galaxy Network Platform, and then the Galaxy Network Platform would be responsible for delivering the goods. When the goods had arrived for inspection, and after they had passed the inspection, only then would the money be transferred to the seller.
During this process, the Galaxy Network Platform would not collect service fees, but would collect transportation fees.

However, this method was only limited to those forces of the Chang Clan on various planets, because goods could only be delivered through a Transfer Formation. They only had to accept delivery of goods from this side of the formation.
Why was there no one to rob the goods of the Chang Clan?
Hehe, what kind of existence was the Chang Clan?
An Imperial Clan!

Furthermore, who would dare to rob the goods of the Chang Clan? Wouldn’t they be afraid that the Chang Clan would ban them, so that you would never be able to connect to the Galaxy Network, and truly become a native?
There were no forces of the Chang Clan on the Celestial Sea Planet, so it was a pity.

Ling Han could only make a trip to other great planets in the future, and purchase all the ingredients in one go. Then, he would concoct the Foundation Dissolution Pill there, and sell it through the Galaxy Network and the like. In any case, he did not have to bear the problem of the transportation fees.
In that case, he only had to teleport himself twice, and the fee would decrease greatly. No matter what, he would still have a profit.
After browsing for a while, an hour finally passed. He had joined the queue, and entered into the tournament grounds to begin the second ranking battle.
The opponent this time was not a pure rookie, but with such a low ranking, how could he possibly be a match for Ling Han?
With a light wave of his hand, Ling Han ended the battle.
This time, he received eleven points.
The opponent this time was clearly weak, so why had Ling Han obtained even more points?
That was because this second opponent had higher points.
Wasn’t this unfair?
It was slightly unfair, but compared to the overall justness of the points system, this little bit of unfairness had absolutely no effect.
Ling Han continued to line up. There were three rounds in a day, and he had to fight until the limit was reached.
He had time again, and came to the training hall.

This was a place to test one’s power. As mentioned before, Heaven Crushing, Origin and Myriad Dao, these three supreme prodigies, had repeatedly broken records in history, which included the limit of power in the training hall.

Entering here, one would have to pay an additional fee, because the test required the soul to take form first, and they would have to simulate the power and moves of the cultivator. This would consume additional energy, so there was naturally a fee.
So be it.
This was the same as the tournament. It cost one Universe Coin a day, which was very expensive.
After Ling Han paid, he entered the training hall.

The Celestial Path had nine levels, but there were only eight branch halls here, which corresponded to the cultivation level of the eight cultivation levels from Foundation Building to Silent Destruction Tiers. The only one missing was the Ancestral King level.
After becoming the Ancestral King, Galaxy Network couldn’t simulate the power of the Great Emperor at all.
Furthermore, the Ancestral King was already invincible, and could only appear once in an era, so what need was there for him to test his power?
He was number one in the world.
Even if all the Ancestral Kings in history were added together, just how many were there in total?
Ling Han naturally entered into the Foundation Building branch hall.
He took a look. Though this was a training hall, the power of the test was also varied.
Punch power, kick power, explosive power, and so on.
The least restricted was explosive power. No matter what method you used to blast the strength tester, it was fine. As long as the value was high enough, it would appear on the leaderboard.
And in this area, the name of Origin was high on the leaderboard.

chapters.title: Chapter 3737: On the Roll
paragraphs: Chapter 3737: On the Roll
Editor: Henyee Translations
It was Origin, a rookie that had suddenly appeared. No one knew his origins, and he was extremely mysterious.
However, it was this kind of person who had have the top explosive power in history at the Foundation Building Tier.
Ling Han stopped to watch. Aside from the lofty name of Origin, there was also a virtual screen beside him, on which a hundred names were listed.
These were the cultivators who had broken through to the Foundation Building Tier and entered the top 100 in terms of explosive power.

The first place was naturally still held by Origin, the record holder of the first place in all of history. Even if he died or his cultivation level increased, the position of first place would not change. As long as the Galaxy Network was not destroyed, and no one had surpassed it, his name would remain in this position forever.
Second was… Heaven Crushing, and third was Myriad Dao!

Origin, Heaven Crushing, Myriad Dao, these three people were all rookies that had suddenly appeared, yet all of them had broken records of all eternity. This was practically enough to make one speechless.
Yi?

This explosive power ranking was actually further divided into three, corresponding respectively to the Human Dao Foundation List, the Heavenly Dao Foundation List, and the Ultimate Dao Foundation List.

Of course, the first place on the Ultimate Dao Foundation Leaderboard was definitely the first place on the general leaderboard, because through the ages, there were innumerable prodigies. Was it possible to surpass the Ultimate Dao Foundation in terms of explosive power when one was in Heavenly Dao Foundation or Human Dao Foundation?

—If it was only limited to Celestial Sea Planet, Ling Han already had the confidence that he was the strongest in Foundation Building Tier when he was in Human Dao Foundation. However, in the entire universe, or even in fact compared to the prodigies of all eternity, he naturally wouldn’t be so blind.

He swept an eye over them. The name of Origin was shining above all the strength testers on the three leaderboards, and on the detailed leaderboard, Heaven Crushing and Myriad Dao were ranked second and third on the Ultimate Dao Foundation Leaderboard.

It wasn’t that they didn’t have enough explosive power when they were in Human Dao Foundation or Heavenly Dao Foundation, but rather that they had already advanced into Ultimate Dao Foundation. Unless they were the strongest in history, they couldn’t possibly leave their names on the Human Dao Foundation Leaderboard and Heavenly Dao Foundation Leaderboard.
On the other side, there were a few people testing their strength.
“Brother Ma has broken through to Heavenly Dao Foundation this time, and has also fused with an ancient Celestial stone, so his abilities have improved drastically.”
“This time, Brother Ma will definitely make it into the rankings.”
“Not only is he going to make it into the rankings, but he’s also going to become the number one person in history!”
“The so-called Origin, Myriad Dao, Heaven Crushing, all of them can only become stepping stones for Brother Ma.”

Those people were all cheering on the young man who was about to begin testing his strength. The person called Brother Ma looked to be in his mid-twenties. He had a handsome face, a slender figure, and had a kind of pride.
Towards his companion’s flattery, this Brother Ma chose to accept it completely, without the slightest bit of modesty.
His name was Ma Ning, and he was the true disciple of a great sect. He was quite valued by his sect.

And not too long ago, he had accidentally obtained a Celestial stone. It actually sank into his body when he had broken through to Heavenly Dao Foundation, and fused with the cornerstone of the Celestial Path, causing his strength to improve greatly.
“If Brother Ma makes it into the rankings this time, he would definitely be able to replace the current Dao Child.”

“That’s right. Even if this leaderboard is only focused on current Foundation Building cultivators, to be able to squeeze into the top 100 in the entire universe, that is definitely a prodigy among prodigies.”
“Brother Ma, we’ll all follow you in the future.”
Everyone continued to flatter him.
Ma Ning smiled proudly. He made his preparations. There was no time limit to this.
Ling Han also crossed his arms over his chest as he watched from the sidelines. He wanted to watch the excitement.
“Brat, you are really lucky to be able to witness this historical moment!” Someone saw Ling Han and immediately said to him.
Ling Han mocked internally. The people on the leaderboard were all in the Foundation Building Tier, so what kind of historical moment was this?
Unless one could overwhelm the ages and become the first in history, that would be the true historical moment.
He couldn’t be bothered to lower himself to the same level as these people. Furthermore, battling through the Galaxy Network would not hurt, so there was no need to waste his energy.
Ma Ning naturally saw Ling Han as well. He showed an expression of pride. Come, witness the moment of his rise.
He moved. Boom, his whole person rushed out, like a wild bull.
Peng!
His whole person had really crashed into the strength tester. The surface of the force he exerted was as big as a wall, so there was absolutely no need for him to worry that he would miss.
After the collision, numbers immediately flashed on the wall-like surface of the impact point, and finally stopped.
Six, six, seven, five.
“What, only the standard strength of 6650?”
“It can’t be, right? Previously, the Dao Child even shot out standard strength of more than 7000.”
Ma Ning’s companions were all whispering among themselves. Though power could not represent everything, it was the most direct embodiment of battle prowess.

Meanwhile, Ma Ning flew into a humiliated rage. This time, he was filled with confidence and planned to make it into the rankings first. In fact, he might even become number one in history. Then, becoming a Dao Child would be a sure bet.
However, he had never imagined that reality would be so cruel.
He… was still a long way off.
“I didn’t perform well just now,” he said.
He began to make preparations again. He was going to do it again.
Ling Han was displeased. ‘This training hall isn’t owned by you, so you can’t always occupy it all by yourself, right?’
He walked up, his attitude very obvious.
“Get lost!” Ma Ning shouted.
“That’s right. In front of my Brother Ma, what right do you have to step forward?”
“Obediently watch from the sidelines. There’s a gap of a few stars between you and Brother Ma. Don’t hinder Brother Ma!”
“Scram.”
Those people also shouted one after another. Some of them even came over to shove him.
Ling Han humphed. The souls here had taken solid form, so force could be used.
He shook lightly, and peng, that person was sent flying.
“How dare you!”
“You actually dare to make a move on us!”
“Are you tired of living?”
Everyone shouted. They were overlords on their own planets, and following Ma Ning around to strut around, they were used to being fearless.
Ling Han ignored him, and strode forwards.
Ma Ning wanted to stop him, but Ling Han had already shot out a punch at the strength tester.
He didn’t use any techniques, and it was just an ordinary punch.
Peng!
The strength tester trembled violently, and then numbers appeared. They flashed continuously, and soon stopped.
Hiss!
In that instant, Ma Ning and the others all gulped. Though they were actually soul form, and did not have any saliva to swallow at all, they had only subconsciously made this action.
Over 30,000, close to 40,000.
In comparison, what was standard strength of over 6000 that Ma Ning had blasted out worth?

Strength was indeed not the only thing that battle prowess counted for, but it was the most important component. With a power gap of six times between the two sides, battle prowess would also be overwhelming.
Moreover, they suddenly recalled that Ma Ning had prepared for a long time for this attack, and what about Ling Han? A casual punch.
“Look, he’s on the leaderboard!” someone whispered.𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺
As expected, there was another person in the top hundred, and he was ranked seventy-sixth.

In other words, Ling Han’s explosive power could be ranked 76th among all the Heavenly Dao Foundations in history. This result was enough to cause a commotion in the universe, and whichever great sect he went, there would be a fight to take him in as disciple.
“Number One in the Galaxy!” someone murmured. This was Ling Han’s name in Galaxy Network. No matter what record he broke, this was his name on the leaderboard..

The first place was naturally still held by Origin, the record holder of the first place in all of history.
Even if he died or his cultivation level increased, the position of first place would not change.
As long as the Galaxy Network was not destroyed, and no one had surpassed it, his name would remain in this position forever.
Second was…
Heaven Crushing, and third was Myriad Dao!
Origin, Heaven Crushing, Myriad Dao, these three people were all rookies that had suddenly appeared, yet all of them had broken records of all eternity.
This was practically enough to make one speechless.
Yi?

This explosive power ranking was actually further divided into three, corresponding respectively to the Human Dao Foundation List, the Heavenly Dao Foundation List, and the Ultimate Dao Foundation List.
Of course, the first place on the Ultimate Dao Foundation Leaderboard was definitely the first place on the general leaderboard, because through the ages, there were innumerable prodigies.
Was it possible to surpass the Ultimate Dao Foundation in terms of explosive power when one was in Heavenly Dao Foundation or Human Dao Foundation?
—If it was only limited to Celestial Sea Planet, Ling Han already had the confidence that he was the strongest in Foundation Building Tier when he was in Human Dao Foundation.
However, in the entire universe, or even in fact compared to the prodigies of all eternity, he naturally wouldn’t be so blind.
He swept an eye over them.

The name of Origin was shining above all the strength testers on the three leaderboards, and on the detailed leaderboard, Heaven Crushing and Myriad Dao were ranked second and third on the Ultimate Dao Foundation Leaderboard.
It wasn’t that they didn’t have enough explosive power when they were in Human Dao Foundation or Heavenly Dao Foundation, but rather that they had already advanced into Ultimate Dao Foundation.
Unless they were the strongest in history, they couldn’t possibly leave their names on the Human Dao Foundation Leaderboard and Heavenly Dao Foundation Leaderboard.
On the other side, there were a few people testing their strength.
“Brother Ma has broken through to Heavenly Dao Foundation this time, and has also fused with an ancient Celestial stone, so his abilities have improved drastically.”
“This time, Brother Ma will definitely make it into the rankings.”
“Not only is he going to make it into the rankings, but he’s also going to become the number one person in history!”
“The so-called Origin, Myriad Dao, Heaven Crushing, all of them can only become stepping stones for Brother Ma.”
Those people were all cheering on the young man who was about to begin testing his strength.
The person called Brother Ma looked to be in his mid-twenties.
He had a handsome face, a slender figure, and had a kind of pride.
Towards his companion’s flattery, this Brother Ma chose to accept it completely, without the slightest bit of modesty.
His name was Ma Ning, and he was the true disciple of a great sect.
He was quite valued by his sect.
And not too long ago, he had accidentally obtained a Celestial stone.
It actually sank into his body when he had broken through to Heavenly Dao Foundation, and fused with the cornerstone of the Celestial Path, causing his strength to improve greatly.
“If Brother Ma makes it into the rankings this time, he would definitely be able to replace the current Dao Child.”
“That’s right.
Even if this leaderboard is only focused on current Foundation Building cultivators, to be able to squeeze into the top 100 in the entire universe, that is definitely a prodigy among prodigies.”
“Brother Ma, we’ll all follow you in the future.”
Everyone continued to flatter him.
Ma Ning smiled proudly.
He made his preparations.
There was no time limit to this.
Ling Han also crossed his arms over his chest as he watched from the sidelines.
He wanted to watch the excitement.
“Brat, you are really lucky to be able to witness this historical moment!” Someone saw Ling Han and immediately said to him.
Ling Han mocked internally.
The people on the leaderboard were all in the Foundation Building Tier, so what kind of historical moment was this?
Unless one could overwhelm the ages and become the first in history, that would be the true historical moment.
He couldn’t be bothered to lower himself to the same level as these people.
Furthermore, battling through the Galaxy Network would not hurt, so there was no need to waste his energy.
Ma Ning naturally saw Ling Han as well.
He showed an expression of pride.
Come, witness the moment of his rise.
He moved.
Boom, his whole person rushed out, like a wild bull.
Peng!
His whole person had really crashed into the strength tester.
The surface of the force he exerted was as big as a wall, so there was absolutely no need for him to worry that he would miss.
After the collision, numbers immediately flashed on the wall-like surface of the impact point, and finally stopped.
Six, six, seven, five.
“What, only the standard strength of 6650?”
“It can’t be, right?
Previously, the Dao Child even shot out standard strength of more than 7000.”
Ma Ning’s companions were all whispering among themselves.
Though power could not represent everything, it was the most direct embodiment of battle prowess.
Meanwhile, Ma Ning flew into a humiliated rage.
This time, he was filled with confidence and planned to make it into the rankings first.
In fact, he might even become number one in history.
Then, becoming a Dao Child would be a sure bet.
However, he had never imagined that reality would be so cruel.
He… was still a long way off.
“I didn’t perform well just now,” he said.
He began to make preparations again.
He was going to do it again.
Ling Han was displeased. ‘This training hall isn’t owned by you, so you can’t always occupy it all by yourself, right?’
He walked up, his attitude very obvious.
“Get lost!” Ma Ning shouted.
“That’s right.
In front of my Brother Ma, what right do you have to step forward?”
“Obediently watch from the sidelines.
There’s a gap of a few stars between you and Brother Ma.
Don’t hinder Brother Ma!”
“Scram.”
Those people also shouted one after another.
Some of them even came over to shove him.
Ling Han humphed.
The souls here had taken solid form, so force could be used.
He shook lightly, and peng, that person was sent flying.
“How dare you!”
“You actually dare to make a move on us!”
“Are you tired of living?”
Everyone shouted.
They were overlords on their own planets, and following Ma Ning around to strut around, they were used to being fearless.
Ling Han ignored him, and strode forwards.
Ma Ning wanted to stop him, but Ling Han had already shot out a punch at the strength tester.
He didn’t use any techniques, and it was just an ordinary punch.
Peng!
The strength tester trembled violently, and then numbers appeared.
They flashed continuously, and soon stopped.
Hiss!
In that instant, Ma Ning and the others all gulped.
Though they were actually soul form, and did not have any saliva to swallow at all, they had only subconsciously made this action.
Over 30,000, close to 40,000.
In comparison, what was standard strength of over 6000 that Ma Ning had blasted out worth?
Strength was indeed not the only thing that battle prowess counted for, but it was the most important component.
With a power gap of six times between the two sides, battle prowess would also be overwhelming.
Moreover, they suddenly recalled that Ma Ning had prepared for a long time for this attack, and what about Ling Han?
A casual punch.
“Look, he’s on the leaderboard!” someone whispered.𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺
As expected, there was another person in the top hundred, and he was ranked seventy-sixth.
In other words, Ling Han’s explosive power could be ranked 76th among all the Heavenly Dao Foundations in history.
This result was enough to cause a commotion in the universe, and whichever great sect he went, there would be a fight to take him in as disciple.
“Number One in the Galaxy!” someone murmured.
This was Ling Han’s name in Galaxy Network.
No matter what record he broke, this was his name on the leaderboard..

chapters.title: Chapter 3738: Second
paragraphs: Chapter 3738: Second
Editor: Henyee Translations
“What arrogance!” Ma Ning said through gritted teeth, filled with jealousy.

He didn’t break records, and in fact, he was still very far from making it into the rankings. However, Ling Han easily fought his way to the seventy-sixth place. Even if he spoke arrogantly, his abilities were still clear for all to see. There was no real battle here, so Ma Ning didn’t need to be afraid that Ling Han’s strength would crush him.
‘What? You think you can hit me?’
Ling Han couldn’t even be bothered to pay attention to him. He was slightly surprised. Although he hadn’t used his full strength in this punch, he had only ranked 76th?
-If this thought of his was known to others, they would definitely rain insults on him.
Just a casual punch, and you got into the 76th place of the Heavenly Dao Foundations, what else do you want? Do you have to get first place?
Ling Han accumulated power slightly and channeled out the Demonic Monkey Fists. Peng, he delivered another blow onto the strength tester.
On the strength tester, a terrifying number froze, and Ling Han’s name also shot up from 76th to 9th.
This was crazy!
Ma Ning and the others were all gaping, completely rendered speechless.
Though this was only the current leaderboard of Heavenly Dao Foundation, to be able to make it into the top nine, what kind of astonishing result was that?
“Come and see, a super awesome person has appeared at the Foundation Building training hall.”

Ma Ning and the others weren’t the only ones here. It was just that the others weren’t testing their explosive power. However, Ling Han had made it into the rankings twice. With such a large number, how could no one have seen it?
Perhaps someone had missed the first time, but the second time would definitely be witnessed by a great many people.
Calling for friends, one after another, people appeared.

This was the Galaxy Network, and through the means of the Great Emperor, it had connected the souls of countless people across the universe. Naturally, this could be done with a single thought, and there was no sense of distance at all.

In just a short while, countless people had appeared here. Thankfully, this was a virtual reality. Once there were too many people, the venue would automatically enlarge, so there was no need to worry about feeling crowded. “Number One in the Galaxy?”
“F***, what bold words.”
“Yi, I know this person. Just now, he was still fighting on the tournament stage.”
“That’s him.”
“Yi, didn’t this guy flee before the battle?”
“That’S right. He encountered Guan Xuan, and did not even dare to fight.”
Hold on, that Guan Xuan who is ranked more than 90 million?”
“That’s him.”

“Til be the one chuckling. This guy’s explosive power has already charged into ninth place on the Heavenly Dao Foundation Leaderboard, and you’re actually telling me that he’s afraid of someone who’s ranked more than ninety million on the Galaxy Network Leaderboard?”
“Er…”

Being able to charge into the top nine in terms of explosive power in Heavenly Dao Foundation, this kind of battle prowess could be ranked quite high even in Ultimate Dao Foundation. There was definitely no problem for him to battle against someone who was ranked above ninety million.
Fled before battle?
What kind of joke was this?
“Yi, this guy seems to be about to try again.”
Everyone could see that Ling Han had raised his fist again.
“No way, he is still not satisfied with the ninth place?”
Boom!
Ling Han threw a punch. This time, he wrapped the Heavenly Dao Flames around his fist. Galaxy Network would simulate it.
His fist landed on the strength tester, and the numbers flashed madly again. 138,621.
It had reached a new height again.
“Heavens, close to 140,000.”
This guy’s battle prowess can probably crush 99% of those in Ultimate Dao Foundation.”
“If anyone says that he’s afraid to fight that Guan Xuan, I’ll drown him with a mouthful of saliva.”
“This is too terrifying. Standard strength of 140,000. Even in Ultimate Dao Foundation, this could probably advance into the top 1000.”

“Yes, someone has done an experiment. The standard strength of 100,000 of Heavenly Dao Foundation is equivalent to standard strength of 10,000 of Ultimate Dao Foundation. His results can definitely rank him in the top 1000 of the Ultimate Dao Foundation Leaderboard.”
Everyone cried out, feeling their scalps go numb.
Ma Ning and the others were already completely silent, and dejectedly retreated to the side.
In front of them was a rising star that could illuminate the universe. Relatively speaking, they were nothing.
“What rank is this?”
“Second, second!”
“Heavens!”

First place was impossible, because first place was first place for all eternity. Whether the record holder was now in the Foundation Building Tier or had already become an Ancestral King, his name would not be removed.
After countless years, who knew how many prodigies were pushing up this record? If one wanted to reach the top, they would have to surpass all the prodigies in history.
Was this possible?
A super monster had just appeared, and in fact, hr had surpassed many Ancestral Kings in the past. Could it be that an even more freakish person would appear?
“What a pity.”
“En, if this person appeared before Origin, it’s really possible that he could suppress eternity and obtain first place.”
“But now?”
“He can only be ranked second.”
However, being ranked second in the galaxy is also incredibly awesome.”
His fate was not good, and he encountered Origin.”

Hehe, there’s also Myriad Dao and Heaven Crushing. Although they’re suppressed by Origin in terms of power, their speed and comprehension ability have each broken an eternal record. Their overall strength isn’t weak at all.” “Being born in the present era is the tragedy of every prodigy. Three such monsters have appeared.”
Everyone shook their heads. Ling Han’s results were indeed astonishing, but with the existence of a monster like Origin, he was firmly suppressed.
-In the past, it was already enough to fight for second place, because the first place had long since belonged to the great elite who had passed away countless years ago.
But this time was different. Origin was still alive and well, and was even only in Ultimate Dao Foundation.
Ling Han was also slightly surprised. He had used the Demonic Monkey Fists and the Heavenly Dao Flames, yet he had actually failed to get first place?
This Origin was truly powerful.
Again.
Ling Han used the Demonic Monkey Fists again. This time, it was a series of
108 attacks, and added with the Heavenly Dao Flames, the Demonic Monkey Fists landed heavily on the strength tester.
Everyone was once again petrified, unable to say a single word.
As it turned out, standard strength of over 130,000 was still not Ling Han’s limit. This guy had almost blasted out standard strength of 200,000.
“This kind of explosive power… even in Ultimate Dao Foundation, he can be ranked around 800th.”
“Heavens, a Heavenly Dao Foundation is actually so strong?”
“Naturally. Could it be that you don’t know that when Origin blasted out close to 300,000 in standard strength, it was enough to rank in the 120s and 130s on the Ultimate Dao Foundation leaderboard?”
“In comparison, this person is still considerably inferior.”
“En, indeed.”
Everyone regained the ability to speak, but even if Ling Han was no match for Origin, he was still terrifying to the extreme.
It was also because of this that even more people appeared, and all of them had gone crazy.
Guan Xuan had also arrived, yet he continued to spout nonsense, using the matter of Ling Han’s previous “cowardice” to exaggerate the matter. He was trying his best to flatter himself.
Yet Ling Han was internally stunned. This Origin was actually so powerful, blasting out close to 300,000 in standard strength?𝓯𝙧𝓮𝓮𝒘𝓮𝙗𝙣𝒐𝒗𝒆𝓵.𝓬𝓸𝒎
This was 50% more than him.
Ling Han took a deep breath. By the looks of it, he needed to unleash his full strength.
The fact that Origin could surpass the prodigies of all eternity was definitely not because the prodigies of all eternity were weak, but rather because he was too freakish.

Ling Han unleashed the Three Styles of the God of War. At the same time, he stimulated the Destructive Energy. The two foundation stones of the Celestial Path were simulated in his body, and power was simultaneously released.
He channeled the power of the eye technique, and searched for the weak points on the surface of the strength tester. This could allow his battle prowess to unleash even greater destructive power..

chapters.title: Chapter 3739: Number one in all eternity!
paragraphs: Chapter 3739: Number one in all eternity!
Editor: Henyee Translations
‘Let’s try it!’
Ling Han charged out, delivering his strongest three strikes.
The Three Styles of the God of War, first attack.
Boom, Ling Han’s palms slammed down furiously, landing on the strength tester.
A number jumped, but it only showed over 200,000. Before it had completely stopped, Ling Han once again blasted out the second form of the Three Styles of God of War.
Peng!
This time, the number on the strength tester directly soared above 290,000.
”N-number one!”
“F*ck! He’s surpassed Origin!”
“The strongest in all of history!”
“My goodness, I must be dreaming. The record of Origin has been broken, and a new number one has been born!”

“Holy f*ck! It should be known that records become harder and harder to break as one progresses. Origin broke a record from 300 million years ago, but now, his record has actually only been maintained for a year.”
“Number One in the Galaxy!”
“Number One in the Galaxy!”
Everyone was beside themselves with excitement. Even though Ling Han had only surpassed Origin by a tiny bit, he had still surpassed him.
This was the strongest record in history, so it definitely could only be surpassed by a sliver. Otherwise, what would all the prodigies of the past generations be worth?
However, this was not the end.

Ling Han unleashed the final strike of the Three Styles of the God of War. The instant his palm struck the strength tester, he opened his mouth and spat out a golden sword, which he struck at the same time.
Boom! It was as if heaven and earth were shaking. It was as if the entire Galaxy Network was trembling.
A higher number jumped out, 312,526.
‘Holy f*ck!’
In an instant, those who had just been numb with excitement and incoherent were once again frozen, unable to say a single word.
The record had once again been broken.
Ling Han had broken the record that he had just created himself, and that previous record was definitely the shortest-enduring record in history. It had only existed for a mere second.
It had exceeded 300,000!

Throughout history, those who wanted to be ranked number one in Heavenly Dao Foundation would have to blast out more than 200,000 in standard strength. However, the record was getting higher and higher, and harder to break. Even the previous number one in history, Origin, could only blast out more than 290,000 standard power.
However, Ling Han suddenly pushed this record up to 300,000.
Everyone looked at Ling Han with admiration. He was number one in all of history, and even the Ancestral Kings and Saints had all been surpassed by Ling Han.

“Che, the first place of the Heavenly Dao Foundation doesn’t mean much. It should be known that many Ancestral Kings have never broken the record of first place. In fact, they are only ranked in the top ten or so, but in the end, they suppressed all prodigies and became the rulers of an era.”
Someone was deliberately belittling Ling Han.
“Hehe, if you can, go and set a record.”
“If you’re not capable, don’t blabber nonsense. This is the number one prodigy in history, surpassing all the prodigies in history. No matter what, hedeserves respect and praise.”
“That’s right.”
There was no need for Ling Han to speak. Immediately, there were a great many people targeting him, causing the face of the person from before to turn red with embarrassment.
On the strength tester, Ling Han’s name replaced the name of Origin. The “Number One in the Galaxy” was shining brightly.
There was no need for anything else. Just these words were enough to explain everything.

“Number One in the Galaxy has broken the record for explosive power of Heavenly Dao Foundation, and is specially rewarded with 1000 Universe Coins.” A cold voice rang out, yet it instantly spread throughout the entire Galaxy Network.
It was Galaxy Network’s soul.
“What?”
“The record of explosive power of Heavenly Dao Foundation has been broken?”
“You’ve got to be joking. Wasn’t it broken just over a year ago?”
“Even Galaxy Network’s soul has announced it on the entire platform, so it definitely can’t be fake.”
“Hiss, this Number One in the Galaxy is really awesome — come to think of it, this guy’s self-confidence is really bursting, to actually dare call himself Number One in the Galaxy?”
“In terms of explosive power alone, he is indeed the strongest in Heavenly Dao Foundation.”
This caused a great commotion on the Galaxy Network. Everyone began to investigate. Who was this “Number One in the Galaxy”? He could actually break the eternal record.
Though it was only one record, it encompassed the universe. If nothing unexpected happened, Ling Han’s record would be able to last for a few hundred million years, or even longer.
Upon investigation, everyone was dumbfounded.
As it turned out, Number One in the Galaxy had just entered the Galaxy Network.

Comparisons were truly infuriating. They didn’t know how long they had worked in the Galaxy Network, yet they hadn’t broken even half of a record. However, just look at Ling Han. He had entered the Galaxy Network the first day, and his name had already spread throughout the world.
Yet Ling Han gritted his teeth. If he was exposed like this, how would he be able to open tournament stages to earn money in future?
Who would still fight him?
En, he could only depend on those in Ultimate Dao Foundation.
However, the Chang Clan was really stingy. To break a record, they actually only gave him 1000 Universe Coins.𝕗𝕣𝐞𝐞𝘄𝐞𝚋𝚗𝗼𝘃𝗲𝗹.𝚌𝕠𝚖

—It was he who had wrongly blamed the Chang Clan. The various settings of the Galaxy Network had all been decided by the Four Directions Great Emperor all those years ago. The Chang Clan only had ownership, but could not interfere with the operations of the Galaxy Network. The Galaxy Network soul was the true ruler.
In the eyes of the Four Directions Great Emperor, the glory of breaking records naturally surpassed everything else. 1000 Universe Coins was merely a token.
Who knew that Ling Han was a poor man? As he saw it, the most important thing was to give him more Universe Coins.
However, small amounts would make a lot. If he broke a few more records, his gains would not be small either.
He left the strength tester, and went to look for a new opportunity to earn money.

Even an Imperial Clan would be moved by such a prodigy.
Ling Han arrived before the record of power.
The Three Styles of the God of War was a palm technique, and if he used the Demonic Monkey Fists now, would he be able to break the record again?
The holder of this record was also Origin.
Ling Han hadn’t even made a move, when he saw a person stride over. The others all separated, clearing a path for him.
That was because this person was a True Self Tier elite.

“The Li Clan is a Sect Master-level force.”
“Wrong, that prodigy from the Li Clan just broke through to the fourth pinnacle level not too long ago, and became a Venerate Tier elite. Now, the Li Clan is a Venerate Tier-level force.”

‘Let’s try it!’
Ling Han charged out, delivering his strongest three strikes.
The Three Styles of the God of War, first attack.
Boom, Ling Han’s palms slammed down furiously, landing on the strength tester.
A number jumped, but it only showed over 200,000.
Before it had completely stopped, Ling Han once again blasted out the second form of the Three Styles of God of War.
Peng!
This time, the number on the strength tester directly soared above 290,000.
”N-number one!”
“F*ck!
He’s surpassed Origin!”
“The strongest in all of history!”
“My goodness, I must be dreaming.
The record of Origin has been broken, and a new number one has been born!”
“Holy f*ck!
It should be known that records become harder and harder to break as one progresses.
Origin broke a record from 300 million years ago, but now, his record has actually only been maintained for a year.”
“Number One in the Galaxy!”
“Number One in the Galaxy!”
Everyone was beside themselves with excitement.
Even though Ling Han had only surpassed Origin by a tiny bit, he had still surpassed him.
This was the strongest record in history, so it definitely could only be surpassed by a sliver.
Otherwise, what would all the prodigies of the past generations be worth?
However, this was not the end.
Ling Han unleashed the final strike of the Three Styles of the God of War.
The instant his palm struck the strength tester, he opened his mouth and spat out a golden sword, which he struck at the same time.
Boom!
It was as if heaven and earth were shaking.
It was as if the entire Galaxy Network was trembling.
A higher number jumped out, 312,526.
‘Holy f*ck!’
In an instant, those who had just been numb with excitement and incoherent were once again frozen, unable to say a single word.
The record had once again been broken.
Ling Han had broken the record that he had just created himself, and that previous record was definitely the shortest-enduring record in history.
It had only existed for a mere second.
It had exceeded 300,000!
Throughout history, those who wanted to be ranked number one in Heavenly Dao Foundation would have to blast out more than 200,000 in standard strength.
However, the record was getting higher and higher, and harder to break.
Even the previous number one in history, Origin, could only blast out more than 290,000 standard power.

This is the number one prodigy in history, surpassing all the prodigies in history.

chapters.title: Chapter 3740: Recruiting
paragraphs: Chapter 3740: Recruiting
Editor: Henyee Translations

Li Leidong was naturally unconvinced. He humphed, “The Venerable Tier elite of our Li Clan is a supreme prodigy. Though he has just become a Venerable Tier, his future prospects are boundless. It is not impossible for him to become a Saint in future!1‘

“Hahahaha!” Wang Jian roared with laughter. “I’m about to laugh myself to death! Do you think Saints are as common as cabbages? Even prodigies have to bow their heads before the doors into Saint Tier. Not only does one need natural talent to become a Saint, but they also need to possess good fortune.” “Wang Jian, do you dare to look down on our Venerate Tier?” Li Leidong said balefully, his killing intent cold.

Wang Jian didn’t reply. The Wang Clan was able to oppose the Li Clan, and in fact, they were even slightly more powerful. However, he definitely couldn’t speak rudely about a Venerate Tier elite. Otherwise, if that great elite of the Li Clan made a move and killed him, no one would be able to avenge him.
Elites needed to be respected, especially those from Sect Master Tier onwards. Weaker cultivators were definitely not allowed to slander such elites.
“Young man, what’s your choice?” Wang Jian looked towards Ling Han. What was there to compete with Li Leidong?
“Join the Li Clan, and I guarantee that there will be no shortage of cultivation resources for you!” Li Leidong hurriedly said.
“Hehe, how could the background of a newly advanced Venerate Tier-level clan compare to the background of our Wang Clan?” Wang Jian humphed.
However, Ling Han ignored both of them. He yearned for freedom, and it was definitely impossible for him to join any force.
How could it be that the resources of forces like this could be taken for free?
There was a price to pay for everything. There was no free lunch in this world.
He channeled the Demonic Monkey Fists and fused it with the Destructive Energy. Then, he suddenly charged forward and threw a punch.
Peng, the strength tester immediately showed the value, and it began to jump rapidly.
More than 280,000.
He had made it into the rankings, but had not broken any records. First place was still Origin.
“Hehe, Origin broke the record with his fist technique, reaching as high as 290,000 in standard strength,” someone said.
So that was the case. Though Ling Han had broken the record for explosive power, it did not mean that he was number one in all aspects throughout history.
“Young man, we were talking to you!” Li Leidong shouted loudly, appearing slightly furious.

This mere Heavenly Dao Foundation actually dared to ignore him. He was truly outrageously bold. Who did he think he was? So what if he had broken an eternal record? After all, his cultivation level was still too low.
In this world, no matter how prodigious you were, you still had to respect elites.
Ling Han merely glanced at him before turning around to leave. Since he couldn’t break this record, he would break other records. In any case, there were all kinds of records here.
“Stop right there!” Li Leidong roared.
Ling Han acted as if he had not heard anything, and continued onwards.
“I told you to stop!” Li Leidong spat out word by word. He had been angered by the young man in front of him.
Ling Han had that kind of ability, easily angering others, even if this person was here to recruit him.
Ling Han still ignored him. He had seen the record of speed, but the creator of this record was not Origin, but rather a person called “Across Mountains”.
Across Mountains was a Saint, but he had long since passed away.

It was rumored that he had been a supreme prodigy all those years ago, and was a strong competitor for the position of becoming an Emperor, becoming an Ancestral King. From the fact that he had created an eternal record in terms of speed, it was clear that this person indeed possessed astonishing talent.
Unfortunately, being momentarily stunning did not mean that he would be stunning forever. In the end, the Across Mountains Saint still lost, and stopped at Saint Tier.
Then let’s test out this record.
Ling Han made an attempt, but though he easily made it into the list, he was still unable to break the record.

He sighed. Though he had broken the historical record of explosive power, but in terms of fist power, kick power, and so on, he was still not strong enough to become the strongest in all aspects in history.
Firstly, it was because he hadn’t reached the peak stage of Heavenly Dao Foundation yet, and secondly, his fist techniques and foot techniques weren’t powerful enough.
Yes, take it slow. Breaking all the records in a single day would be quite boring. “You!” Li Leidong roared from the sidelines, already in a thunderous rage.
Ling Han glared at him, and said, “What are you shouting for? If you’re not convinced, in a battle of equal cultivation levels in the tournament, it’s your win if you can block ten moves from me.”
Li Leidong wanted to agree, but just as he opened his mouth, he forcefully swallowed his words.
In a battle of equal cultivation levels, who could match this guy who had the strongest explosive power in history?
He wasn’t just the number one in the world, but the number one in all of history. The value of both was completely different.
If he stubbornly agreed, he would only be seeking his own humiliation.
Yi?
A thought flashed in Ling Han’s head. He had received another notification from the Galaxy Network. The hour-long queue had ended, and he could now participate in the level battles.
Confirmation.
Xiu, Ling Han instantly disappeared into thin air, and appeared in the tournament grounds.
His opponent was a young girl. When she discovered that her opponent was Ling Han, she couldn’t help but scream in shock.

“You’re Number One in the Galaxy, the one who just broke the record for the explosive power of Heavenly Dao Foundation!” The young girl was so excited that she was almost incoherent, her eyes shining. ”1 admire you so much, you’re my idol!”
Ling Han couldn’t help but sweat. “We’re fighting now!”
“Idol, how could I possibly be a match for you?” the young girl hurriedly said. “Idol, let’s take a photo together!”
She approached, and issued a payment that allowed Galaxy Network to activate its recording function. Then, she posed in various positions around Ling Han.
After a long while, she was finally satisfied. She took the initiative to admit defeat, and her figure instantly disappeared from sight.
In this battle, Ling Han still obtained eleven points.
He thought for a moment, then exited the Galaxy Network platform.
Hu, Ling Han stood up, pushed open the doors and left.

Only a short two hours had passed, and he had already caused a storm on the Galaxy Network. Now, everyone would remember “Number One in the Galaxy”, and there would definitely be countless forces that would begin to search for him.

Ling Han found Lin Luo and the others, and made friends with them on the Galaxy Network. Then, he transferred some Universe Coins to each of them. Next, he was sure that Lin Luo and the others would also make a name for themselves on the Galaxy Network, and become the generation of super rookies.

The connection device itself had the function of a optical computer, and could store information. As long as the information was downloaded, even if one couldn’t connect to the Galaxy Network, it could still be viewed.

However, with Ling Han’s memory, there was naturally no need for him to deliberately turn on the optical computer to look at the recipe for the Foundation Dissolution Pill. He merely recalled it in his mind, and the pill recipe clearly appeared in his mind, allowing him to simulate the concoction process.

After an hour, Ling Han believed that as long as he was given the raw materials, he would only fail once or twice, at most, and summarizing his experience, he would be able to concoct a successful pill.
The night passed quietly. On the morning of the second day, after Ling Han finished cultivating, he began to practice the Demonic Monkey Fists.
Brother Monkey’s ancient ancestor was an Ancestral King, and had been invincible for an era. The Demonic Monkey Fists that he had created was naturally a noble Imperial Technique.
Among the Great Emperors of the world, who was weaker than the other?
He could break records with the Three Styles of the God of War, but why couldn’t he do the same with the Demonic Monkey Fists?
It wasn’t that the Demonic Monkey Fists were weak, but rather that he couldn’t unleash the true might of the Demonic Monkey Fists.

“I’m going to find Brother Monkey,” Ling Han murmured. “Firstly, I’ve already advanced to the Foundation Building Tier, and my formation abilities have also improved greatly. I’m now qualified to try to decipher Celestial level formations. Secondly, I still have the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. I should be of some help to Brother Monkey.”
“Let’s see if I can help Brother Monkey escape this time..”

chapters.title: Chapter 3741: Preparing to Break the Seal
paragraphs: Chapter 3741: Preparing to Break the Seal
Editor: Henyee Translations

Ling Han left just like that. This time, he didn’t bring Princess Bixiao with him. Instead, he brought the empress, Hu Niu, and the large black dog. Tang Yun’er naturally couldn’t be left behind, so Ling Han decided to simply use her shuttle. In just a few hours, they had already arrived near Haiping Mountain.
They landed, and then Ling Han used his movement technique, bringing them along with him.

Second King!” When they saw Ling Han, the monkeys called out one after another. Their advancement was very fast, and a great many of them had already advanced into Foundation Building Tier. In fact, the one who advanced the fastest was already in Ultimate Dao Foundation.
Ling Han’s expression darkened, “I already told you, don’t call me Second King, I am not the slightest bit stupid!?”
“Then what about Second Leader?” a monkey asked tentatively.
“Hahahaha!” The large black dog rolled around on the ground and laughed, “You idiot, so even monkeys know that you are stupid.”
These words offended the monkeys. Immediately, a few baboons jumped out, each grabbing onto one of the large black dog’s legs and lifting him up.
We can eat dog meat today.” These monkeys were also gluttons, and began to drool.
“Little Han, save me, save me!” the large black dog hurriedly shouted.
Ling Han laughed loudly, “Forget it, spare its wretched life.”

Only then did the monkeys toss the large black dog onto the ground. Some of their eyes were shining, clearly not giving up on the idea of eating dog meat, scaring the large black dog so much that it clamped its tail between its legs, and followed closely behind Ling Han.
“Second Leader, please,” the monkeys called out.
The corners of Ling Han’s mouth twitched. Why couldn’t these monkeys learn?
“Call me Leader Ling!” he emphasized.
Alright, Second Leader!” The monkeys readily accepted.
Forget it. Ling Han sighed.
He arrived at the depths of the Monkey Valley, and saw Brother Monkey. This great elite from the ancient age had still been suppressed at the foot of the mountain, and had not escaped.
“Brother Monkey,” Ling Han called out.
Second Brother, you’re here.” Brother Monkey glanced at him, and couldn’t help but nod in gratification. “You’ve broken through to the Foundation Building Tier.”

Weng, a divine light actually shot out of Brother Monkey’s eyes, sweeping over Ling Han. Then, he revealed an expression of shock, and said, “Second Brother, you have actually formed two foundation stones of the Celestial Path!”
Was this a kind of eye technique? So powerful, it could actually see into his mind.𝑓𝓇𝘦ℯ𝘸𝘦𝑏𝓃𝑜𝘷ℯ𝑙.𝑐𝑜𝓂
This is the Fiery Golden Eyes Mystical Power of my race, created by Old Sun’s distant ancestor. It can only be cast with the power of bloodline,” Brother Monkey explained.
Oh, so it was passed down from the Ancestral King, Brother Monkey’s ancestor. Ling Han couldn’t help but feel curious, and asked, “Brother Monkey, what’s that old senior’s name?”

Brother Monkey was proud, “Ancestor was a Stone Monkey nurtured by the spirit of heaven and earth. When he was young, he travelled all over the universe, and secretly learnt from others. In the end, he walked his own path, and became the Ancestral King of his generation, known respectfully as the Battle Saint Emperor!”

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel engrossed. When he channeled the Demonic Monkey Fists, he discovered that there would be a rebellious Demonic Monkey that would appear, striking the heavens above and shattering the depths of hell below. That aura was truly unprecedented and domineering.

“Brother Monkey, the lifespan of an Ancestral King is also limited. Furthermore, there is no sign of an Ancestral King. I heard that the most recent Ancestral King is the Great Emperor of the Human Race.” Ling Han was slightly puzzled.

Ling Han found this strange. Brother Monkey had only been suppressed, but had not been killed. That was because the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire feared that the Battle Saint Emperor was still alive, but logically speaking, this Demon Race’s Great Emperor should have long since died.

In his later years, my ancestor went to a dangerous place to seek the path of immortality. From then onwards, he has never returned,” Brother Monkey said. “That was at the edge of the universe. When he got there, my ancestor’s suppression of the fortune of heaven and earth also dropped to the weakest level. After millions of years, heaven and earth also returned to normal, and there would be another person who could become an Emperor.”

‘However, many great elites have deduced that my ancestor did not die. Instead, he was battling in that danger zone, because there would occasionally be world-shaking battle scenes flashing in some corner of the universe.”
Brother Monkey looked at the sky, and said, “After Old Sun becomes a Saint, I’ll go find my ancestor. If he’s trapped in that desperate situation, Old Sun will save him no matter what!”

If it was another person saying this, Brother Monkey would definitely treat it as a joke.
Wasn’t it?

Even an Ancestral King could possibly be trapped. Even if he became a Saint, it would still be extremely dangerous for him to go to that danger zone. Ling Han was presently only a mere Foundation Building Tier, and could not even be considered a speck of dust.
However, Brother Monkey believed in Ling Han’s potential.
Having cultivated two foundation stones of the Celestial Path, just how amazing was that?
Unprecedented!
Ling Han picked some interesting things to share with Brother Monkey, including the fact that he had broken the record of power for Heavenly Dao Foundation in Galaxy Network.

Brother Monkey laughed loudly. “Second Brother, you’re really impressive. Although Old Sun managed to make it into the leaderboard back then, I was still a little short of breaking the record of being the strongest in history. Haha, as expected of Old Sun’s brother!”
“Brother Monkey, I’ve come to see if I can help you escape,” Ling Han said.

Though Brother Monkey only had to advance into the fourth pinnacle level, and become a Venerate Tier, he would be able to escape, Brother Monkey had also said that this could possibly take a few years, or even over a hundred years. After all, he had never stepped onto this level before. Everything was only his own deduction.
What if?
Moreover, how could the difficulty of breaking through while being suppressed be the same as breaking through normally? It would also be much more dangerous.

Ling Han first went to check on this formation, but the formation that suppressed Brother Monkey was too high-level, and he had nowhere to start. “Second Brother, your cultivation level is not high enough. No matter how talented you are in formations, it is useless.” Brother Monkey shook his head. He looked in a certain direction in the skies, “That old b@stard from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, suppressing Old Sun for more than two thousand years. When Old Sun breaks free, I will beat you to death with a single staff strike!”
There was nothing else that could be done. He could only use this move.
Ling Han took out the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower. He hadn’t even opened his mouth to speak, when Brother Monkey was immediately moved.

“This is… Imperial Weapon!” Brother Monkey blurted out. Then, he shook his head repeatedly, “No, no, the might of the Imperial Weapon should far surpass it. A wisp of aura would be able to turn Old Sun into dust. This is only forged by Origin Gold, a the future Imperial Weapon.”
As expected of Brother Monkey, his insight was extremely sharp.
“Brother Monkey, can this help you?” Ling Han asked.
“There should be hope.” Brother Monkey was also a little eager to give it a try, and looked excited.
If he could do anything about it, how could he be willing to be trapped?
“Second Brother, Old Sun has instilled the Mystical Power into the Imperial Weapon. You control it and bombard the mountain above Old Sun,” Brother Monkey said.
“All right!” Ling Han nodded vigorously.
