chapters.title: Chapter 3742: Brother Monkey returns
paragraphs: Chapter 3742: Brother Monkey returns
Editor: Henyee Translations
Brother Monkey roared loudly, and a golden light appeared above his head, turning into a small monkey that flew towards Primal Chaos Extreme
Lightning Tower.
Ling Han suddenly recalled, and hurriedly said, “Brother Monkey, there are still Heavenly Dao Flames in this tower.”
This fire could burn even Venerate Tier elites to death. He didn’t want to accidentally screw Brother Monkey over as well.
Zhi!
Brother Monkey hurriedly braked. The little monkey flashed. Xiu, it surged back into Brother Monkey’s body.
“Really?” Brother Monkey asked.
Ling Han nodded earnestly, “When I was refining the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, I went to the site of Heavenly Dao Flames.’
“That’s right. Without the Heavenly Dao Flames, there is absolutely no way to shape the Origin Gold.” Brother Monkey nodded.

“After I refined the Imperial Weapon, I also used the internal space of the Imperial Weapon to retrieve some Heavenly Dao Flames. However, after I stowed the Heavenly Dao Flames, its might decreased greatly. It can only burn Venerate Tiers to death,” Ling Han continued.
Brother Monkey couldn’t help but grimace at this show-off.
He was only at the level of Sect Master. Even in front of a weaker version of the Heavenly Dao Flames, he could only kneel.
“It’ll be easy if you have the Heavenly Dao Flames. Second Brother, go to the mountain peak and pour out the Heavenly Dao Flames,” Brother Monkey said.
Ling Han was astonished, and he asked, “Will that hurt you?

“It’s fine. The Heavenly Dao Flames can easily incinerate this formation. Without waiting for the flames to burn down, Old Sun has already escaped,” Brother Monkey said proudly, but changed the topic, and continued, “However, just in case, let the monkeys retreat first.”
“All right.”
Ling Han began to evacuate the monkeys, leaving the Monkey Valley far behind, and that included the empress, the large black dog, and the others.
Then, he returned to the Monkey Valley all by himself, and flew up to the summit.
“Brother Monkey, I’m about to begin.”
“Let’s begin.”

With a thought from Ling Han, boom, the Heavenly Dao Flames immediately surged out from the eighth level of the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower, burning at the summit and rapidly spreading, burning towards the waist of the mountain.
He hurriedly controlled the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to fly away.
When Brother Monkey appeared, it would definitely be world-shaking.
Boom, the Heavenly Dao Flames spread very quickly, surging all the way down the mountain, burning everything and nothing could not be destroyed.
This was an extreme flame that could burn even Venerate Tiers to death, and could be considered Pseudo Saint-level.
Ling Han was slightly anxious. Why hadn’t Brother Monkey appeared yet?
If the Heavenly Dao Flames really reached the foot of the mountain, that wouldn’t be a joke.

He had best head to the foot of the mountain to take a look. If Brother Monkey couldn’t do it, he would then withdraw the Heavenly Dao Flames. Of course, it was impossible to withdraw all of them, but it should be no problem to only withdraw the flames around Brother Monkey.

However, before Ling Han could make a move, peng, an earth-shattering bang was heard, and the great mountain beneath suddenly exploded. A figure that looked like a streak of light shot out from underneath, shooting straight into
the horizon.
“I, Old Sun, have come out!”
In the blink of an eye, that streak of light shot down from the skies again, turning into a furry monkey.

This monkey’s body was covered with golden fur, and he was as tall as three meters. His golden eyes were filled with fire, and they exuded a ferocious might as he looked around. It was as if even heaven and earth was beneath his notice.
It was Brother Monkey.
Ling Han felt that it was a little blinding. That was because Brother Monkey was completely naked. Thankfully, it was covered with fur. Otherwise, it would really leave a psychological scar on him.
“Come!” Brother Monkey shouted lightly. Xiu, xiu, xiu! Countless golden shadows flew towards him. Pa, pa, pa, they continuously stuck to his body, turning into a dazzling golden armor.
Then, he stretched out a hand and dug in his ear. Instantly, a golden needle was taken out.
Yi, such a mighty and domineering Brother Monkey was actually using a golden needle as his weapon?
This, this, this, this, so feminine, his eyes were about to pop out of his head.
“Change.”

With a soft exclamation from Brother Monkey, the golden needle enlarged continuously, turning into a staff. It was completely golden, and there were also veined patterns on it, exuding a majestic and domineering aura.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝒆𝔀𝒆𝙗𝓷𝒐𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝓶
As it turned out, this could be shrunk and enlarged.

The material that could become bigger and smaller had to be at least of the level of the Minor Advanced Tier. However, Brother Monkey was a Sect Master elite, so it was naturally very normal for him to possess such a treasured staff. “This is Saintly Material, and it’s also a replica of Ancestor’s Wishful Golden Cudgel,” Brother Monkey explained. He stood proudly in the sky. As a Sect Master-level, he naturally didn’t need to wield a Tool to stand in the sky.

Ling Han laughed loudly, and said, “Congratulations, Brother Monkey!” Brother Monkey nodded, “Thanks to Second Brother’s heaven-defying good fortune, not only did you obtain Origin Gold, but you also forged an Imperial Weapon and absorbed the Heavenly Dao Flames. Otherwise, Old Sun would have to endure for a while longer.”
“Come, let’s go down and talk.”

The two of them landed on the ground. However, the Monkey Valley had already been completely destroyed, but since Brother Monkey had already escaped, he was presently the strongest on the Celestial Sea Planet, so where could he not go?

After reuniting with everyone and the monkeys, Brother Monkey used his great power and brought them to a place of natural beauty. He first settled the monkeys down, then the monkeys took out the fine wine they had brewed and began to celebrate.
Ling Han let go of his worries. He didn’t think about anything else, and simply drank fine wine with Brother Monkey every day.
Seven days later, the banquet finally ended.
■■Second Brother, do you find it strange that the Demonic Monkey Fists are inferior to the Three Styles of the God of War?” Brother Monkey took the initiative to talk about this matter.

Ling Han hadn’t mentioned it before because he didn’t want Brother Monkey to think that he was using his action of rescuing him to coerce him. Although Brother Monkey wasn’t a petty person, he didn’t want there to be any misunderstanding between the two of them.
However, since Brother Monkey had taken the initiative to mention it, Ling Han nodded.
The Demonic Monkey Fists was created by an Ancestral King. Logically speaking, even if it wasn’t the strongest in the world, it should still be ranked among the strongest.

Brother Monkey smiled, and said, “That so-called Three Styles of the God of War should have been left behind by the Battle God Palace. The Battle God Palace is a Holy Land, so how could a mere Saint-level technique possibly compare to an Imperial Technique?”
“Moreover, the Three Styles of the God of War isn’t the ultimate technique of the Battle God Palace. It’s just that your cultivation level is still too low, so the difference isn’t very obvious.”
Ling Han was extremely curious, and he asked, “Then why?

“That’S because the Demonic Monkey Fists that I taught you were only suitable for you to cultivate in the mortal level. Now that you’ve advanced into the Celestial Path, it’s naturally different,” Brother Monkey said with a smile.
It was that simple!

Ling Han couldn’t help but feel surprised. A fist technique that was used by mortals could still unleash a powerful might when used on Celestial Path. It was only slightly weaker than the Three Styles of the God of War, so how strong would the Celestial Path-level Demonic Monkey Fists be?
“Come, Old Sun will teach you.”

Ling Han began to cultivate the Demonic Monkey Fists with Brother Monkey. This was an Imperial Technique, and it wasn’t something that he could slowly analyze with a tap of the finger and some teachings from Brother Monkey.

This was the world’s highest grade celestial technique. Not only did it need to be taught by example, it also needed to be carefully comprehended. Those with poor aptitude could not possibly learn it in a hundred or a thousand years.
Even if Ling Han’s comprehension ability was so nature-defying, he would not be able to grasp it in a short period of time.
A whole month had passed, and he had finally grasped the Demonic Monkey Fists… It was only at the superficial level, and he was still far from grasping the core.

Ling Han planned to return to the Imperial Capital to take a look. Brother Monkey was also quite interested, so he decided to go with Ling Han to the imperial Capital to see his junior, Chen Fengyan. Then, he would leave the Celestial Sea Planet, and only go to the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire after he had become a Venerate Tier.
En, he wondered if Chen Fengyan would call him uncle this time..

It was that simple!
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel surprised.
A fist technique that was used by mortals could still unleash a powerful might when used on Celestial Path.
It was only slightly weaker than the Three Styles of the God of War, so how strong would the Celestial Path-level Demonic Monkey Fists be?
“Come, Old Sun will teach you.”
Ling Han began to cultivate the Demonic Monkey Fists with Brother Monkey.
This was an Imperial Technique, and it wasn’t something that he could slowly analyze with a tap of the finger and some teachings from Brother Monkey.
This was the world’s highest grade celestial technique.
Not only did it need to be taught by example, it also needed to be carefully comprehended.
Those with poor aptitude could not possibly learn it in a hundred or a thousand years.
Even if Ling Han’s comprehension ability was so nature-defying, he would not be able to grasp it in a short period of time.
A whole month had passed, and he had finally grasped the Demonic Monkey Fists…
It was only at the superficial level, and he was still far from grasping the core.
Ling Han planned to return to the Imperial Capital to take a look.
Brother Monkey was also quite interested, so he decided to go with Ling Han to the imperial Capital to see his junior, Chen Fengyan.
Then, he would leave the Celestial Sea Planet, and only go to the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire after he had become a Venerate Tier.
En, he wondered if Chen Fengyan would call him uncle this time..

chapters.title: Chapter 3743= Time Chamber
paragraphs: Chapter 3743= Time Chamber
Editor: Henyee Translations
After only a few hours, Ling Han returned to the Imperial Capital.
Brother Monkey walked casually, while Ling Han logged into Galaxy Network.

In this one month, he had been earnestly cultivating the Demonic Monkey Fists. He had completely forgotten to eat or sleep, and rested no more than an hour every day. He was really just resting his brain.
In this state, he naturally didn’t have time to log onto Galaxy Network.
The moment he logged into the Galaxy Network, he immediately received a
large number of friend requests.
“Friend, we have important matters to discuss.”
“Young man, I am from the Nine Winds Holy Land.
“Brother, please approve my friend request.”

Most requests had side notes. Ling Han only looked through a few before choosing to ignore them. The reason why he had logged into the Galaxy Network this time was not for the sake of ranking or earning money, but rather because he had heard from Brother Monkey that the Galaxy Network had a function called the Time Chamber.
In the Time Chamber, the flow of time would be many times faster than normal, similar to the Reincarnation Tree, which only targeted the soul.
However, the fee for the Time Chamber was very high, extremely high.

It used one day’s time as an example. Acceleration of two times would require a payment of 100 Universe Coins. Three times would mean 500 Universe Coms, ten times would mean 10,000 Universe Coins, and a hundred times would mean five million!
Though Ling Han had also earned a little money, he could only choose to cultivate at twice the speed for a few days, at most.
However, Brother Monkey was rich and imposing, and told Ling Han to choose the best Time Chamber because he had money.
In the past, he had been a Sect Master great elite. This kind of existence could be called an elite anywhere in the universe, so his ability to earn money was naturally very strong.
Something like the Universe Coins could not possibly be snatched away by the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, even if Brother Monkey had been captured and suppressed years ago.
After befriending Brother Monkey, a transfer message was immediately sent
over.
“You earned 100 million Universe Coins.”
Ling Han gritted his teeth. Brother Monkey was indeed rich. Fine, he was in desperate need of Universe Coins now. It wouldn’t be too late to repay him in the future.
He asked for a Time Chamber where time flowed 100 times faster, and had the platform automatically deduct his payment, right until he walked out, or right until all his Universe Coins were expended.

In the Time Chamber, Ling Han continued to cultivate the Demonic Monkey Fists. This required a large amount of time to practice. Under normal conditions, it was very normal to only grasp the core after too or 1000 years.
However, Ling Han couldn’t wait for that long. He wanted to master this fist technique as soon as possible.
Thankfully, he had Brother Monkey.
Ling Han entered the Time Chamber and started to practice his fist technique.
This was time acceleration of too times. Very quickly, a year had passed, and then another year had passed. His mastery of the Demonic Monkey Fists was getting deeper and deeper.

Why had he only just begun to enter the Time Chamber to cultivate? It couldn’t be helped. Previously, he hadn’t grasped the superficial details. He had to have Brother Monkey give him pointers step by step. Now that he had finally grasped the general idea, he could practice on his own.
Three years, five years, time flew by. Ling Han was now a pure spirit form, so he could focus all his energy on practicing his fist technique.
He still wanted to continue cultivating, but was forced to leave the Time
Chamber.
100 million Universe Coins had already been deducted.
Already?

Ling Han thought for a moment. 100 million Universe Coins could only allow him to cultivate here for 20 days in real time. Then, even if it was sped up a hundredfold, it would only be 2000 days, which was slightly over five years.
His money… was not enough.

The Chang Clan was truly black-hearted, charging such a high fee. However, he finally mastered one of the moves of the Demonic Monkey Fists. There was only one style, and the real Demonic Monkey Fists was made up of nine styles. The first style was also the simplest.
It had been five years, and he had only mastered one move, and it was the simplest move at that.
Ling Han sighed. This was an Imperial Technique!
Let’s go and test out the might of the new Demonic Monkey Fists.
Ling Han went to the reaining hall, then came to the fist strength tester.
“Yi, Number One in the Galaxy is here again.”
‘Almost two months have passed, and his level ranking is actually still just
over 1.1 billion.”
“How strange. With his strength, he can be ranked in the top 200 even among Ultimate Dao Foundation. Why isn’t he fighting in a level battle?”
Someone discovered Ling Han’s presence, and immediately began to send out messages, summoning friends. And friends called friends, and more and more people ran over.
Ling Han didn’t accept private messages, so those noble clans and sects could only personally come over to recruit him.
Xiu, xiu, xiu! One after another, mighty figures appeared. They were all True Self Tier-level elites, and there were even Spirit Transformation True Lords.
Ling Han ignored everyone else. Instead, he channeled the Demonic Monkey Fists and entwined them with the Destructive Energy before launching an attack at the strength tester.
Hong, his body exuded golden light, as if there was a Demonic Monkey that had fused with him, exuding an aura that would make one tremble.
“This, this is an Imperial Technique!”
“Only Imperial Techniques can possess such might!”
“Heavens, this is the heir of an Imperial Clan.”
“Forget it, let’s all go back. He is the heir of an Imperial Clan, so how could he possibly be recruited?”

There were great elites observing in secret, and when they saw Ling Han’s punch, they immediately exclaimed in surprise. Furthermore, there was not just one such great elite, and they all voiced their agreement.
This was a descendant of an Imperial Clan. Even the Holy Lands were not qualified to recruit him.
Peng!
Ling Han’s fist landed on the strength tester, and instantly, a terrifying number popped up.
“Heavens, he broke his own record!”
Ling Han had broken the record for the maximum power of a punch, but it was equivalent to breaking the record for explosive power as well.
Everyone was astounded. This wasn’t just breaking the record by a little bit, but raising the record by a whopping 30,000.
Youf****** freak.

Yet Ling Han sighed. Imperial Techniques were definitely not just 10% stronger than Saint Techniques. However, his cultivation level was too low, so there was no fundamental difference in the might of an Imperial Technique and a Saint Technique.
This was really the limit of his battle prowess, unless he could also grasp the other eight moves of the Demonic Monkey Fists.
Ling Han was already queuing up for the level battles. This would take some time, so he first contacted Lin Luo and the others.

Close to two months had passed, and Lin Luo and the others had also made a name for themselves on the Galaxy Network. Their rankings had increased very quickly, and were currently ranked in the 80 millions respectively. Compared to Ling Han’s 1.1 billion, they were on two completely different levels.
After conversing with Lin Luo and the others, Ling Han also finished queuing up and began the level battle.
The battle soon ended. Ling Han had just exited the tournament hall when he received a friend request, and the person who had sent the request was… Origin!
The mysterious prodigy, Origin, had created a record for pinnacle strength. At present, there were still a great many records that he had created in the training hall.
Ling Han pondered for a moment before accepting the friend request from Origin.
“Battle?”
The other party sent a simple and direct message.
“All right,” Ling Han replied.
In just a short while, Origin sent him a tournament stage number.

Ling Han took a look. This tournament stage was set with Absolute Cultivation Level. In this kind of tournament battle, not only would the major tier of cultivation level be pulled into the same level, even the minor tier of cultivation level would be equal. It could be claimed that it was an absolute battle between equals.
There were no conditions for the battle. It was only set that only Ling Han could enter into the tournament stage.
However, while the tournament stage had a rule about who to battle against, there was no restriction on the spectators. Everyone could enter to watch the battle.
A single stone would give rise to a thousand ripples.
“Everyone, come quickly.. Origin is going to fight with Number One in the Galaxy!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3744: First battle with Origin
paragraphs: Chapter 3744: First battle with Origin
Editor: Henyee Translations
Origin versus Number One in the Galaxy.
This was an incomparably explosive piece of news. These two people had both set a record for the highest limit of strength, and the gap between the two records was only over a year.
In the same era, two such prodigies actually appeared?
When Ling Han broke the record of explosive power created by Origin over a month ago, some people were guessing who would win if Origin and Ling Han battled at the same cultivation level.
A great many people also posted on the forum, egging on Origin to issue a challenge to Ling Han, or Ling Han to issue a challenge to Origin.
However, Origin remained silent the entire time, and Ling Han hadn’t logged into the Galaxy Network for more than a month. Thus, passersby could only feel excited for nothing.
And now, Origin finally moved, issuing a challenge to Ling Han.
Would Ling Han agree?
A great many people had already entered into that tournament stage at the first instant, and were waiting for Ling Han to appear.
However, Ling Han still hadn t appeared.𝙛𝒓𝓮𝒆𝔀𝒆𝙗𝓷𝒐𝙫𝒆𝙡.𝒄𝓸𝓶
“He doesn’t dare to fight?”
“That’s right. The news should have spread long ago, but Number One in the Galaxy still hasn’t appeared. He must be afraid of battle.
“F***, and he calls himself Number One in the Galaxy? He really dares to
boast.”
“He doesn’t even dare to fight at the same cultivation level, so how can he be called Number One in the Galaxy?”
Everyone was filled with disdain, but just as they were talking excitedly, they saw that they had all been forcibly pushed out of this tournament area.
Yi, what was going on here?
They immediately discovered that Origin had already canceled this tournament
stage.
Origin had been angered into leaving?
No!
“Look, Number One in the Galaxy has set up another tournament stage, issuing
a challenge to Origin.”
“Origin has already entered.”
“Quick, let’s go too.”
“Yi, there’s a fee for entering to watch the battle?
“F***, he actually wants 1000 Universe Coins?”
“This is screwing me over!”
“It’s a robbery!”
Everyone was making a big fuss. There was actually a fee? There was no fee for
Origin’s tournament stage.

Hiss, a guess rose up in all of them. Could it be that it was because Ling Han had not accepted the challenge previously, not because he was afraid of battle, but because he wanted to create a tournament stage himself to collect money?
‘This money grubber, are you f*cking greedy for money?’
In the battle between two ultimate elites in history, what kind of sacred and dignified matter was this? You f****** actually charged? Charged a fee!
It could not be helped. No one wanted to miss out on this kind of battle. Even if there were people who could record it, the majority still wanted to witness it at the first instant.
Wasn’t it just 1000 Universe Coins? Just give it to him!
Everyone couldn’t suppress their urge to “see” with their own eyes. They all chose to have Galaxy Network deduct 1000 Universe Coins, and entered into the tournament area.
1000 Universe Coins to watch a battle was truly exorbitantly expensive. However, the two people battling were the two most powerful elites in history, so who would be willing to miss such a battle?
There was no shortage of true disciples of great sects, and important heirs of noble clans. Gritting their teeth, 1000 Universe Coins was not something that they could not afford.
Of course, Ling Han would definitely be hated by them. This person was really too good at earning money, wasn’t he?
Yet Ling Han was completely unconcerned. In such an incomparable battle, if he did not collect some money, how would he be able to forgive himself?
He was very poor now.
“You have obtained 999 Universe Coins.”
“You have obtained 999 Universe Coins.”
“You…”
Ling Han continued to receive notifications from Galaxy Network, and his wallet quickly filled up.

“Hurry up and start!” Opposite him, Origin appeared to be very displeased. ■For better or worse, you have broken an eternal record, but now, for the sake of earning some money, you actually dragged me into your tournament stage.’ This was supposed to be a battle of the strongest, yet it had actually become so filled with the smell of money?
It’s your business whether you want to be shameless or not, but you can’t drag me down with you.
“Hold on, hold on.” Ling Han waved his hand. He listened to Galaxy Network’s notifications, and felt very pleased.
Let the Universe Coins fly for a while longer.
Origin had no more patience. He roared loudly, and charged towards Ling Han. How could this kind of money grubber stand side by side with him?

Origin’s figure was extremely tall and sturdy, as if he was the embodiment of a primitive giant. Even if he was a spiritual manifestation, there was still an image of a dragon and phoenix wrapped around each of his arms.

“Innate Divine Physique, Dragon Phoenix Everlasting Saint Physique. Everyone was exclaiming in shock Origin was an Innate Divine Physique. This wasn’t a secret, but most people didn’t have the chance to se Origin. They had only heard about it, and now that they had seen him, it was indeed true.
What was a Saintly Physique?
Only those who possessed a first-class Innate Divine Physique were qualified to be called Saint Physique. In itself, they were synonymous with power.
Boom, Origin shot out a punch, and the power of two punches blasted out, turning into a dragon and a phoenix respectively, that charged towards Ling
Han.
Ling Han was naturally unafraid. Using the Three Styles of the God of War, he charged towards Origin.
The Three Styles of the God of War was a powerful move that he had used to break the record of all eternity, so its might was naturally astonishing. The ultimate power was even superior to Origin.
Hong! Hong! Hong!

The two of them exchanged blows. They were both people who had broken the record for the highest limit of power. Both of them had astonishing power. Not only were they standing at the highest limit of Heavenly Dao Foundation, they were also the strongest in history.
Multiple attacks exploded, and the whole tournament hall seemed to be trembling, with endless shards of seals flickering.
“Too terrifying, this is really too terrifying.”
“Although I’m a Ultimate Dao Foundation cultivator], I’m sure that I’ll be shattered if I come into contact with it.
“Two monsters.”
“The power of Heavenly Dao Foundation is already this strong, so how on earth have they cultivated this kind of power?”
Everyone’s eyes were bright, and they couldn’t help themselves.
However, Ling Han discovered that even though the Galaxy Network was constructed by a Great Emperor, it still had some shortcomings.

If he were using the Three Styles of the God of War in reality, his body would definitely be flooded by the power of heaven and earth once the three Styles of the God of War were used and he wouldn’t be able to channel it again.
Otherwise, his body would definitely explode and die.

However, he was a pure spiritual manifestation now, so he didn’t need to worry about any physical burdens at all. He unleashed the Three Styles of the God of War over and over again, and there were no side effects at all.
Additionally, he had absolutely no need to worry about the problem of exhausting his mystical power. He could use any kind of powerful move as much as he liked.

Thus, Ling Han believed that elites were indeed powerful when battling on the Galaxy Network. However, when there was a gap of 10 or even under 100 ranks between elites. If they were battling in real life, perhaps those who were ranked lower would win.

Taking into account all kinds of realistic problems, it would cause a change in the strength of the cultivators, and even cause a great change in fact. Additionally, in this place, no one would have to worry about the problem of exhausting their mystical power, but in the real world, probably only Ling Han would not have to worry about this. Thus, battling in the Galaxy Network, this advantage of his was completely concealed.
There was also the Spirit Tool. Ling Han had a future Imperial Weapon, but in the Galaxy Network, a Spirit Tool would not be simulated as well.
Of course, in the tournament, one could also choose to use weapons in battle, but it would only have the basic attributes, and would not have any additional effects.
Ling Han nodded internally. The fact that the Galaxy Network could connect everyone in the universe was already incredibly amazing. It definitely could not be perfect and flawless.
Even so, this still couldn’t conceal the strength of Origin.

It was really powerful. His fist technique was like a violent storm, and Galaxy Network had perfectly manifested the power of his Innate Divine Physique. The two great Divine Beasts, the Dragon and Phoenix, were both releasing powerful might, as if he was not fighting alone, but rather had the Immortal Dragon and the Immortal Phoenix joining forces with him.
As expected of someone who had broken the record for the pinnacle of strength..

He listened to Galaxy Network’s notifications, and felt very pleased.
Let the Universe Coins fly for a while longer.
Origin had no more patience.
He roared loudly, and charged towards Ling Han.
How could this kind of money grubber stand side by side with him?
Origin’s figure was extremely tall and sturdy, as if he was the embodiment of a primitive giant.
Even if he was a spiritual manifestation, there was still an image of a dragon and phoenix wrapped around each of his arms.
“Innate Divine Physique, Dragon Phoenix Everlasting Saint Physique.
Everyone was exclaiming in shock Origin was an Innate Divine Physique.
This wasn’t a secret, but most people didn’t have the chance to se Origin.
They had only heard about it, and now that they had seen him, it was indeed true.
What was a Saintly Physique?
Only those who possessed a first-class Innate Divine Physique were qualified to be called Saint Physique.
In itself, they were synonymous with power.
Boom, Origin shot out a punch, and the power of two punches blasted out, turning into a dragon and a phoenix respectively, that charged towards Ling
Han.
Ling Han was naturally unafraid.
Using the Three Styles of the God of War, he charged towards Origin.
The Three Styles of the God of War was a powerful move that he had used to break the record of all eternity, so its might was naturally astonishing.
The ultimate power was even superior to Origin.
Hong!
Hong!
Hong!
The two of them exchanged blows.
They were both people who had broken the record for the highest limit of power.
Both of them had astonishing power.
Not only were they standing at the highest limit of Heavenly Dao Foundation, they were also the strongest in history.
Multiple attacks exploded, and the whole tournament hall seemed to be trembling, with endless shards of seals flickering.
“Too terrifying, this is really too terrifying.”
“Although I’m a Ultimate Dao Foundation cultivator], I’m sure that I’ll be shattered if I come into contact with it.
“Two monsters.”
“The power of Heavenly Dao Foundation is already this strong, so how on earth have they cultivated this kind of power?”
Everyone’s eyes were bright, and they couldn’t help themselves.
However, Ling Han discovered that even though the Galaxy Network was constructed by a Great Emperor, it still had some shortcomings.

If he were using the Three Styles of the God of War in reality, his body would definitely be flooded by the power of heaven and earth once the three Styles of the God of War were used and he wouldn’t be able to channel it again.
Otherwise, his body would definitely explode and die.
However, he was a pure spiritual manifestation now, so he didn’t need to worry about any physical burdens at all.
He unleashed the Three Styles of the God of War over and over again, and there were no side effects at all.
Additionally, he had absolutely no need to worry about the problem of exhausting his mystical power.
He could use any kind of powerful move as much as he liked.
Thus, Ling Han believed that elites were indeed powerful when battling on the Galaxy Network.
However, when there was a gap of 10 or even under 100 ranks between elites.
If they were battling in real life, perhaps those who were ranked lower would win.
Taking into account all kinds of realistic problems, it would cause a change in the strength of the cultivators, and even cause a great change in fact.
Additionally, in this place, no one would have to worry about the problem of exhausting their mystical power, but in the real world, probably only Ling Han would not have to worry about this.
Thus, battling in the Galaxy Network, this advantage of his was completely concealed.
There was also the Spirit Tool.
Ling Han had a future Imperial Weapon, but in the Galaxy Network, a Spirit Tool would not be simulated as well.
Of course, in the tournament, one could also choose to use weapons in battle, but it would only have the basic attributes, and would not have any additional effects.
Ling Han nodded internally.
The fact that the Galaxy Network could connect everyone in the universe was already incredibly amazing.
It definitely could not be perfect and flawless.
Even so, this still couldn’t conceal the strength of Origin.
It was really powerful.
His fist technique was like a violent storm, and Galaxy Network had perfectly manifested the power of his Innate Divine Physique.

The two great Divine Beasts, the Dragon and Phoenix, were both releasing powerful might, as if he was not fighting alone, but rather had the Immortal Dragon and the Immortal Phoenix joining forces with him.
As expected of someone who had broken the record for the pinnacle of strength..

chapters.title: Chapter 3745: A tie?
paragraphs: Chapter 3745: A tie?
Editor: Henyee Translations
Origin was unbelievably powerful. Moreover, he didn’t need to worry about the burden on his body at all. He could use all kinds of powerful techniques and repetitively.
For example, his Innate Divine Physique, logically, couldn’t be channeled continuously, but it was possible here.

Of course, this was also because Ling Han was too strong. Otherwise, if it was any other opponent, Origin would have been able to deal with him in a single move. What need was there for the battle to be so drawn out?
The two of them battled fiercely, and it was hard to decide the victor.
This was the first time Ling Han had encountered such a powerful opponent. In a battle of equal cultivation levels, he had always been invincible, but Origin could completely contend against him.
That’s right. His explosive power was indeed slightly stronger, but if he didn’t use the Demonic Monkey Fists, his advantage wouldn’t be very obvious.
Most importantly, Origin was not a strength tester, and would not allow him to attack as he liked.
Strength was indeed the most important element of battle prowess. However, strength definitely didn’t guarantee victory, unless it reached a crushing level.

This kind of battle was completely based on individual strength. If they were battling in the outside world, Ling Han wouldn’t believe that there would be a second Foundation Building cultivator who could possess an Imperial Weapon.
For Ling Han, this kind of opponent also filled him with endless fighting spirit.
Only by relying on one’s own strength to defeat such an opponent could one truly achieve victory.
He channeled out the Demonic Monkey Fists. Instantly, a Demonic Monkey fused with him, causing his aura to suddenly soar greatly.
This was an Imperial Technique, and merely its aura alone was enough to suppress 99% of Foundation Building Tier cultivators. They were completely unqualified to oppose it.
However, Origin was completely unaffected.
Ling Han was astounded. Could it be that the foundation stone of the Celestial Path that he had cultivated was also a replica of the primitive Celestial Gate?
Otherwise, the spiritual body could not possibly rely on any kind of Spirit Tool, so how would it be able to resist the intimidation of an Imperial Technique?
He remembered that when he had been leaping over the Celestial Gates, he had seen a figure at the end. Was that Origin?
But if that was Origin, it would not match in the timeline.
Unless… one more person had come to the primitive Celestial Gate!
Hiss, what was wrong with this world? A freak like Ling Han and Origin should only appear once in several great eras, but now, they appeared one after another.

Don’t forget that there was also Heaven Crushing and Myriad Dao. The strength and talent of these two people should not be inferior to Origin, and added with that mysterious prodigy, the number of super freaks was as many as five people.
Ling Han withdrew his idle thoughts, and continued to battle fiercely with his strongest opponent.

The two of them were like peacocks, bursting forth with the brightest light, causing every single member of the audience to be unable to take their eyes off them. In fact, even their breathing had stopped.
Thankfully, they were spiritual manifestations now, so even if they didn’t breathe, it wouldn’t affect them at all.
“Who can win?”
“It seems to be a complete tie.”
“This is really too shocking. Aside from Origin, Myriad Dao and Heaven Crushing, another incredibly freakish guy has actually appeared.”
“What kind of era are we living in now? In the past few great eras, it was rare for even one such prodigy to appear, and now, all of a sudden, four of them have appeared.”
Everyone sighed ruefully. Being born in this kind of era was practically the tragedy of all prodigies.

It was now the Foundation Building Tier, and in future, it would be the Cauldron Forging Tier. Then, it would be the Core Formation Tier. Whichever cultivation level Ling Han and the others advanced into, it would cause chaos among the prodigies of that cultivation level.
Ling Han believed that if he continued to use the Demonic Monkey Fists, even if it was only the first style, he should still be able to defeat Origin.

However, he could channel the Demonic Monkey Fists continuously now, but in the real world, he could only use it once in a short period of time. A powerful secret technique naturally had harsh conditions for casting, so how could he channel it continuously?
Ling Han didn’t need to win in this way.
Furthermore, once he defeated Origin, that would be one less gimmick. How would he be able to earn money from ticket fees in future?
Yes, he could not win, but he could not lose either.
Ling Han maintained his battle prowess the entire time, and it did not change. When a day had passed, the tournament authorities forcefully interfered, and ended the battle between the two of them.
A tie?
No, Ling Han had been judged to have won.
Why?

Because Origin’s cultivation level was higher, even if the two of them were at the peak stage of Heavenly Dao Foundation, Ling Han still hadn’t reached the peak stage of Heavenly Dao Foundation yet. He was at a disadvantage.
Fighting to a tie in a disadvantageous situation, it was naturally his victory.
Origin was defeated.
“Unfair, this is too unfair!”
“One isn’t weak at all!”
“Completely biased!”
This caused a great many people to protest, because everyone was already very dissatisfied with the fact that Ling Han was charging fees in the first place, so it naturally exploded.
However, this rule had been set by the Four Directions Great Emperor in the past, so what was the use of protesting? The Galaxy Network soul completely ignored it.

Ling Han was extremely satisfied with this result. Not only had he won, but he had also drawn the displeasure of many people. They were defending Origin. In this way, when he and Origin battled again, more and more people would definitely come to watch the battle.
He took a look. The battle he was fighting had actually attracted 730,000 people to watch the battle. Each of them had paid 1000 Universe Coins, which was a total of more than 700 million!
Heavens, he had earned too million Universe Coins in one go, and there was still a lot more than that.
Too bad, this kind of battle could not be carried out continuously. If there was too many of such battles, it would not be so attractive. No one would complain about having too much money.
After battling for three ranking battles, he exited the Galaxy Network.
Now, he had a lot of money, but the problem was how to spend it.
On this planet?
Hehe, there was not much difference between having money and not having money.
However, he was so hungry!

Ling Han immediately felt an intense hunger. After cultivators advanced into Celestial Path, they would be able to survive as long as they could absorb the power of heaven and earth. However, this wouldn’t be able to eliminate their hunger.

Previously, he had stayed in the Galaxy Network for a consecutive twenty days, and his physical body had not eaten the slightest bit of food all this while. That must mean that he was extremely hungry.
Hurry up and go eat.
He pushed open the doors and left. Hu Niu immediately jumped over. When she found out that he was going to eat, she naturally went with him happily.
“Yi, you’ve broken through to the Foundation Building Tier?” Ling Han was surprised.
“That’s right, bad Ling Han. When I broke through to Foundation Building Tier, you weren’t even by Niu’s side!” Hu Niu humphed.
“Hehe, Grandpa Dog has also broken through!” The large black dog appeared, exuding the unique aura of a Foundation Building cultivator.
Ling Han couldn’t help but feel rueful. Having someone fully support him and fighting alone were two completely different things.

Previously, he had worked so hard, and had many fortuitous encounters, but that was also because he had spent a very long time to finally break through to Foundation Building Tier. How could it be as easy as Hu Niu and the others?
However, he had cultivated each cultivation level to the pinnacle, so he naturally had to spend even more time.
“Ling Han! Ling Han!” Xuanyuan Dingguo’s voice traveled over from afar.
Ling Han sighed. Why was this guy always panicking?
It wasn’t long before Xuanyuan Dingguo charged through the door, panting and looking like the sky was about to collapse.
“What is it? Does your father want to force you to marry some ugly woman?” Ling Han asked with a smile.
“You’re still in the mood to laugh? Something big has happened!” Xuanyuan Dingguo said loudly to Ling Han after taking two deep breaths.

“What’s going on?” Ling Han didn’t think much of it. Brother Monkey had returned now, and he was the descendant of a genuine Imperial Clan. His battle prowess was definitely one of the strongest among Sect Masters.
With Brother Monkey standing guard, who would he be afraid of?𝚏𝕣𝐞𝗲𝐰𝕖𝐛𝐧𝕠𝕧𝚎𝚕.𝐜𝚘𝗺
“Someone from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire has come!” Xuanyuan Dingguo said.
Er, this was really shocking news..

chapters.title: Chapter 3746: Visitors from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire
paragraphs: Chapter 3746: Visitors from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire
Editor: Henyee Translations
The Azure Dragon Majestic Empire could be considered the culprit behind the Celestial Sea Planet’ s difficulties.

In the past, this Majestic Empire was worried that the Chen Clan’s Royal Empire would rise up and threaten their orthodox status, so they casually gave the Chen Clan a crime of treason and sent out an army to besiege them, leading to the destruction of the Chen Clan and the massacre of tens of thousands of living beings. Afterwards, they even used the Celestial Sea Planet as a prison to imprison those who could not be easily killed.
Previously, when the Dark North Nation rose up, the prison was also opened. The Azure Dragon Majestic Empire actually did not have the slightest reaction, and only now did they send someone over.
They had really come slowly.

In the past, Ling Han didn’t know the reason, but now that he was connected to the Galaxy Network, it could be said that even on the other side of the universe, no matter what happened, he would be able to react at the first instant.

The Azure Dragon Majestic Empire couldn’t even take care of themselves during this period of time, because they were invaded by the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire. A great many planets had fallen, and those were all bountiful resource planets. In comparison, how could they possibly take the Celestial Sea Planet, a prison, to heart? Where would they find the manpower to handle this matter?
It wasn’t until not too long ago that news of the inheritance of the Saint spread far and wide. Even the Azure Dragon Empire Majestic Empire had heard about it, and finally sent an envoy over.
“Oh, what did that envoy say?” Ling Han asked.
Xuanyuan Dingguo shook his head and said, “How would I know?”
“Then has His Majesty stepped out?” Ling Han asked again.

“Not yet. The Second Prince, the Third Prince, and the Council Chairperson have all gone to receive them. I am sure that not too long after, His Majesty would also be alerted,” Xuanyuan Dingguo deduced.
Ling Han nodded. An envoy from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire had come. Such an important matter would definitely alert Chen Fengyan.

Though now that the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire was being invaded by an external enemy, they would definitely be hard-pressed and severely short of manpower, if they squeezed out some of their manpower and sent out a Sect Master, that would be enough to sweep aside all opposition in the Celestial Sea Planet – of course, this did not take into account Brother Monkey.
“Then what do the four great sects say?” Ling Han knocked on the table.

“What can they say?” Xuanyuan Dingguo sneered. “They’re staying here for the inheritance of the Saint. Now that it is proven that the so-called Saint’s inheritance is a lie, they can run at any time. The reason why they haven’t left immediately is because they’ve occupied some bountiful sites, where they can harvest high-level Celestial medicines. That’s why they are staying here as long as they can.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh. “You’ve seen things quite thoroughly.”
“Of course.” Xuanyuan Dingguo was a little proud.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then said, “His Majesty will definitely step out on this matter. Let’s just wait and see.”
Sure enough, only a day later, Chen Fengyan appeared and met with this “envoy from the superior empire”.

Brother Monkey had also returned, and said that he was about to leave Celestial Sea Planet. He was going to break through to the fourth pinnacle level, and in the current environment of Celestial Sea Planet, he would need a very long time. He had to go to a great planet.
“Brother Monkey, have you seen Chen Fengyan?” Ling Han asked.

Brother Monkey nodded. “That brat is actually hiding in the restrictions on the 18th underground level. He’s really as cowardly as a mouse. However, Old Sun swept aside all obstacles along the way, so what use are these restrictions?” Ling Han couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat. The reason why Chen Fengyan had set up this kind of restriction should be to prevent Primordial True Lord and the others from sneak attacking him while he was in seclusion, but what kind of existence was Brother Monkey?
Sect Master-level, and furthermore, he was a descendant of an Ancestral King, a great demon that possessed a Saint Tool, so it was natural that he could destroy everything in his way.
Sigh.
Lmg Han silently mourned for Chen Fengyan in his mind. Who told him to have such a senior?

“This brat is really too useless. So many years have passed, and his cultivation level is actually still the same as before. I’m so angry that I beat him up.” Brother Monkey humphed, “Also, Old Sun asked him before, and he actually didn’t call Second Brother uncle. Old Sun was so angry that he beat him up again.”
Er… Chen Fengyan actually didn’t die. He was quite durable.
“Old Sun has already told that brat that he has to listen to you in everything in the future,” Brother Monkey said.
Under Brother Monkey’s violent attacks, perhaps even Chen Fengyan wouldn’t dare to say no.

“Second Brother, the path of martial arts is long, and you need to advance with determination. You’re too sentimental, and this will probably delay your cultivation,” Brother Monkey continued. A vicious glint flashed in his eyes, “Old Sun will help you kill those women!”
F***, what kind of thought process is going through your head?

Ling Han hurriedly waved his hand and said, “Brother Monkey, don’t be rash. I know what I’m doing, and I definitely won’t delay my cultivation. Look, haven’t I formed two foundations of the Celestial Path, which is an unprecedented feat?”
To form two Celestial Foundations, there were two conditions, and neither could be missing.

Firstly, life had to be nurtured in dimensions within one’s body. This was something that no one in the entire galaxy could do. Secondly, even if there really was someone who could do the same as Ling Han, they would still have to use an Imperial Weapon as suppression. Otherwise, the second Celestial Foundation would still be impossible to form.
Hence, it was not an exaggeration to say that it was an unprecedented feat.
Brother Monkey nodded, “Forget it then.”
That was close. Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief.

The next time I see you, Second Brother, if your cultivation level doesn’t reach Old Sun’s expectations, then Old Sun will still decide to sever your mortal bonds for you,” Brother Monkey continued. Then, with a leap, xiu, he directly pierced through the heavens, turning into a streak of light that disappeared.
This… the pressure was huge!
Brother Monkey, you didn’t say when you would return, nor did you say what cultivation level I should reach to satisfy you, making me feel very uncertain.
Forget it, he’d just work hard on cultivation.
Ling Han pondered for a moment. Chen Fengyan had come out of seclusion so quickly. Had he simply come out because he had been dragged out and beaten up by Brother Monkey?

Otherwise, he would probably still be diligently cultivating in seclusion, right? Ling Han was just thinking about this, when Imperial Guards suddenly came over. They came to announce an imperial decree that decreed that Ling Han should enter the palace immediately.
On the surface, Ling Han was naturally Chen Fengyan’s subject, so he naturally had to comply with the emperor’s decree.
Thus, Ling Han set out with the Imperial Guards, heading towards the Imperial Palace.

Today, the Imperial Palace was really bustling with noise and excitement. Not only were the Imperial Princes present, but there were also the Four Great Generals, the Council Chairman, and the likes. Because of Hong Tianbu, Grand Tutor Hong had long since fled the Imperial Capital and gone to the Nine Spirits Sect.

Ling Han swept an eye over him. Chen Fengyan was naturally seated high up on the throne, but beneath him, a green-robed man was also seated. He was still sipping tea, looking very relaxed and carefree.
This must be the envoy of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. Otherwise, why would he dare to be so arrogant?
—In front of the Emperor, everyone could only stand solemnly.
“Is this Ling Han, one of the two prodigies of the Imperial Capital?” The envoy from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire glanced at Ling Han and asked.
All the officials looked furious. This was the Imperial Palace, and Chen Fengyan hadn ‘t even spoken yet. What right did he have to speak?

However, this person was the envoy of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. Even if he was slightly arrogant, what could they do about it? Moreover, he was an Ultimate Dao Foundation cultivator, so who here could compare?
Could it be that Chen Fengyan, the emperor, had to personally teach this rude guy a lesson?

That would really be hilarious. There was no one in the massive Dark North Nation that could compare to him, and they actually wanted a Spirit Transformation True Lord to personally teach a mere Ultimate Dao Foundation a lesson.
Wasn’t it embarrassing?

In the past, Ling Han didn’t know the reason, but now that he was connected to the Galaxy Network, it could be said that even on the other side of the universe, no matter what happened, he would be able to react at the first instant.
The Azure Dragon Majestic Empire couldn’t even take care of themselves during this period of time, because they were invaded by the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire.
A great many planets had fallen, and those were all bountiful resource planets.
In comparison, how could they possibly take the Celestial Sea Planet, a prison, to heart?
Where would they find the manpower to handle this matter?
It wasn’t until not too long ago that news of the inheritance of the Saint spread far and wide.
Even the Azure Dragon Empire Majestic Empire had heard about it, and finally sent an envoy over.
“Oh, what did that envoy say?” Ling Han asked.
Xuanyuan Dingguo shook his head and said, “How would I know?”
“Then has His Majesty stepped out?” Ling Han asked again.
“Not yet.
The Second Prince, the Third Prince, and the Council Chairperson have all gone to receive them.
I am sure that not too long after, His Majesty would also be alerted,” Xuanyuan Dingguo deduced.
Ling Han nodded.
An envoy from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire had come.
Such an important matter would definitely alert Chen Fengyan.

Though now that the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire was being invaded by an external enemy, they would definitely be hard-pressed and severely short of manpower, if they squeezed out some of their manpower and sent out a Sect Master, that would be enough to sweep aside all opposition in the Celestial Sea Planet – of course, this did not take into account Brother Monkey.
“Then what do the four great sects say?” Ling Han knocked on the table.
“What can they say?” Xuanyuan Dingguo sneered.
“They’re staying here for the inheritance of the Saint.
Now that it is proven that the so-called Saint’s inheritance is a lie, they can run at any time.
The reason why they haven’t left immediately is because they’ve occupied some bountiful sites, where they can harvest high-level Celestial medicines.
That’s why they are staying here as long as they can.”
Ling Han couldn’t help but laugh.
“You’ve seen things quite thoroughly.”
“Of course.” Xuanyuan Dingguo was a little proud.
Ling Han thought for a moment, then said, “His Majesty will definitely step out on this matter.
Let’s just wait and see.”
Sure enough, only a day later, Chen Fengyan appeared and met with this “envoy from the superior empire”.
Brother Monkey had also returned, and said that he was about to leave Celestial Sea Planet.
He was going to break through to the fourth pinnacle level, and in the current environment of Celestial Sea Planet, he would need a very long time.
He had to go to a great planet.
“Brother Monkey, have you seen Chen Fengyan?” Ling Han asked.
Brother Monkey nodded.
“That brat is actually hiding in the restrictions on the 18th underground level.
He’s really as cowardly as a mouse.
However, Old Sun swept aside all obstacles along the way, so what use are these restrictions?” Ling Han couldn’t help but break out in a cold sweat.

The reason why Chen Fengyan had set up this kind of restriction should be to prevent Primordial True Lord and the others from sneak attacking him while he was in seclusion, but what kind of existence was Brother Monkey?
Sect Master-level, and furthermore, he was a descendant of an Ancestral King, a great demon that possessed a Saint Tool, so it was natural that he could destroy everything in his way.
Sigh.
Lmg Han silently mourned for Chen Fengyan in his mind.
Who told him to have such a senior?
“This brat is really too useless.
So many years have passed, and his cultivation level is actually still the same as before.
I’m so angry that I beat him up.” Brother Monkey humphed, “Also, Old Sun asked him before, and he actually didn’t call Second Brother uncle.
Old Sun was so angry that he beat him up again.”
Er…
Chen Fengyan actually didn’t die.
He was quite durable.
“Old Sun has already told that brat that he has to listen to you in everything in the future,” Brother Monkey said.
Under Brother Monkey’s violent attacks, perhaps even Chen Fengyan wouldn’t dare to say no.
“Second Brother, the path of martial arts is long, and you need to advance with determination.
You’re too sentimental, and this will probably delay your cultivation,” Brother Monkey continued.
A vicious glint flashed in his eyes, “Old Sun will help you kill those women!”
F***, what kind of thought process is going through your head?
Ling Han hurriedly waved his hand and said, “Brother Monkey, don’t be rash.
I know what I’m doing, and I definitely won’t delay my cultivation.
Look, haven’t I formed two foundations of the Celestial Path, which is an unprecedented feat?”
To form two Celestial Foundations, there were two conditions, and neither could be missing.
Firstly, life had to be nurtured in dimensions within one’s body.
This was something that no one in the entire galaxy could do.
Secondly, even if there really was someone who could do the same as Ling Han, they would still have to use an Imperial Weapon as suppression.
Otherwise, the second Celestial Foundation would still be impossible to form.
Hence, it was not an exaggeration to say that it was an unprecedented feat.
Brother Monkey nodded, “Forget it then.”
That was close.
Ling Han breathed a sigh of relief.
The next time I see you, Second Brother, if your cultivation level doesn’t reach Old Sun’s expectations, then Old Sun will still decide to sever your mortal bonds for you,” Brother Monkey continued.
Then, with a leap, xiu, he directly pierced through the heavens, turning into a streak of light that disappeared.
This… the pressure was huge!
Brother Monkey, you didn’t say when you would return, nor did you say what cultivation level I should reach to satisfy you, making me feel very uncertain.
Forget it, he’d just work hard on cultivation.
Ling Han pondered for a moment.
Chen Fengyan had come out of seclusion so quickly.
Had he simply come out because he had been dragged out and beaten up by Brother Monkey?
Otherwise, he would probably still be diligently cultivating in seclusion, right?
Ling Han was just thinking about this, when Imperial Guards suddenly came over.
They came to announce an imperial decree that decreed that Ling Han should enter the palace immediately.
On the surface, Ling Han was naturally Chen Fengyan’s subject, so he naturally had to comply with the emperor’s decree.
Thus, Ling Han set out with the Imperial Guards, heading towards the Imperial Palace.
Today, the Imperial Palace was really bustling with noise and excitement.
Not only were the Imperial Princes present, but there were also the Four Great Generals, the Council Chairman, and the likes.
Because of Hong Tianbu, Grand Tutor Hong had long since fled the Imperial Capital and gone to the Nine Spirits Sect.
Ling Han swept an eye over him.
Chen Fengyan was naturally seated high up on the throne, but beneath him, a green-robed man was also seated.
He was still sipping tea, looking very relaxed and carefree.
This must be the envoy of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire.
Otherwise, why would he dare to be so arrogant?
—In front of the Emperor, everyone could only stand solemnly.
“Is this Ling Han, one of the two prodigies of the Imperial Capital?” The envoy from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire glanced at Ling Han and asked.
All the officials looked furious.
This was the Imperial Palace, and Chen Fengyan hadn ‘t even spoken yet.
What right did he have to speak?
However, this person was the envoy of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire.
Even if he was slightly arrogant, what could they do about it?
Moreover, he was an Ultimate Dao Foundation cultivator, so who here could compare?
Could it be that Chen Fengyan, the emperor, had to personally teach this rude guy a lesson?
That would really be hilarious.
There was no one in the massive Dark North Nation that could compare to him, and they actually wanted a Spirit Transformation True Lord to personally teach a mere Ultimate Dao Foundation a lesson.
Wasn’t it embarrassing?

chapters.title: Chapter 3747: Beating up the envoy
paragraphs: Chapter 3747: Beating up the envoy
Editor: Henyee Translations

Ling Han strode toward the envoy from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. There was a disdainful smile on the envoy’s face. This Royal Empire was truly waning. Up until now, he had actually not seen anyone that could match his cultivation level — not counting Chen Fengyan, he should have escaped from the prison. Actually, he did not know at all how many people and elites were actually imprisoned inside.
However, he wasn’t afraid of Chen Fengyan. This time, he had come on behalf of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. So what if he was only an Ultimate Dao Foundation? Who would dare to touch him?
Touching him would be disrespecting the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, and it would draw out the great elites of the Majestic Empire to move and flatten the
Dark North Nation.
Moreover, aside from Chen Fengyan, who else could rival him?
Ling Han was already approaching, and he raised his hand.
Hiss!
Everyone couldn’t help but widen their eyes in shock. ‘It can’t be that you want to slap him, right?’

To be honest, they too wanted to, but firstly, they did not have the ability, and secondly, even if they did, they would not dare. That was the envoy of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. Hitting him would mean great trouble.

“Impudence!” The envoy from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire was enraged. To say nothing of the fact that Ling Han hadn’t hit him yet, he was already enraged by the fact that Ling Han was standing in front of him in such a position.
Didn’t he know the rules?
I am an envoy to the imperial court!
“I’m beating a b@stard like you!” Ling Han said, and delivered a slap.
He had not struck suddenly, but rather made his stand clear. I have come to thrash you, frank and forthright.
It was precisely because of this that the envoy from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire was naturally enraged. ‘You really dare to slap me?’

“You’re seeking death!” he said with a cold chuckle. This person was far too stupid. Did he really think that he could act as arrogant as he liked just because he was one of the two prodigies of the Imperial Capital?
This was a backward and primitive planet. The path of martial arts had just begun here, so what kind of prodigy could emerge?
Because he was the tallest among the dwarves, he thought that he was taller than anyone else?
He also moved, and delivered a palm strike right at Ling Han’s face.
He was going to kill Ling Han with this strike.
Pa, a slap landed, unstoppable.
The envoy from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire was instantly sent flying. Peng, he fell heavily onto the ground, blood seeping out.
Hiss, everyone inhaled sharply. He had beaten an envoy, and the matter had blown up.

“Good, good, good!” The envoy flipped over and got back to his feet, blood all over the corners of his lips. He pointed angrily at Ling Han, then pointed at the others, “You guys are done for, you’re all done for, all of you are going to die, all of you!”
Ling Han scoffed, “Haven’t you learnt your lesson yet?”
He strode over. Pa, pa, pa, he greeted the envoy with a series of slaps.
All the ministers, including those Imperial Princes, were dumbfounded. If you want to die, don’t drag us down with you.
Why didn’t His Majesty stop him?
It was naturally satisfying to vent anger, but the consequences still had to be considered. It couldn’t be done at the expense of lives, right?
En, His Majesty is not in a position to advise against it, is he?

You see, he was arrogant, and His Majesty couldn’t make a move directly, making others laugh at the Dark North Nation for having no one to rely on. Then, Ling Han stepped out, and won back some face for the Dark North Nation. That naturally was a merit. If it was a merit, how could His Majesty reprimand him?
They understood.
Some subjects immediately felt that they had touched the point of issue for Chen Fengyan, and thought that this was a good opportunity to curry his favor.
“Ling Han, that’s enough. Stop!”𝒻𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝘯𝘰𝑣ℯ𝑙.𝘤𝑜𝘮
They all called out. It was not convenient for His Majesty to speak, so it was naturally up to them to do the job.
Yet Ling Han did not even cast a look at them. He was just here to thrash this envoy from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire.

He did not have the sligthest bit of positive feelings towards the members of the Meng Clan. Previously, he had competed with Meng Yangcheng over the Buddhist Race’s fated opportunity, and added with the crime that Azure Dragon Majestic Empire had committed on the Celestial Sea Planet, Brother Monkey had suffered for more than two thousand years because of this. This had determined that Ling Han and Azure Dragon Majestic Empire would definitely end up on opposing sides.
As for today? He would beat up the envoy first and collect some interest.
“Ling Han, you’ve gone crazy!”
“Stop!”

All the ministers shouted loudly, and even a few Imperial Princes almost rushed over. However, Chen Fengyan did not speak all this while, so how could the others have the courage to come to blows with Ling Han in this palace?
The envoy finally understood Ling Han’s determination. Although his heart was filled with fury, a wise man doesn’t fight when the odds are against him.
He obediently shut his mouth.
“Do you know where you’ve gone wrong?” Ling Han asked.
He hadn’t done anything wrong!
The envoy thought, but how could he possibly dare to be stubborn with Ling Han? Hurriedly, he said, “I should not have gone out of line in front of the Dark North King.”

Ling Han patted his head and said, “You still know where the line is?” The envoy muttered internally. This was only a primitive land, so what was it worth in front of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, which was at its peak? If it was not for the invasion of the Shadow Moon Majestic Empire, they would have directly mobilized an army of elites to flatten this planet completely.
“I know my mistake,” he said obediently.
When he returned to the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, he would definitely add fuel to the fire and egg on the imperial court to send elites to destroy the
Dark North Nation.
Ling Han smiled faintly, “Are you thinking that when you return, you will definitely exaggerate today’s matter a hundredfold, and then ask the elites to destroy us?”
When everyone heard this, they wanted nothing more than to rush over and beat Ling Han up.
‘Aren’t you teaching him what to do?’
The envoy hurriedly shook his head, and said, “How could that be? Impossible!” His expression was filled with righteousness.

Ling Han chuckled and said, “It’s fine even if you say it. However, you’re just a Foundation Building cultivator. So what if you’ve been wronged? Who would take it to heart? Our Dark North Nation is a loyal subject of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. Do you think the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire will raise its butcher’s knife against loyal subjects?”
“Fool, there are so many people in the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, so why did they send you over? Don’t you have any idea?
The envoy’s heart skipped a beat. That’s right, why had they sent him?
He was merely in the Foundation Building Tier, and in the galaxy, he was not even worth a fart. Who would take him seriously?

Yet he had been beaten silly by Ling Han. The reason why the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire had sent him here was firstly, because the front lines were really in dire straits, and they could not spare any elites. After all, the internal strife in the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire was also very great, and a great many great forces were no longer very obedient. Furthermore, the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire still considered themselves as one of the superior nations, and looked down on the Celestial Sea Planet 100 times over, so they naturally did not think that there was any need to send elites over.
They were just a bunch of prisoners. I did not mobilize troops to destroy you, but rather asked you to surrender. Naturally, you should be crying in gratitude. What else do you want?

The envoy had completely lost his pride. At present, the front lines were in dire straits, and Spiritual Transformation True Lords like Chen Fengyan and the others would be fully assisting. In comparison, what was he worth?
Only then did Ling Han smile. He tossed the messenger back onto the chair, and clasped his hands respectfully at Chen Fengyan, saying, “Greetings, Your Majesty.”

Chen Fengyan suddenly stood up. ‘F*ck! This is my youngest uncle! Not long ago, he was thrashed by Uncle Monkey and scolded for disrespecting his elders. He was beaten to the point that he couldn’t bear it anymore!’ Now, however, Ling Han was actually paying respects to him? This was truly going to kill him. Where was Uncle Monkey? Was Uncle Monkey here?
He couldn’t help but look around, his heart thumping wildly.
All the ministers were surprised. What was going on here?

chapters.title: Chapter 3748: Self-recommendation
paragraphs: Chapter 3748: Self-recommendation
Editor: Henyee Translations
A subject bowed, and Chen Fengyan actually stood up.
Hiss, this was too exaggerated, wasn’t it?

Chen Fengyan also realized that he had lost his composure. It couldn’t be helped. He had been beaten to the point of doubting life by Brother Monkey previously. He sat back down, waved his hand, and said, “My dear subject, there’s no need to be so polite.”
Ling Han nodded, and retreated among the ministers.
Shua, every minister involuntarily took a few steps back, maintaining an absolute distance from Ling Han.
No one wanted to have anything to do with this troublemaker.
Ling Han was rendered speechless. Was he that scary?
Chen Fengyan looked at the envoy and said calmly, “You’ ve come on behalf of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, so what’s your intention?”
That envoy finally recovered a little of his pride, but when he discovered that Ling Han was staring at him, this little bit of pride immediately vanished without a trace.
Others might have reservations, but this guy didn’t. Others didn’t dare to touch him, but this guy did.

The envoy hurriedly said honestly, “Our Imperial Majesty, requests the Dark North King to deliver your letter of surrender, and send an envoy to represent the Dark North Nation to stay eternally in our Empire.”

It was very much in line with the rules to present a surrender letter. The Azure Dragon Majestic Empire could not possibly allow an uncontrollable force to appear in their territory, but they still needed the Dark North Nation to send out an envoy?
Wasn’t this clearly a hostage?
All the Imperial Princes looked livid. This envoy was definitely going to be chosen from among them.
Among them, the ten eldest Imperial Princes were the most nervous. They had the best natural talent, and had the highest cultivation level. Thus, they would definitely be the first to be chosen.
-The more important this hostage was to Chen Fengyan, the more obedient Chen Fengyan would be. This was a simple logic that could be understood just by thinking about it.
However, who would want to become a hostage?
To put it nicely, they would be an anvoy, but in truth, they were a hostage, and what good treatment could a hostage get?
They were all Imperial Princes, and able to command so many people at once now, so how awe-inspiring was that?
However, if he went to the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, he would be like an insect that wouldn’t get any response no matter how much he called out.
All the Imperial Princes turned to look at Chen Fengyan, hoping that their father’s love for them would be as great as a mountain. They hoped that he wouldn’t choose them.
“I’ll go.” A voice rang out. In the silence, it seemed very abrupt.
Shua, all eyes turned towards Ling Han.
It was Ling Han who had spoken just now.
All the subjects shook their heads. ‘You are really too f****** good at sucking up, but the problem is, no matter how much His Majesty dotes on you, what right do you have to be a hostage?’

One couldn’t become a hostage so easily. One had to have a high enough status. Before Chen Fengyan could speak, the messenger interrupted, “Er… it’s best that the messenger is the son of the Dark North King. Otherwise, it might be useless even if you go.”
He was scared off by Ling Han’s beating, and his words were very careful, fearing that Ling Han would come and beat him up again in anger. Ling Han cracked a smile, “Don’t worry, my weight is enough.
He paused for a moment before turning to Chen Fengyan and asking, “Isn t that right, nephew?”
Shua! Everyone turned to look at Chen Fengyan.
Nephew?
‘Hmm?’

Chen Fengyan felt extremely vexed. What would come eventually would come. This relationship couldn’t be concealed! However, he was also grateful that Ling Han was willing to stand up for the Chen Clan.
He nodded, “Subject Ling is indeed my elder.”
A single stone caused a thousand ripples!
What? Ling Han was actually Chen Fengyan’s senior?
Heavens, how was this possible?

Meanwhile, the Second Imperial Prince and the others suddenly recalled that when Ling Han had been teaching them a lesson, he had indeed said that he was their grand uncle. At first, they had thought that Ling Han was deliberately taking advantage of them, but they had not thought that it was actually true.
The envoy was also surprised.
Chen Fengyan was the ruler of a nation, and he was more so a mighty Spirit Transformation True Lord. If he dared to recognize a random person as elder, he would definitely lose all face.
Thus, Ling Han was genuinely Chen Fengyan’s senior.
No wonder Chen Fengyan didn’t stop Ling Han from acting so arrogantly just then. Wasn’t that treasonous?

“This nephew of mine has over a hundred sons. He would not take any one of them to heart at all,” Ling Han said. “However, it is different for me, his uncle. There is only one, and the significance is completely different.”
Yi, why are you still promoting yourself?
Everyone was speechless. You are going to be a hostage, not to enjoy life. Why are you so proactive?
The envoy couldn’t help but nod. That’s right. He had over a hundred sons. Whichever one he chose as hostage, would they be able to use him to threaten Chen Fengyan?
Moreover, once Ling Han went to the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire, wouldn’t it be his territory?
It was now possible for him to exact revenge.
When he thought of this, his heart involuntarily thumped.
“All right, it’s you then,” he nodded.
Everyone was speechless. This was such a big matter, and Ling Han had decided with just a single word of self-promotion and a nod from the envoy?
This was too childish, wasn’t it?
