chapters.title: Chapter 3749: Jia Yuan Manor
paragraphs: Chapter 3749: Jia Yuan Manor
Editor: Henyee Translations
After boarding the warship, Ling Han stayed alone in the cabin.
Of course, there was also the large black dog and the perverted pig.
Though he was going to be a hostage, and could not possibly bring his whole family with him, there was no rule against bringing “pets”, was there?

The envoy from the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire was called Ge Shuang. He thought that Ling Han was scared of leaving home, and ignored this. His mind was filled with thoughts of how he was going to vent his anger after returning to the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire.
—At present, he definitely did not dare to kill Ling Han. This was a hostage from the Dark North Nation, but if he embarrassed Ling Han a little, or even gave him a good thrashing, that was fine.
“Let’s go.”
With a wave of his hand, the warship began to traverse through the galaxy.

Ling Han naturally didn’t feel any grief. He had experienced this kind of situation many times before, so he only had ambitions of conquering new territory. How could he worry about personal gains and losses?
He connected with Galaxy Network and began today’s level battles.
After a few days, his ranking was also shooting up.

At the lower levels, if one maintained a winning streak, their ranking would increase very quickly. Lin Luo and the others had only fought for less than two months, yet they had already entered the top 100 million, which was proof enough of this.

He had already mastered one form of the Demonic Monkey Fists, and from the second form onwards, there was still a requirement for cultivation level. It was not something that could be achieved simply through hard cultivation. Thus, Ling Han did not waste any more Universe Coins to go to the Time Chamber to cultivate. Instead, he went to the training hall to break records.

He would experience great improvement every day, and his power was naturally increasing as well. However, he had not broken through to the next cultivation level, so this kind of improvement was naturally limited. There would not be any sudden qualitative change.
However, he wasn’t far from those records in the first place. Slowly, he broke records one after another. Although he didn’t obtain many Universe Coins, his reputation became more and more renowned.

There were too many people who wanted to defeat him, and make a name for themselves in a single stroke. Regarding this, Ling Han was also very willing to oblige them. He clearly stated a price of 10,000 Universe Coins per battle.

At this point, the strength of Ling Han’s talent had indeed shocked the universe. At the same time, his reputation for being a money-grubber was not to be outdone either, causing many great forces to come to recruit him. The first words they said were, ‘As long as you join us, you can ask for as many Universe Coins as you want.’
Ling Han indeed needed money very much, but he would definitely not sell himself off to any force.
Moreover, if he wanted money, couldn’t he earn it himself?

He tried to find Origin to fight again, but Origin would refuse every time. When he was annoyed enough, he replied that there was no meaning to continue fighting now. He would fight again after Ling Han had a breakthrough in strength, or Ling Han had advanced into Ultimate Dao Foundation.
Sigh, wasn’t this cutting off his source of income?

Ling Han was in high spirits, and went to contact Myriad Dao and Heaven Crushing. He wanted to befriend them, then open a tournament stage to collect fees for tickets, but the two of them actually ignored him.
F***, had he become notorious now?

He patiently and continuously issued his friend request, and the two of them finally replied. They said that Ling Han had to be ranked in the top ten of Galaxy Network, at least, before they could exchange blows with Ling Han.
There was nothing else that could be done. He could only find another way to earn money.

Don’t say, there were really people who refused to believe it, and came to challenge Ling Han. However, Ling Han’s strength could be ranked around a hundredth even among those in Ultimate Dao Foundation, and how could those who were ranked so high take the initiative to challenge someone with such a low point level like Ling Han?
Winning would not bring them any glory, but losing would mean losing face. What was the point?

Ling Han would participate in the level battles every day, and earn some extra income from accepting challenges from others. He didn’t feel that his days were difficult. However, he couldn’t absorb the power of heaven and earth in the heaven and earth, so he could only rely on the Azure Wood Restore Spirit Pill to improve. This caused his advancement to become very slow.
It couldn’t be helped. The Silver Dragon Fish’s effects were more or less digested.
The warship passed through one wormhole after another, and after a whole two months, they finally arrived at Moonlight Planet.

“We’ve finally arrived.” Ge Shuang smirked coldly. This was his territory. Now that they were here, even if Ling Han was a dragon, he would have to coil himself up. He would slowly deal with Ling Han.

The warship landed, and Ge Shuang was the first to disembark. He glanced at Ling Han, who was behind him, and saw that the latter had a relaxed expression on his face. He did not have the slightest bit of unease and anxiety that came from having just arrived here, which made him feel slightly displeased.
In his eyes, Ling Han had suddenly come to the territory of the Majestic Empire. He was all alone, with no one to rely on at all, so he would definitely be in a state of anxiety.
Just how thick was this guy’s brain?

He wanted to “remind” Ling Han and wake him up a little, but before he could speak, he saw Ling Han looking at him with a faint smile, causing his heart to involuntarily tremble. He swallowed the words that were about to come out of his mouth.
He was already traumatized by Ling Han.
Ling Han stepped onto the ground. He looked around. Hehe, Moonlight Planet, he was here again.
“Come with me,” Ge Shuang said. He was extremely displeased with his own performance. They were already in his territory, yet he was still as afraid of Ling Han as if he was a snake.
The two of them strode forwards, and soon arrived at the Clan Mansion?.
“This guy is the uncle of the Dark North Nation’s leader?” When the person-in-charge saw Ling Han, he couldn’t help but ask in surprise, “Ge Shuang, are you joking?”

This person looked to be in his twenties, and it was not that he looked young, but that he was really young. That flame of life blazed brightly, and he definitely could not be over a hundred years old.
But what about Chen Fengyan?
Being able to become a Spirit Transformation True Lord, which one of them wasn’t an old monster?

Ge Shuang hurriedly nodded, and said, “That’s indeed the case. I saw Chen Fengyan admit it with my own eyes. Also, this is the surrender letter that Chen Fengyan handed in. It also clearly states that his uncle, Ling Han, is to stay eternally in our Empire.”

The person-in-charge still couldn’t believe it. He stared at Ling Han repeatedly, and after a long time, he finally made a record of Ling Han’s identity, allowing him to enter into the Jia Yuan Manor.

The Jia Yuan Manor was also known as the Political Hostage Manor, because the people who lived there had the same nature as Ling Han and were hostages of the extraterrestrial forces that were subordinate to the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. Thus, they were all hostages, so what else could they be called if not the Political Hostage Manor?.

Now that they were here, this was no longer a place that Ge Shuang could touch. He watched Ling Han leave, while he was already planning in his heart who he should ask to give Ling Han a harsh beating.
He definitely could not swallow this humiliation.

Ling Han followed a servant into the Jia Yuan Manor. This was a very large place, with multiple courtyards, and there was a hostage living in each courtyard. The conditions were not too bad, and they were all equipped with servants.
“Young Master Ling, this is your residence.” The servant led Ling Han into a courtyard, then nodded at Ling Han before turning around to leave.
Ling Han walked in, and immediately, three servants approached him. They bowed and said, “Greetings, Lord.”

These three servants were two men and one woman respectively. All of them looked to be over forty years old. Their looks were ordinary, and possessed a slight cultivation level. They were all at the level of Blood Transformation Tier.
Ling Han nodded, “My surname is Ling, and my name is Ling Han. You guys can just call me Young Master Han.”
“Young Master Han!” the three servants said at the same time. Their attitudes were extremely respectful.
Even though Ling Han was a hostage, he was still a special envoy representing a nation, so how could he be disrespected?
Ling Han waved his hand, indicating for them to leave. Then, he planned to go out and buy the ingredients for concocting the Foundation Dissolution Pill.
However, when he arrived at the entrance of the Jia Yuan Manor, he was stopped.
“Without special permission, you are not allowed to go out!”

chapters.title: Chapter 3750: Concocting the Foundation Dissolution Pill
paragraphs: Chapter 3750: Concocting the Foundation Dissolution Pill
Editor: Henyee Translations𝒻𝓇𝑒𝘦𝘸𝑒𝒷𝓃ℴ𝑣𝘦𝑙.𝒸ℴ𝘮
It was not that someone was deliberately targeting Ling Han, but rather that this was the rule of the Jia Yuan Manor. A hostage could not be allowed to leave as he willed it.
Tsk, did they really think of him as a prisoner?

Ling Han didn’t argue. Although the guards here were only at the cultivation level of the Foundation Building Tier, and he could deal with them with a single finger, if he really made a move, he would attract the suppression of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. For the current Ling Han, this was a colossal giant that he couldn’t oppose yet.
Thus, he turned around and returned. However, he asked, “I can’t go out. Is there any problem with my dog going out for a walk?”
Walking the dog? Oh, no, the dog was walking itself?
The guard at the door thought for a moment, then said that there was no problem.
As long as there was no problem.
After Ling Han returned, he called the large black dog over.

“What’s wrong? Can’t you see that I’m busy right now?” The large black dog was presently sprawled out on the ground. Ever since he had equipped the connection device, it was as if he had obtained an incredibly interesting toy. He had been immersed in that world all this while, and was having a great time playing with it.
Ling Han chuckled, “Alright, then from now onwards, I won’t give you any more Universe Coins.”

“Hehehe!” The large black dog immediately got up, and said with an obsequious smile, “Little Han Han, Grandpa Dog was just joking with you. Don’t take it seriously. Quick, tell me what’s the matter. Grandpa Dog is juat about to bring a girl to barge into a place of extreme frost. We agreed that after we barged in, the girl would show Grandpa Dog her underpants.”
Ling Han almost gave him a slap. ‘What are you thinking about all day?’

In the Galaxy Network, in addition to sparring and shopping, there were also some virtual Mystery Realms that could allow people to enter for training and increase their experience. The reason why people died time and time again in virtual Mystery Realms was actually so that they would not die in real Mystery Realms, or even be injured in real Mystery Realms.
But when it came to the large black dog, it actually became a tool for him to pick up girls?
“You damn dog, can’t you show some promise?” Ling Han sighed.
“Heng, heng!” The pervert pig also mocked from the sidelines.
“You’re not much better either,” Ling Han glared at him.
The perverted pig gave him a disdainful look. If it was not for this guy, it would definitely be in the arms of different beauties by now, enjoying all the luck with women.
“Little Han, why are you calling Grandpa Dog over?” the large black dog asked.
Ling Han looked at it. Now, he was slightly hesitant. Would it be reliable to hand this matter over to the large black dog? Would this guy embezzle his funds to court women?
However, if he didn’t send the large black dog, could it be that he should let the perverted pig go?
Ling Han glanced at the perverted pig, and shook his head. Sigh, why was there only this unreliable pig and dog by his side?
The pervert pig was instantly enraged. What kind of gaze was that?
It was one thing for you to look down on that perverted dog, but why did you have to sweep your gaze over Lord Pig as well, b@stard?
There was nothing else that could be done. He had best let the large black dog do the job.
“Help me buy some medicinal ingredients,” Ling Han said seriously.
The large black dog faltered for a moment before cocking its head to one side to look at Ling Han. “Little Han, you actually delayed Grandpa Dog’s time to court women for such a small matter?”

“Here, I’ll transfer 200,000 Universe Coins to you. Buy me 10 portions of the medicinal ingredients listed here, and I’ve marked the price for each of them. If you can buy them back at a lower price, they’ll be considered your errand fee,” Ling Han tempted.

“I’ll go! I’ll go!” The large black dog immediately stood up on his hind legs, one arm wrapped around Ling Han’s shoulder, “Little Han, if anything like this happens in the future, just send Grandpa Dog over. Who are we to each other!” “Get lost!”
After Ling Han transferred the money, the large black dog fled in a flash.

After half a day, he finally saw the large black dog slowly return. He had thrown all the ingredients on the ground, and then disappeared in a flash. He had probably embezzled a lot of money, and feared that Ling Han would go back on his word.
Unfortunately, it didn’t know how much money Ling Han had earned from the tickets for his battle with Origin. Otherwise, it would definitely strangle Ling Han’s neck and demand a dividend.
Ling Han smiled, and after counting the ingredients, nodded.

Though the large black dog was unreliable, the medicinal ingredients he had bought this time were not too bad. There were no cases of inadequacy of age, or of medicinal effects being lost after being left for too long.

On this point, the large black dog still had some sense of propriety. He knew the importance of Ling Han’s alchemy skills, so he should have only made some money from getting good bargains. Otherwise, if he had just bought some medicinal ingredients, he should not have spent practically half a day’s time. He had probably worn out his mouth, and dumbfounded the shop assistant.
In this aspect, Ling Han was far too confident in the large black dog.

Ling Han then set up the formation. He frowned slightly. The heaven and earth here had been changed, and used to build the defensive formation of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. That was a very high-level formation, which also made Ling Han’s desire to stimulate the heaven and earth here, and form an alchemy formation became a very troublesome task.
Simply put, he was no match for that great formation in the Imperial Capital.
There was nothing else that could be done. Ling Han could only use the Dao Stones as replacement, and burn the energy of the Dao Stones to replenish the power of heaven and earth.
This consumed a lot of Dao Stones, but there was nothing that could be done.

Ling Han began to concoct alchemical pills. He tossed the medicinal ingredients into the cauldron, and used his Spiritual Power to stimulate the power of heaven and earth, blending and improving the essence of the medicinal ingredients.
Pa, a crisp sound rang out, and the alchemy cauldron shattered.

Ling Han couldn’t help but frown. There was nothing wrong with his concoction technique, but concocting alchemical pills above Celestial Path, the power of heaven and earth stimulated was extremely shocking. This ordinary alchemy cauldron could not withstand the pressure of this kind of energy, and easily shattered.
Could it be that he would have to use the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower again?

This was the Imperial Capital of the Azure Dragon Majestic Empire. Ling Han didn’t want to expose his treasures. Although he could keep have the Imperial Weapon keep a low profile, this wasn’t enough for greedy people.
He had to get a better alchemy cauldron. He couldn’t keep using the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower to refine pills in the future, right?
He took out the Primal Chaos Extreme Lightning Tower and began to refine it again. This time, he would use the future Imperial Weapon to make up for it.

The concoction of the Foundation Dissolution Pill was extremely complex, and it also required a sliver of power from the alchemist’s Celestial Foundation, which directly affected the quality of the completed pill. Even Ling Han had to be very careful, even if he had already rehearsed it many times in his mind.
However, a drill was a drill. In the end, all of it was only plans, but he needed to execute these plans in real life.
Failure, failure, failure.
This was more difficult than Ling Han had imagined. He had actually failed seven times in a row. To the Alchemy Emperor, this was an inconceivable feat.
He adjusted his condition, and was not in a rush to begin concocting the eighth cauldron. Instead, he began to recall in his mind, summarizing his own shortcomings.
After half an hour, Ling Han finally started again.
This time, he was successful.
Three hours passed, and he revealed a smile. The concoction of the alchemical pill was close at hand.

He suddenly snapped his fingers. Xiu, xiu, xiu, he shot out seven flashes of power. This was the power of his Celestial Foundation, and was also the catalyst for the Foundation Dissolution Pill. It was extremely important.
Seven flashes of power shot into the alchemical pills, causing the seven alchemical pills to dance in the air like fairies.
Ling Han focused his full attention. He was presently fusing the power of the Celestial Foundation with the medicinal effects.
One second, two seconds… ten seconds.
The time was very short. Ling Han stretched out a hand, and xiu, the seven alchemical pills were all taken into his palm.
Pa, pa, pa! Applause rang out..
